izzyondroid:app.lawnchair.name: Lawnchair
izzyondroid:app.lawnchair.summary: Homescreen based on on Launcher3 from AOSP
izzyondroid:app.lawnchair.description:
Lawnchair. Get it? It's a bad pun, we know. Based on Launcher3 from AOSP, Lawnchair has all the features of the Pixel Launcher (including the Google Feed), plus customizability. Best of all? No root required.
 Lawnchair is a free, open-source home app for Android. Taking Launcher3—Android’s default home app—as a starting point, it ports Pixel Launcher features and introduces rich customization options.
 NOTE: These are betas of the upcoming version for the next version of Lawnchair . Use at your own risk! 
 Icon size, label, rows, and columns are all adjustable. Lawnchair also supports icon packs, and the Pill is customizable as well. These aren't the only features, and more are added regularly. An incomplete feature list includes:
 Material You Theming: Adapts to your wallpaper and system theme.
 At a Glance Widget: Displays information at a glance with support for Smartspacer.
 QuickSwitch Support: Integrates with Android Recents on Android 10 and newer. (requires root)
 Global Search: Allows quick access to apps, contacts, and web results from the home screen.
 Customization Options: Provides options to tweak icons, fonts, and colors to your liking.

izzyondroid:com.blankdev.sidestep.name: Sidestep
izzyondroid:com.blankdev.sidestep.summary: Intercept URLs, remove tracking, and redirect to privacy-friendly frontends.
izzyondroid:com.blankdev.sidestep.description:
Android app that intercepts social media URLs and redirects them to alternative frontends while removing tracking parameters. No apps or accounts needed to access the content shared with you.
 Alternative Frontends 
 Bypass closed ecosystems and access a more open internet - with a less cluttered web experience. Sidestep supports several major platforms with configurable alternatives:
 Twitter/X → Nitter
 Reddit → Redlib
 YouTube → Invidious, Piped
 Google Maps → OpenStreetMap
 IMDb → LibreMDB
 Medium → Scribe
 Wikipedia → Wikiless
 Goodreads → BiblioReads
 Genius → Dumb, Intellectual
 Tumblr → Priviblur
 UrbanDictionary → RuralDictionary
 Imgur → Rimgo
 GitHub → GotHub
 StackOverflow → AnonymousOverflow
 Flexible Configuration & Smart URL Cleaning 
 Automatically removes tracking parameters from all URLs:
 UTM parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, etc.)
 Platform-specific trackers (Twitter s/t, YouTube si, Instagram igsh)
 E-commerce tracking (Amazon, affiliate links)
 Analytics parameters
 Granular control over how URLs are processed:
 Unshorten URLs: Automatically resolves shortened links (bit.ly, t.co, etc.)
 Remove Tracking: Strip analytics and tracking parameters
 Immediate Navigation: Automatically open the processed URL in your browser
 Clean Only Mode: Remove tracking without redirecting
 Clean & Sidestep Mode: Remove tracking AND redirect to alternative frontend
 Custom Redirects: Add your own domain mappings
 Instance Picker: Fetch live, healthy instances sorted by uptime
 Tracking-proof 
 Previews fetched via DuckDuckGo (optional)
 No Data Collection: Zero analytics, zero tracking
 Local Processing: All URL cleaning happens on-device

izzyondroid:org.joinmastodon.android.mos.name: Moshidon
izzyondroid:org.joinmastodon.android.mos.summary: Mastodon for Android but it's Material You and has more features
izzyondroid:org.joinmastodon.android.mos.description:
Moshidon is a modified version of the official Mastodon Android app adding important features that are missing in the official app, such as the federated timeline, unlisted posting and an image description viewer.
 Key features 
 Many colors : Brings material you theme and many colorful options for themes!
 Filtered posts! : The ability to have filtered posts show with a warning!
 Translate button : Brings a translate button!
 Toot language picker : Brings in a toot language picker!
 Unlisted posting : Post publicly without having your post show up in trends, hashtags or public timelines.
 Federated timeline : See all public posts from people on all other Fediverse neighborhoods your home instance is connected to.
 Image description viewer : Quickly check whether an image or video has an alt text attached to it.
 Pinning posts : Pin your most important posts to your profile and see what others have pinned using the “Pinned“ tab.
 Follow hashtags : See new posts from specific hashtags directly in your home timeline by following them.
 Answering follow requests : Accept or decline follow requests from your notifications or the dedicated Follow requests list.
 Delete and re-draft : The much-loved feature that made editing possible without an actual editing function.
 Extras : Brings many extra UI features, such as interaction icons on the Notifications and removing many annoyances with the original UI!

fdroid:com.aeidolon.vaultexplorer.name: Vault Explorer
fdroid:com.aeidolon.vaultexplorer.summary: Encrypted container explorer: VeraCrypt, LUKS, BitLocker, Cryptomator, gocryptfs
fdroid:com.aeidolon.vaultexplorer.description:
Vault Explorer opens and browses encrypted containers and vaults directly
on your device -- VeraCrypt/TrueCrypt, LUKS, BitLocker, Cryptomator,
gocryptfs, and CryFS, plus VHD/VHDX images -- without exporting your
files unencrypted to shared storage.
Features:
* Read/write NTFS, FAT/exFAT, and ext2/3/4 filesystems inside a container
* VeraCrypt/LUKS/BitLocker unlock, including cascaded ciphers and hidden volumes
* Cryptomator, gocryptfs, and CryFS directory-vault support
* Built-in viewers and editors for photos, video/audio, PDF, HTML, Markdown, and text/code, plus an image editor and archive browser (ZIP, 7-Zip, RAR, TAR and more)
* Vault camera -- shoot photos and video straight into a container, with background recording and a Quick Settings tile/shortcut
* Item Vault -- an encrypted password manager built into your container
* Create new encrypted containers and USB volumes, up to 8 mounted at once
* Password, PIN, pattern, or biometric unlock
* Storage locations for device storage, SD cards, and cloud document providers, plus auto-sync between a vault and a folder
* Emergency panic and duress unlock -- lock vaults, wipe credentials, or wipe the app's own data
* Mask Mode -- optionally disguise the app as a real, working local file manager on the home screen; hold the title for 2 seconds to reach your real vault
* Optional local automation for Tasker/MacroDroid (Beta) -- no network involved
* Tools: keyfile/passphrase generator, file encryptor, hash verifier, vault sync, storage analyzer, duplicate finder, split & join, header backup, and container repair
Vault Explorer does not collect or transmit any data -- it has no INTERNET
permission at all. All decryption happens locally on your device, in
memory wherever possible. The few operations that need a scratch file keep it
in private app storage and wipe it afterwards. Files only leave a vault when
you (or an automation you enabled) export, share, or sync them.
Mask Mode only changes the app's home-screen name, icon, and front screen for
situations where someone else may pick up your device. The disguised file
manager is a genuine, working browser for your device's own storage, not a
way to hide activity from other people.

fdroid:com.baly_groceries_tracker.app.name: Baly Groceries Tracker
fdroid:com.baly_groceries_tracker.app.summary: Track your groceries, without worrying about running out.
fdroid:com.baly_groceries_tracker.app.description:
A free, open-source app that frees your mind from constantly worrying about essential household needs.
At a quick glance, you can see how much you have left of eggs, flour, rice, and other daily essentials — so you always know what's about to run out and what's still in stock.
Stay organized and enjoy peace of mind by tracking your groceries and receiving alerts before essential items run out.
The app helps you prioritize what truly needs to be bought, making it easier to spend your budget on necessities first rather than on impulse purchases.
This reduces waste, lowers the risk of financial strain caused by poor planning, and gives you greater peace of mind in your daily life.
Perfect for families and anyone seeking a better, more organized life.
 Key Features 
 Expiry Screen 
Displays all items that are about to run out, sorted by priority, with clear visual indicators — so you instantly know what needs to be bought first.
Frees you from constant worry and the recurring question: "Is something essential about to run out right now?"
 Smart Alerts 
The app sends a notification when any household supply is close to running out, giving you enough time to plan your purchase before it runs out.
You can also manage notifications and disable them for any item as you wish, and choose your preferred time for notifications to arrive.
 Built-in Shopping List 
No need to write your shopping list elsewhere. The app provides a shopping list where you can add items that are about to run out, along with anything else you don't track within the app.
So you buy only what you need and avoid unnecessary impulse purchases — with the option to easily share the list via WhatsApp with anyone who can do the shopping for you.
 Inventory Sharing 
Want to let a family member know what's in the house?
No need to explain the state of your supplies manually. You can generate a summary showing all available items and how much is left of each, and easily share it via WhatsApp.
 Change History 
Don't worry if you make a mistake updating an item's data or doubt a value you entered previously.
The app lets you review the change history to see what was modified and when, with the ability to easily revert to any previous state.
 Complete Privacy 
All your data is stored locally on your device, and the app works fully offline, with the ability to create backups and restore them whenever needed.
 No Ads 
The app is completely free of ads, so you can use it without any annoyance or distraction.
 Supports Arabic and English 
The app supports both Arabic and English.

fdroid:com.circadiandisplay.app.name: Circadian Display
fdroid:com.circadiandisplay.app.summary: Adaptive screen warmth and dimming curves for better evening comfort and sleep.

Setwork — Set your work. Get it done ●
Your tasks live on your phone. Not in a cloud.
Setwork is a distraction-free task manager that works entirely offline. No account. No sync fees. No ads. Just you and your to-do list.
Why people love it:

● App modes, theming, customizations — your app, your feel.

fdroid:com.github.mistermo_vibecode.voic.name: VoicePlus – Audiobook Player
fdroid:com.github.mistermo_vibecode.voic.summary: Play local audiobooks with a smart sleep timer and listening stats.
fdroid:com.github.mistermo_vibecode.voic.description:
VoicePlus is a free, open-source player for audiobooks stored on your device. Choose your audiobook folders with Android's file picker, then listen offline without creating an account.
PLAYBACK
- Remembers your position in each book
- Adjustable playback speed and bookmarks
- Volume boost, with an option to remember it across all books
- Sleep timer with end-of-chapter options and interaction reset
- Customizable playback toolbar, lock-screen controls and media-button actions
- Android Auto and a resizable home-screen widget
MAKE YOUR LIBRARY YOURS
- Book-inspired portrait covers, Grid or List view, and two or three books per row
- Personal shelves and manually grouped series with editable book order
- Current keeps in-progress books easy to reach, even inside a series
- Edit titles and covers without rewriting audio files; preserve edits through rescans and portable backups
- Listening log and statistics calculated on your device
- Character notes for each book
- Edit chapter names and fix incorrect chapter numbering
- Hide books without deleting their files
- Back up and restore your progress and settings
PRIVACY
VoicePlus has no account, ads, analytics or crash-reporting service. Your library and listening history are stored locally. If Android system backup is enabled, eligible app data may be backed up by your configured provider. The optional online cover search sends a book title and author query to DuckDuckGo; opening a result downloads an image from its host. Cover search only runs when you choose to use it.
Privacy policy: https://github.com/mistermo-vibecode/VoicePlus/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
OPEN SOURCE
VoicePlus is a GPLv3-licensed fork of Voice by Paul Woitaschek, with additional features and changes by Mistermo. Source code: https://github.com/mistermo-vibecode/VoicePlus

fdroid:com.greenaddress.greenbits_androi.name: Blockstream App (Green)
fdroid:com.greenaddress.greenbits_androi.description:
The Blockstream app (formerly Green) is a simple and secure Bitcoin wallet that makes it easy to get started sending and receiving Bitcoin and Liquid-based assets such as Liquid Bitcoin (L-BTC) and Tether’s USDt.
Built by Blockstream, one of the most security-focused teams in the Bitcoin industry, the wallet is supported across multiple platforms and is designed for Bitcoin beginners and power users alike.
EASY SETUP
No registration or personal details are required to get started, just write down your recovery phrase and start making Bitcoin transactions right away.
BUY BITCOIN DIRECTLY TO SELF-CUSTODY
No intermediate self custody, buy bitcoin directly into your wallet (additional registration may be required).
FASTER & CHEAPER BITCOIN TRANSACTIONS
Smart fee estimation ensures your Bitcoin payments arrive on time without being charged excessive fees.
MULTILINGUAL
We speak your language. Green includes support for Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified), Dutch, English, French, German, Hebrew, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese. And more to come!
BITCOIN LAYER-2 SUPPORT
Send and receive Liquid Bitcoin L-BTC, Tether’s USDt, and any other Liquid-based assets with a Liquid account.
Bitcoin power users will feel right at home with a wide range of advanced features and industry-firsts:
FEE CONTROL
Fully customizable transaction fees with replace-by-fee support so that you can start low and adjust the fee if necessary. Great for pushing through urgent transactions without overpaying.
HARDWARE WALLET SUPPORT
Integration with Blockstream Jade, Ledger Nano S and X, Trezor One and T (see our help desk for latest compatibility across the various supported platforms).
TWO-FACTOR THRESHOLDS
Require two-factor authentication for large payments only, by setting a two-factor threshold. Total payments up to the threshold can be completed without 2FA.
WATCH-ONLY WALLETS
Keep an eye on your Bitcoin balances while on the go and receive payments from others without needing to grant payment permissions to your device.
TESTNET SUPPORT
Easily make test transactions on Bitcoin testnet until you feel comfortable with how the wallet works.
PRIVACY
No documents, personal information, or KYC required. An email address is needed for wallet recovery purposes only. Connect via Tor at the tap of a button, no other apps needed.
CONNECT TO YOUR OWN NODE
Verify transactions on your own full node with SPV support.

fdroid:com.menny.android.anysoftkeyboard.name: AnySoftKeyboard
fdroid:com.menny.android.anysoftkeyboard.summary: We live in a world full of languages. Why not use a multi-lingual keyboard?
fdroid:com.menny.android.anysoftkeyboard.description:
Any Soft Keyboard is an open-source, on-screen keyboard with multiple languages support with emphasis on privacy.
This is one of the most customizable keyboards available.
To activate: Launch 'AnySoftKeyboard Settings' App, and follow the instructions.
Main features:
* Multi languages keyboard support via external packages.
* Completion dictionaries for multiple languages.
* Also completes your typed words from you contacts names (Android 2.0+)!
* And, learns your typing behavior to provide next-word prediction.
* Multi-Touch support (as in, pressing SHIFT along with other characters).
* Extension keyboard (swipe your finger all the way up out of the keyboard).
* Voice Input support (Android 2.2+).
* Compact/Phablet Mode.
* Gesture support:
** Experimental Gesture-Typing (enable in the Settings app).
** Swipe left or right to switch layouts.
** Swipe up to shift.
** Swipe down to close the keyboard.
* Theme support (comes with a few built-in skins, and more available in Play Store).
* Night Mode: Quiet, Dark keyboard at night time (enable in the Settings app).
* Power-Saving Mode: No vibrations, sound, suggestions and a dark theme (enable in the Settings app).
* Build-in user dictionary words editor.
* Build-in abbreviations dictionary: create shortcuts for words and sentences.
* Utility keyboard (swipe up from space-bar):
** Clipboard actions copy, paste, select-all, select selectively (long-press select and use arrow keys).
** Voice input
** Arrows
* And many more features!
Support at: https://github.com/AnySoftKeyboard

fdroid:com.quantum_prof.vtscansuite.name: Veto
fdroid:com.quantum_prof.vtscansuite.summary: Open source, native VirusTotal client. Scan files, links and apps in style.
fdroid:com.quantum_prof.vtscansuite.description:
Veto is a sleek, open source VirusTotal client for Android. It turns the full VirusTotal service into a fast, native app: submit a file, a link, or one of your installed apps, watch the analysis happen in real time, and read a clear report that goes from a single verdict down to every field the service returns.
Veto is free and open source. It has no accounts of its own, no tracking, and no advertising. You bring your own free VirusTotal API key, so every scan runs under your own account and nothing is routed through a third party.
BEAUTIFULLY NATIVE
A modern Material 3 interface that follows your system colours, with polished light and dark themes, smooth motion, and thoughtful haptics.
TWO WAYS TO READ A REPORT
Quick mode gives you an at a glance summary: the verdict, the detection breakdown, the threat classification, key details, and the engines that flagged the item. Detailed mode adds everything else, including hashes, history and community votes, sandbox behaviour, YARA matches, Android app internals, and an Additional data section that surfaces every remaining field the service sends back.
BUILT TO BE UNDERSTOOD
Every section carries a short, plain language help note that explains what it means. You can switch the notes off in settings once you know your way around.
MADE FOR EVERYDAY USE
Aggregated results from more than 70 engines. Uploads and analysis show real progress, and scans keep running in the background, so you can leave the app and get a notification the moment the result is ready. Save any report to open it again later, even offline. If you reach the free VirusTotal rate limit, Veto tells you clearly.
OPEN SOURCE
The full source code is available, so anyone can inspect, build, and contribute.
Veto is not affiliated with or endorsed by VirusTotal.

fdroid:com.tvlauncher.name: TV Launcher
fdroid:com.tvlauncher.summary: Lightweight, low-RAM Android TV home launcher
fdroid:com.tvlauncher.description:

Features:

* App search and filter chips (All / Selected / Shortcuts) when picking apps

The build on F-Droid does not include the self-update feature; updates are delivered through F-Droid.

fdroid:com.yozachar.apps.soundcraftmixer.name: Mixer Controller
fdroid:com.yozachar.apps.soundcraftmixer.summary: Access digital audio mixer's via WebUI.
fdroid:com.yozachar.apps.soundcraftmixer.description:
Connect your phone's WiFi to the digital mixer. Launch this app, it should
automatically detect your IP network. Enter the MixerID, which we define as the

fdroid:de.bernd.bikalo.name: Bibel-Kapitel-Losung
fdroid:de.bernd.bikalo.summary: Draws randomly a bible chapter by touching a button
fdroid:de.bernd.bikalo.description:
Hint: This is a German app, but because your device locale is not German, you get its description in English here:
Being close to God is the desire of many people. Reading in His Word is a particularly suitable possibility for it. For some time, there have also been practical apps with various Bible translations for reading and studying, reading schedules, prayers and much more.
An old custom is the so-called “Bibelstechen” (Bible drawing), in which the Bible is simply opened and a verse or chapter is read at the Bible passage that has been struck in this way.
This app is designed to offer a practical alternative for this kind of Bible drawing:
If you touch onto the "Touch me" button, a book with chapter indication appears.
To read this drawn Bible chapter you can use a Bible app of your choice or read it in your paper Bible.
The "Bibel-Kapitel-Losung" (Bible chapter drawing) app is costless and advertising-free, it does not require access rights, works offline, does not require registration and can be used as often as desired.
German app, English version soon.

fdroid:de.rwth_aachen.phyphox.name: phyphox
fdroid:de.rwth_aachen.phyphox.summary: Perform physics experiments with your phone. (by the RWTH Aachen University)
fdroid:de.rwth_aachen.phyphox.description:
Did you know that you are carrying a 3D magnetometer? That you can use your phone as a pendulum to measure earth's local gravitational acceleration? That you can turn your phone into a sonar?
phyphox gives you access to the sensors of your phone either directly or through ready-to-play experiments which analyze your data and let you export raw data along with the results for further analysis. You can even define your own experiments on phyphox.org and share them with colleagues, students and friends.
Selected Features:
• A selection of pre-defined experiments. Just press play to start.
• Export your data to a range of widely used formats
• Remote-control your experiment through a web interface from any PC on the same network as your phone. No need to install anything on those PCs - all you need is a modern web browser.
• Define your own experiments by selecting sensor inputs, defining analysis steps and creating views as an interface using our web-editor ( http://phyphox.org/editor ). The analysis consists of just adding two values or using advanced methods like Fourier transforms and crosscorrelation. We offer a whole toolbox of analysis functions.
Sensors supported:
• Accelerometer
• Magnetometer
• Gyroscope
• Light intensity
• Pressure
• Microphone
• Proximity
• GPS
• Camera
• LiDAR/ToF
*some sensors are not present on every phone.
Export formats
• CSV (Comma separated values)
• TSV (Tab-separated values)
• Excel
(if you need other formats, please let us know)
This app has been developed at the 2nd Institute of Physics A at the RWTH Aachen University.

fdroid:helium314.keyboard.name: HeliBoard
fdroid:helium314.keyboard.description:
HeliBoard is a privacy-conscious open-source keyboard, based on AOSP / OpenBoard.
Does not use internet permission, and thus is 100% offline.
Features:
 Add dictionaries for suggestions and spell check

 note that for Korean layouts, suggestions only work using this dictionary , the tools in the dictionary repository are not able to create working dictionaries
 Customize keyboard themes (style, colors and background image)
 can follow the system's day/night setting on Android 10+ (and on some versions of Android 9)
 can follow dynamic colors for Android 12+
 Customize keyboard layouts (only available when disabling use system languages )
 Customize special layouts, like symbols, number, or functional key layout
 Multilingual typing
 Glide typing ( only with closed source library ☹️)

fdroid:io.github.hddq.restoid.name: Restoid - Backup Tool
fdroid:io.github.hddq.restoid.summary: Secure, deduplicated backup for apps and files powered by the restic engine.
fdroid:io.github.hddq.restoid.description:
Restoid is a modern, privacy-focused backup solution for Android powered by the robust, open-source restic engine. Keep your apps, data, photos, and documents safe with enterprise-grade encryption and lightning-fast, space-saving deduplication.
Whether you want to back up photos to a home NAS, store encrypted snapshots in the cloud, or preserve full app data on a rooted device, Restoid gives you complete control without trackers, ads, or proprietary lock-in.
Root access is completely optional: back up custom folders, photos, and documents without root; root access is only needed to back up private app data.
Key Features:
Blazing Fast & Deduplicated
• Content-Defined Deduplication: Only unique changed blocks are uploaded, making subsequent backups blazingly fast and drastically more efficient than traditional tar.gz archives.
• Space-Saving: Multiple snapshots share common data, keeping storage footprints minimal.
Zero-Knowledge Encryption
• Enterprise security: All snapshots are encrypted with restic using state-of-the-art cryptography.
• Your passwords and encryption keys remain entirely under your control.
Flexible Storage Backends
• Local Storage: Save to internal memory, SD card, or USB OTG drives.
• Network & Cloud: Native support for SFTP (SSH key & password), REST server, and Amazon S3-compatible object storage (Garage, MinIO, Wasabi, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2).
Full App & Data Backup (Root Required)
• Selectively back up installed user applications.
• Granular control: Choose whether to include APKs, app data, device-protected data, external files, or OBB caches.
Custom Files & Media
• Back up personal folders: DCIM, Documents, Downloads, or any directory on your device.
Automated Background Schedules
• Configure recurring schedules (daily, weekly, or custom intervals).
• Smart trigger constraints: Run only while charging, on unmetered Wi-Fi, or when battery conditions are met.
Surgical & Safe Restore
• Restore entire apps or specific parts (e.g. restore data without overwriting the installed APK).
• Downgrade protection prevents accidental restoration of older versions over newer ones.
Zero Vendor Lock-in
• Standard restic format: Repositories use the native, open-source restic format. You can always access, inspect, mount, or restore your data on any PC (Linux, macOS, Windows) using the official restic CLI—even without your phone.
Maintenance & Repository Health
• Keep your repository compact with automated snapshot retention policies (prune old backups by day, week, month).
• Run repository integrity checks and clear stale locks with one tap.
Modern Material 3 Expressive UI
• Built with modern Jetpack Compose and Material 3 Expressive design, featuring dynamic theming, smooth animations, and edge-to-edge layout.
• 100% Free and Open Source (GPLv3), with zero analytics, telemetry, or third-party tracking.

fdroid:net.meshsat.android.name: MeshSat
fdroid:net.meshsat.android.summary: Mesh, satellite and SMS messaging through one phone and a MeshSat node
fdroid:net.meshsat.android.description:
MeshSat turns an Android phone into a MeshSat gateway. Pair it with a MeshSat node, a pocket-sized box with a Meshtastic LoRa radio and a RockBLOCK 9603 Iridium modem, and one phone can send and receive over the mesh, by satellite and by SMS. It keeps working when the mobile network and the internet are gone. It also works with any plain Meshtastic radio, for the mesh only.
Status: pre-release. This is a prototype under active development. It has never been deployed to a real user and has never been used in an actual emergency. Do not rely on it for your safety.
What it does:
• Mesh: Meshtastic over Bluetooth LE with the official protobufs: text, positions, telemetry, waypoints, node info and traceroute. A reply to a node goes to that node, not to the whole channel.
• Satellite: Iridium SBD through the node's RockBLOCK 9603, up to 340 bytes out and 270 bytes in. Messages wait in a queue and are retried until they go out. The app opens a satellite session only when there is something to send, when the modem rings or when you check the mailbox, never on a timer, because every session costs a credit. Passes are predicted on the phone, with no internet needed.
• SMS through the phone's own SIM, optionally encrypted per conversation with AES-256-GCM. Messages are compressed with MSVQ-SC, which is lossy: what arrives means the same, but may not be word for word what was sent.
• APRS through a KISS TNC over TCP (Direwolf, for example) or directly to APRS-IS.
• Hub, optional: the phone reports to a MeshSat Hub over MQTT with a client certificate and takes remote commands. The Hub is open source and can be self-hosted.
• TAK, through the Hub: your team's TAK picture appears on the map, and with Enable TAK on the phone sends its position, an SOS and its chat to your TAK server.
• Reticulum: the phone runs as a Reticulum transport node and relays between its links. A message to a Reticulum contact can carry a voice note, or a photo picked from your gallery; both travel on a Reticulum link only.
• Safety: hold the SOS button for 3 seconds and the SOS goes out on every route the phone has, each retried until it is sent, until you cancel it. A check-in timer and zones drawn on the map.
• The map works offline down to country level. Night mode turns the whole app red.
Satellite messaging needs a RockBLOCK modem and Iridium credits from a provider; Iridium is a paid commercial network.
Internet connections: the bundled world map covers country level; closer in, map tiles come from OpenStreetMap's tile servers while you look at the map online. Once a satellite modem is set up (the MeshSat node's modem seen, or a RockBLOCK 9704 connected), Iridium orbit data is downloaded from celestrak.org, or tle.ivanstanojevic.me if that fails, when the stored copy is more than a day old, checked at most every 12 hours; before that only when you tap Update on the passes screen. The Hub, APRS-IS and Reticulum over TCP connect only when you set them up, and a field kit you add under Setup is reached at the address you give it, or through the Hub relay. A voice note's transcript, offered for routes that carry text only, comes from the phone's own speech recogniser, which may use its maker's servers; MeshSat itself sends the recording nowhere but to the contact. Node firmware is downloaded from MeshSat's releases on github.com only when you tap Check for update. Nothing else goes online.
Permissions: Bluetooth and location, because Android needs location to scan for Bluetooth devices and the map shows where you are; SMS, to send and receive through your SIM; the microphone, only while you hold the voice note button; notifications. Starting after a phone restart is off until you switch it on.
Documentation, and a table of what has and has not been verified: https://docs.meshsat.net/android/

fdroid:org.vi_server.androidudpbus.name: UDP Bus
fdroid:org.vi_server.androidudpbus.description:
android-udp-bus is an application to create UDP forwarders, hubs and other tools. To aid building VPNs, video streaming and other tricky network uses.
 Features: 
* Binding UDP socket on specified port and exchanging traffic between all known peers
* Exchanging traffic between multiple UDP sockets
* Remembering specified number of peers that have sent us some datagram, with optional expiration policy
* Directly specifying peers to send datagrams to. Combined with remembering, it allows using the application as UDP forwarder.
* Joining multicast groups, setting TTL, TOS, read and write buffer sizes and other socket options.
* Periodical sending of hardcoded datagrams to specified peers (e.g. to keep NAT open)
* Displaying of detailed statistics of the traffic
* Starting multiple isolated hubs, each with distinct set of ports. Can even act as a simplistic load balancer due to SO_REUSEPORT .
The application does not send datagrams back to sender.
 Limitations: 
* UI is not user-friendly.
* Not all features are exposed in GUI - you may want to add some undocumented fields to the JSON manually.
* Not very optimised for speed or latency. It may be slightly slower than socat udp4-l udp.
* Not everything is tested yet
* Documentation is lacking

flathub:dev.bsnes.bsnes.name: bsnes
flathub:dev.bsnes.bsnes.description:
bsnes is a Super Nintendo (SNES) emulator focused on performance, features, and ease of use.
 Unique features of bsnes:
 True Super Game Boy emulation (using the SameBoy core by Lior Halphon)
 HD mode 7 graphics (by DerKoun) with optional supersampling
 Low-level emulation of all SNES coprocessors
 Multi-threaded PPU graphics renderer
 Speed mode settings which retain smooth audio output
 Built-in games database with over 1,200 game entries
 Built-in cheat code database (by mightymo) with hundreds of game entries
 Built-in save state manager with screenshot previews and naming capabilities
 Customizable game mappings to support any game cartridges, including prototypes
 7-zip decompression support
 Extensive Satellaview emulation, including BS Memory flash write and wear-leveling support
 Optional higan game folder support (standard game ROM files are also supported!)
 Advanced mapping system allowing multiple bindings to every emulated input
 Standard features of bsnes:
 MSU1 support
 BPS and IPS soft-patching support
 Save states with undo and redo support (for reverting accidental saves and loads)
 OpenGL multi-pass pixel shaders
 Several built-in software filters, including HQ2x (by MaxSt) and snes_ntsc (by blargg)
 Adaptive sync and dynamic rate control for perfect audio/video synchronization
 Just-in-time input polling for minimal input latency
 Run-ahead support for removing internal game engine input latency
 Support for Direct3D exclusive mode video
 Support for WASAPI and ASIO exclusive mode audio
 Periodic auto-saving of game saves
 Auto-saves of states when unloading games, and auto-resuming when reloading games
 Sprite limit disable support
 Cubic audio interpolation support
 Deinterlacing support
 Optional high-level emulation of most SNES coprocessors
 Optional emulation of flaws in older emulators for compatibility with older, unofficial software
 CPU, SA1, and SuperFX overclocking support
 Frame advance support
 Cheat code search support
 Movie recording and playback support
 Rewind support
 HiDPI monitor support
 Multi-monitor support
 Turbo support for controller inputs

flathub:fr.nytuo.cosmiccomics.name: Cosmic Comics
flathub:fr.nytuo.cosmiccomics.summary: Read Comics, Manga and Ebooks the easy way
flathub:fr.nytuo.cosmiccomics.description:
Cosmic Comics offers a user-friendly interface that makes it easy to browse the collection of comics, manga and ebooks. It supports different file formats, offers adaptive page layout, favorite page marking, advanced search and library management.
 What Cosmic Comics can do:
 Read a wide range of formats: CBR, CBZ, CB7, CBT, ZIP, RAR, 7z and TAR archives, PDF and EPUB documents, and folders of PNG, JPG, JPEG or BMP images
 Browse your collection by series and books, with covers fetched from APIs, extracted from files or set manually
 Track your reading progress: mark books as read, unread or reading, add them to favorites and rate them
 Powerful viewer options: zoom, auto background color, double page mode, blank first page, manga mode, webtoon mode, fullscreen, rotations, bookmarks, slideshow, sidebar and magnifier
 Rich metadata about your comics, manga and ebooks
 Downloaders for Marvel Unlimited, MangaDex, DC Infinite, Viz and GetComics (some require a subscription)
 Library metadata from Google Books, AniList, Metron, Open Library or manual entry
 Continue reading right where you left off

flathub:org.synfig.SynfigStudio.description:
Synfig Studio is a free and open-source 2D animation software, designed as powerful industrial-strength solution for creating film-quality animation using a vector and bitmap artwork. It eliminates the need to create animation frame-by frame, allowing you to produce 2D animation of a higher quality with fewer people and resources.
 Features:
 Can manipulate vector and bitmap artwork
 Automatic tweening (independent from FPS)
 Multitude of layers of various types (geometry primitives, shapes, gradients, fratals)
 Full-featured bone system
 Filters and effects for compositing (blurs, distortions, color manipulation, masks)
 All color operations use High Dynamic-Range Imaging (HDRI)
 Pentablet-friendly tools
 Sound support
 Linking data on file or parameter-level
 Automatic animation using mathematical functions

gnome-extensions:weatherglass@vijaybala..name: Weatherglass
gnome-extensions:weatherglass@vijaybala..summary:
Weather that lives in your top bar.
The panel icon animates with the sky outside - sun, drifting clouds, rain, snow, thunderstorms - beside a live temperature. Open the menu and the whole card is the sky: a live animated backdrop of drifting clouds, twinkling stars and falling precipitation, painted frame by frame.
What's inside:
* Animated menu backdrop with eleven scenes, from clear sun and moon to fog, sleet, hail and lightning
* Hourly chart: switch between temperature, precipitation or wind
* The moon carries the real lunar phase at night; sunrise and sunset bathe the card in golden-hour light
* Eight days of forecast tiles, current conditions at a glance
* Official weather advisories where a public source covers your location (US, Canada, Norway, most of Europe)
* 21 languages with full bidirectional support: the entire card mirrors in Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu
* Metric or imperial units, 12- or 24-hour clock, live scene previews in preferences
* Three backdrop styles: animated sky, solid, or theme background with accent charts
Weather data from Open-Meteo (global), Met.no (ECMWF) and NOAA NWS - choose your favourite forecaster, no API keys needed. Location: detected automatically through GNOME's own location service (IP lookup where none is available), or a city you pick.
No accounts, no tracking, no analytics: weather requests go straight from your machine to the provider you choose. Official weather advisories are fetched for your location from the responsible public services (NOAA NWS, Met.no, Environment Canada or MeteoAlarm) - also keyless and direct. Automatic detection prefers the system location service, with the standard GNOME prompt naming this extension; its IP-lookup and city-label fallbacks each contact one free keyless endpoint and are used only when needed. Nothing is cached on disk.
Demo: https://github.com/vijaybala-lang/weatherglass/releases/download/v8/weatherglass-demo-card.mp4

fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.name: catharsis-cormorant-garamond-fonts
fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.summary: Cormorant Garamond, a variant with more traditional shapes
fedora-packages:catharsis-cormorant-font.description: Cormorant is an original design for an extravagant display serif font family inspired by the Garamond heritage, hand-drawn and produced by Catharsis Fonts. While traditional Garamond cuts make for exquisite reading at book sizes, they appear clumpy and inelegant at larger sizes. The design goal of Cormorant was to distill the aesthetic essence of Garamond, unfetter it from the limitations of metal printing, and allow it to bloom into its natural refined form at high definition. Cormorant is characterized by scandalously small counters, razor-sharp serifs, dangerously smooth curves, and flamboyantly tall accents. While many implementations of Garamond at small optical sizes already exist (including the open-sourced EB Garamond by Georg Duffner), Cormorant aims for the sparsely populated niche of display-size counterparts that exploit the high resolution of contemporary screens and print media to the fullest. Cormorant is made for large sizes; the larger, the better. However, it works well as a text face in high-resolution environments. Cormorant is a native 21st-century typeface making ample use of OpenType technology. Some OpenType features are applied automatically while you type, subtly improving the flow of the text. This includes kerning, standard ligatures, and contextual alternates. Other features are intended to be activated manually by the user, such as discretionary ligatures, stylistic alternates, small capitals, and alternate figure sets. While Cormorant’s quality is most evident in titling and poster usage at the largest sizes, its Garamond genome renders it highly legible down to text sizes on high-resolution devices and in print. This is particularly true about the “Cormorant Garamond” cuts of the typeface. Cormorant Garamond offers larger counters and subtly more traditional Garamond shapes for a few key characters to achieve more reading comfort.

fedora-packages:drat2er/drat2er.name: drat2er
fedora-packages:drat2er/drat2er.description: Drat2er is a tool for transforming proofs that are usually produced by SAT solvers. It takes as input a propositional formula (specified in the DIMACS format) together with a DRAT proof (DRAT is the current standard format for proofs in SAT solving), and outputs an extended-resolution proof of the formula in either the TRACECHECK or the DRAT format. The details of this proof transformation are described in the paper "Extended Resolution Simulates DRAT" (IJCAR 2018). Note that if drat2er is given as input a DRUP proof, then it transforms this DRUP proof into an ordinary resolution proof.

Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains a library that allows recursive child and sibling iteration with filtering, recursion and item mapping provided by downstream users.

fedora-packages:frugally-deep/frugally-d.summary: Header-only library for using Keras (TensorFlow) models in C++
fedora-packages:frugally-deep/frugally-d.description: Would you like to build/train a model using Keras/Python? And would you like to run the prediction (forward pass) on your model in C++ without linking your application against TensorFlow? Then frugally-deep is exactly for you. frugally-deep * is a small header-only library written in modern and pure C++. * is very easy to integrate and use. * depends only on FunctionalPlus, Eigen and json - also header-only libraries. * supports inference (model.predict) not only for sequential models but also for computational graphs with a more complex topology, created with the functional API. * re-implements a (small) subset of TensorFlow, i.e., the operations needed to support prediction. * results in a much smaller binary size than linking against TensorFlow. * works out-of-the-box also when compiled into a 32-bit executable. (Of course, 64 bit is fine too.) * avoids temporarily allocating (potentially large chunks of) additional RAM during convolutions (by not materializing the im2col input matrix). * utterly ignores even the most powerful GPU in your system and uses only one CPU core per prediction. ;-) * but is quite fast on one CPU core, and you can run multiple predictions in parallel, thus utilizing as many CPUs as you like to improve the overall prediction throughput of your application/pipeline.

firefox-addons:3000552.name: MAXSEC Privacy Layer
firefox-addons:3000552.summary: Optional in-chat encryption layer for MAX web client without backend dependencies.
firefox-addons:3000552.description:
MAXSEC — приватный режим для MAX Web
Короткое описание (до ~132 символов)
MAXSEC добавляет локальное шифрование в веб-чат MAX: режимы OFF/READ/SECURE, ручная проверка ключей, без собственного сервера.
Полное описание
MAXSEC — это браузерное расширение для web.max.ru , которое добавляет поверх обычного чата опциональный приватный режим обмена сообщениями.
Что умеет
 Режимы работы:
 OFF — без шифрования и расшифровки
 READ — только расшифровка входящих
 SECURE — шифрование исходящих + расшифровка входящих
 Плавающая панель в чате: текущий режим, fingerprint, статус верификации, кнопка Verify
 Ручная crypto-панель для тестов: Encrypt/Decrypt/Copy без зависимости от DOM мессенджера
 Работа через обычные сообщения чата (in-band), без собственного backend
Важные принципы
 Шифрование выполняется только на клиенте (в вашем браузере). 
 Расширение не отправляет ваши ключи на наши серверы (у нас нет сервера для ключей/сообщений).
 Ключи и настройки хранятся локально в storage браузера.
Для кого
 Для пользователей, которым нужен дополнительный приватный слой в веб-версии MAX
 Для команд/тестировщиков, которые хотят валидировать сценарии шифрования до production-интеграции
Ограничения
 Расширение зависит от структуры DOM веб-клиента MAX; при крупных обновлениях интерфейса может потребоваться обновление расширения.
 При ошибках парсинга/шифрования расширение переключается в безопасный fallback и не должно блокировать обычные сообщения.

firefox-addons:2856072.name: IPVanish Secure Browser
firefox-addons:2856072.summary: Erleben Sie einzigartigen Online-Schutz mit unserem IPVanish Secure Browser. Sie sind vor den alltäglichen Online-Bedrohungen geschützt, da keine Aktivität auf Ihrem Gerät stattfindet.
firefox-addons:2856072.description:
Der IPVanish Secure Browser wurde entwickelt, um ein sicheres und anonymes Surfen im Internet zu ermöglichen. Ob beim Arbeiten, Einkaufen oder Streamen – unser Firefox Add-on bietet eine Reihe von Funktionen, die Ihre Online-Aktivitäten verbessern und Sie bei der Nutzung des Internets schützen.
 So funktioniert es 
Wenn Sie das IPVanish Secure Browser Add-on für Firefox verwenden, öffnet IPVanish auf unseren Servern in der Cloud ein virtuelles Browserfenster speziell für Sie. Sie greifen über einen interaktiven Video-Feed von Ihrem normalen Firefox-Browser auf diesen virtuellen Browser zu. Alles, was Sie auf Ihrem Gerät tippen, klicken, scrollen und kopieren/einfügen, wird in den Browser der IPVanish-Cloud kopiert.
Da Ihre Suchanfragen und Klicks remote repliziert werden, findet keine Aktivität auf Ihrem Gerät statt. So wird Ihr Gerät vor allen Arten von Bedrohungen geschützt, einschließlich bösartiger Links, Malware, Tracking und vielem mehr. Darüber hinaus werden bei der Verwendung von Secure Browser weder der Verlauf des Browsers noch Cookies oder Daten über die Website auf Ihrem Gerät gespeichert. Diese Funktion ist dem privaten Browsing-Modus ähnlich, der IPVanish Secure Browser bietet jedoch weitaus mehr. Im Unterschied zum privaten Browsing-Modus können Dritte nicht sehen, welche Websites Sie besuchen, Werbetreibende können Ihre IP-Adresse oder Geräteinformationen nicht über Fingerprinting zurückverfolgen, und es kann keine Malware auf Ihr Gerät heruntergeladen werden.
 Wesentliche Funktionen: 
● Virus Protection: Es findet keine Aktivität auf Ihrem Rechner statt, so dass ein Klicken auf schädliche Links oder heruntergeladene Viren Ihr Gerät nicht beeinträchtigen. Stattdessen wird dies vor der Quarantäne und Löschung nur auf den Cloud-Server heruntergeladen. 
● Automatisches Entfernen des Browserverlaufs: Ihr Browserverlauf wird weder auf Ihrem noch auf unserem lokalen Gerät gespeichert. Beim Schließen des Secure Browser-Fensters werden alle Informationen der Sitzung sofort von unserem Server gelöscht. 
● Verhinderung von digitalem Fingerprinting: Websites und Werbetreibende tracken Nutzer mithilfe von digitalem Fingerprinting und sammeln Daten wie Gerätetyp, Betriebssystemversion, Browserversion und mehr. Mit dem Secure Browser können Sie über einen interaktiven Videostream auf Websites zugreifen, ohne dass Ihre persönlichen Daten sichtbar werden. Sofern Sie sich nicht bei Diensten anmelden, können Ihre Aktivitäten nicht zurückverfolgt werden.
● Schutz vor DNS-Cache-Schnüffeln: DNS-Daten aus jeder Browsersitzung werden sofort gelöscht, nachdem Sie ein sicheres Browserfenster geschlossen haben. Dadurch wird sichergestellt, dass keine Restdaten in Ihrem Cache verbleiben, die Ihre Browseraktivitäten an Tracker oder Dritte weitergeben könnten.
● Zehn verschiedene Standorte: Derzeit bieten wir zehn virtuelle Standorte an, darunter in den USA, in Kanada, im Vereinigten Königreich, in Australien und an verschiedenen Orten in Europa. Wählen Sie den Ort aus, an dem sich Ihr Secure Browser-Cloudfenster öffnet. So können Sie sicher im Internet surfen.
● Benutzerfreundlich: Mit unserer intuitiven und benutzerfreundlichen Erweiterung können Sie ganz einfach im Internet surfen. Installieren Sie einfach die Erweiterung und klicken Sie auf das IPVanish Secure Browser-Symbol, um sie zu aktivieren.
 Erste Schritte: 
1. Installieren Sie das Add-on: von der Firefox Add-ons-Website in Ihren Firefox-Browser.
2. Klicken Sie auf das Symbol: Um den IPVanish Secure Browser zu aktivieren, klicken Sie einfach auf das entsprechende Symbol. 
3. Genießen Sie sicheres Surfen: Erleben Sie die vielen Vorteile und die Sicherheit, die Ihnen der Secure Browser bietet.
Bitte beachten Sie: Damit IPVanish Secure Browser den interaktiven Video-Feed von Secure Browser ausführen und die Funktion Kopieren & Einfügen bereitstellen kann, müssen wir Ihren Browser um die Erlaubnis für Folgendes bitten: „ Lesen und Ändern aller Daten auf allen Websites “ sowie „ Ändern von Daten, die Sie kopieren und einfügen. “ Daher werden Sie bei der Installation des Dienstes in Ihren Browsern die oben genannten Anfragen sehen. Seien Sie versichert, dass bei der Verwendung des IPVanish Secure Browsers keine Browserverlaufsdaten, Cookies oder Websitedaten gespeichert werden; Sie werden weder von uns noch von Dritten getrackt.
 Laden Sie das IPVanish Secure Browser Add-on noch heute herunter 
Übernehmen Sie die Kontrolle über Ihre Sicherheit und Anonymität im Internet mit dem IPVanish Secure Browser Add-on. Mit Funktionen, die darauf ausgelegt sind, Ihre Daten zu schützen und die Anonymität Ihres Surferlebnisses zu gewährleisten, war es noch nie so einfach, sich im Internet zu schützen. Laden Sie das Add-on noch heute herunter und erleben Sie sicheres Surfen im Internet.

🚀 Melv For Manga — Read any raw manga, manhwa, or manhua in your language instantly for FREE!

🎨 Seamless Text Overlay: Replaces original Japanese/Korean/Chinese text neatly inside speech bubbles without ruining the original art.
📱 Cross-Platform: Fully compatible with Firefox for Desktop and Firefox for Android!
⚙ Customizable Settings: Easily change font size, translation mode, and target language from a clean Popup UI.
📖 How to Use:
Install the extension and open any website containing raw manga chapters.
Right-click on any image or panel you want to read.
Click "Translate Image" from the context menu and enjoy reading!
🔑 How the Free Access System Works (Monetization & Daily Pass):
To keep the high-performance AI translation servers 100% FREE for everyone without charging subscription fees, we use a simple 24-Hour Daily Activation Pass:
No Registration Required: The extension automatically assigns a unique, anonymous Device ID (no personal data is ever collected).
24-Hour Free Pass: Click the "Activate" button in the popup to complete a quick short-link verification (via LinkJust).
Enjoy Unlimited Translation: Once completed, your device unlocks unlimited translations for 24 full hours!
When your pass expires, simply renew it for another 24 hours in a few seconds to keep using the service for free forever.
🛡 Privacy & Security:
We do NOT collect or track your browsing history or personal information.
Images sent for translation are processed instantly by our server and are never stored or shared.

firefox-addons:742289.name: Custom New Tab Page
firefox-addons:742289.summary: Specify a custom URL to be shown when opening a new tab, **without changing the address bar content**.
firefox-addons:742289.description:
*** Please read the permissions and caveats sections below before leaving a negative review! *** 
The existing add-ons I found for replacing the new tab URL emulate the ` browser.newtab.url ` functionality of Firefox <41 that change the address bar to a specific URL.
This add-on lets you set a custom URL without changing the address bar content so the cursor remains focused in the address bar and you can just start typing to search or navigate to a different URL.
 Instructions 
To set your custom new tab URL after installing the extension:
 Open `Add-ons` from the `Menu (☰)` (or navigate to `about:addons` with the address bar)
 Select `Extensions`
 Select the `Custom New Tab Page` extension → `Options`
 Enter your URL in the `New Tab URL` box
 Press `Save`
 Done!
 Permissions 
Please note the "Access your data for all websites" permission is completely optional and only required if you enable advanced options.
Even when advanced options are enabled, the add-on will only ask to access data for the site configured as your new tab page.
Core functionality of this add-on will work without granting any extra permissions.
 Caveats 
 Only http:// and https:// URLs are currently supported. Due to security restrictions imposed by Mozilla, local file:// URLs will NOT work. 
 Links on the site you choose will open in the iframe ( issue #1 ). If you control the site add target="_top" to the links to make them open in the top frame. 
 If you're looking for a new new-tab page then check out my site Zen .

bluejetty:00070917:ios.description:
myFitnessSync - Apple Health to Fitbit uploads your Apple Health data from the Apple Health app and stores it in your Fitbit account. After syncing, you can view your fitness data on the Fitbit app or Fitbit.com
▶ Sync up to 5 fields:
- Steps
- Weight
- Body Fat Percentage
- Sleep Analysis
- Water
▶ Auto-Sync
- Manually sync the app or let auto-sync automatically keep your data up to date
▶ WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
***** "I like using the Fitbit app to view all my fitness data like steps and weight, but I track my steps with my iPhone and Apple Watch. Syncs all my steps and weight data from Apple Health to my Fitbit account"
***** "I work for a large company that partners with WebMD and other resources to help encourage us to stay healthy. I’ve been searching for an app that would let me do exactly what this does."
***** "This app is really easy to use. My steps sync automatically from my Apple Watch to my Fitbit app every day like clockwork. It took maybe 5 minutes to set it up and I haven't had to touch it since."
! IMPORTANT NOTES !
* Unfortunately, Fitbit doesn't allow third-party apps or devices to compete in step challenges or share steps with community members (friends). BUT you can still share your Fitbit dashboard with Fitbit friends and other friends and family using the share option on your dashboard
* Fitbit will overwrite the last 30 days of step, weight, and BMI data in your Fitbit account when using this app for the first time
* Auto-sync may take a few days to work, as iOS controls this process based on user behavior. For privacy reasons, iOS will not run an auto-sync if your phone is locked - this can cause auto-sync delays
* Fitbit will not merge existing steps in your account with steps from our app. If you have step data in your Fitbit account in the last 30 days it will be overwritten with the step data in Apple Health
* App syncs up to 30 days of historical data
▶ Syncing your Apple Health app everyday with myFitnessSync - Health to Fitbit for iPhone allows you to use the Fitbit app and Fitbit.com dashboard to view your fitness data. Select from multiple data sources like your iPhone, Apple Watch, Withings scale/Health Mate, running and walking apps, and other devices that sync with your iPhone and Apple Health
We want to hear from you! We can't help through reviews - if you encounter any issues or would like to request a new feature please email support@bickster.com or click the "App Support" button in the App Store.

Data is synced in 3 easy steps:
1. Sign in to Fitbit
2. Pick the fitness fields (Steps, Weight, Bodyfat) you want to sync with your Fitbit account.
3. Click the "Sync Now" button to start syncing your Apple Health data with your Fitbit account

bluejetty:00031299:ios.description:
Know your mile marker location! Use Mile-1 to help emergency personnel or roadside assistance locate you faster. 
Mile-1 provides you with the most comprehensive and accurate highway milepost locator service ever built. Easy to use day or night, quickly find and share your real-time mile marker. Nearly every highway with markers in the U.S. is included, along with a growing list of river miles and railroad mileposts. Even if you lose your data connection, Mile-1 will still show your milepost.
"Hey Siri, Get my milepost in Mile-1." Just ask Siri to get your current milepost. Check out our CarPlay app and CarPlay widgets too. Real-time mile marker locations right on your dashboard.
Need directions or distance? Tap any milepost. The navigation button will use Maps to show you the fastest route to get there. Perfect for towing and roadside assistance.
Click the share button to send your current location via messages, email, or your favorite app. 
Closures, construction, and incidents are often reported using mileposts as a reference. Mile markers function like an address on the highway. Quickly and easily search for these locations. It's the perfect companion for incident reporting and maintenance.
Mile-1 Pro includes:
 Unlimited search and navigation
 Unlimited custom marker points
 Mile marker point manager - Save money by reducing location uncertainty and field documentation
 Mile marker map maker - Create custom maps with mile marker references. It's great for crash reporting on your socials or construction maps.
 Auto-tag and markup photos with accurate mile markers and timestamps
 Convert Latitude/Longitude to mile marker location 
These are just some sample headlines we see every day, but it's not so easy to locate exactly where these are. Mile-1 helps save the day!
AZDOT, "State Troopers and emergency crews use mile markers to locate stranded drivers or those involved in crashes...emergency crews will be able to find you faster."
KEZI, "Evacuation levels reduced for homes near Milepost 97 fire."
NewsChannel20, "Illinois State Troopers and first responders were called to a crash on I-57 northbound near milepost 241 Wednesday afternoon."
KqenNewsRadio, "I-5 Milepost 114 fire burns Tuesday night."
National Park Service, "Detour implemented from Milepost 115 to 135 starting January 25, 2021."

Your Digital Bank. 
Our digital banking services give you more control and a better experience. 
At First Farmers, we recognize that our customers are busy - growing businesses, raising families, running the farm. Your time is valuable. That's why we're determined to offer the best and most convenient digital tools so that you're able to take care of your finances and then get back to living, on your terms. We’ve upgraded our online and mobile banking platform to better meet the growing technological needs of our communities and customers. 
Improved User Experience - Enjoy the same digital experience whether banking on your computer, smartphone, or tablet, with the same tools and functionality across all of your devices. 
Personal Financial Management - This new personal banking feature lets you pull in external accounts from other financial institutions, showing your full financial picture in one platform. 
CardSwap - Isn't it frustrating when automatic payments are unexpectedly returned because of an updated card with a new expiration date? With CardSwap, you can swap out card information on subscription sites such as Amazon and Netflix (plus many more!) from within your digital banking platform. 
Enhanced Security - 2-factor authentication will be enabled to add an extra layer of protection beyond just a username and password. A Secure Access Code (SAC) will be sent to the phone number or email address that we have on file. Please note that First Farmers will NEVER contact you and ask you to verify your Secure Access Code (SAC). 
Other Available features include: 
Accounts: 
• Check your latest account balance and search recent transactions by date, amount, or check number. 
Transfers: 
• Easily transfer funds between your accounts. 
Bill Pay: 
• Make payments and view recent and scheduled payments. 
• Ability to add new payees, edit existing payees, or delete payees directly from the mobile app. 
Deposits: 
• Submit check deposits using your device’s camera. 
Locations: 
• Find nearby branches and ATMs. 
Fingerprint/Face Recognition: 
• Allows you to use a secure and more efficient sign-on experience using your fingerprint or facial recognition.

bluejetty:00061990:ios.description:
Home is a special place. It's a place to explore, to have adventures, and also the most common place for young children to get injured. We never know when an injury will happen. But most injuries are predictable and preventable. Worried that your baby will touch an electric socket? Afraid that your baby will open the door for strangers? Baby Panda Home Safety is here to solve your worries! 
Baby Panda Home Safety is an interactive toddler game allows young children to learn and play with much fun at the same time. We have included plenty of safety learning activities where toddlers and pre-k kids can learn lots of home safety knowledge in a fun and memorable way. Strangers knocking at the door, socket safety, problems with eating food, tidy bathrooms, broken stairs...All these potential safety problems and reaction tips are all in one app! Download Baby Panda Home Safety and start to learn home safety tips!
Features:
 9 major scenes along with fun of baby panda care! 
 Role-playing and safety knowledge make learning easy and happy!
 Voice guidance and easy-to-do controls allow safety learning to be simple and fast!
 Children's safety songs and entertaining animations strengthen safety knowledge!

At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own. 
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 250 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have produced more than 150 children's educational games, 700 children's songs, and animations of various themes spanning the arts, health, and science.

Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

bluejetty:00021988:ios.name: Terrier Transit
bluejetty:00021988:ios.summary:
Terrier Transit is your key to getting to, from, and around Boston University.
Transportation is an integral part of life at Boston University. Whether you ride the BU Shuttle (BUS), the T, MBTA buses, or a Bluebike, to reach classes, labs
bluejetty:00021988:ios.description:
Terrier Transit is your key to getting to, from, and around Boston University.
Transportation is an integral part of life at Boston University. Whether you ride the BU Shuttle (BUS), the T, MBTA buses, or a Bluebike, to reach classes, labs, dorms, or dining halls, getting the best urban mobility information is critical – from trips to between campuses or just up and down Commonwealth Avenue. Enter BU’s Terrier Transit app, powered by Moovit! Terrier Transit guides you from point A to B in the easiest and most efficient way. Get T and bus times, maps, and real-time arrival times with ease so you can plan your trip with confidence. Find critical alerts and service disruptions for your favorite lines, including the BUS. Get step-by-step directions of optimal route bus, train, metro, bike, scooter or a combination of them. 
Terrier Transit is your personal assistant for trips on-campus and off! 
► Real time arrivals. View real-time arrival updates, which are taken directly from GPS devices positioned on BU buses and MBTA buses and trains. Avoid wasting time guessing train times or bus times.
► Real time alerts. Know about issues ahead of time by receiving MBTA and BU service alerts such as emergency or unexpected disruptions, delays, traffic jams, new construction, and more so that you can plan ahead if your bus time or train time changed.
► Live Directions. Get step-by-step bus directions and other transit directions with live guidance from A-to-B: Know how long you need to walk to your station, view the arrival time of your line, receive get-off alerts at your destination, and more. 
► Users reports. Terrier Transit’s users report issues found with stations, line service, and schedules so that we can inform all nearby riders about what’s going on in their area.
► Favorite lines, stations, and places. Always going between Central Campus and BUMC? Get easy access to lines, stations, and places you ride and visit all the time. Plus, get real-time updates if/when there are changes to your favorite lines in case your bus time or train time is impacted!
► Bike routes. Get bike routes in addition to the bus, subway, train, or metro trip plans. If you ride bikes (yours or shared) we can plan a route that includes the train or bus. Terrier Transit will help you plan a trip that meets your transit-needs. Bluebikes station data is updated in real-time.
► Maps view. Interested in seeing the whole picture? View all stations, routes, and lines on the subway or bus map. Additionally, maps are available in PDF for when you’re offline, or underground on the subway. 
► International functionality. Terrier Transit isn’t just for getting around campus. It will also work for study abroad and trips home. The app can be used to navigate nearby buses and transit nationwide and across 98 other countries. If you’d like to know bus times and train times in London, Barcelona, Madrid, or Rome, or, if you need to find out when the last bus leaves a certain bus stop in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Melbourne, Seoul, Terrier Transit has you covered. You ride, we guide!
***
Have an idea or a question? Feel free to contact us: http://bu.edu/thebus

bluejetty:00044402:ios.name: Disney Magic Match 3D
bluejetty:00044402:ios.summary: Disney Magic Match 3D is a brand-new 3D matching game where you’ll solve captivating Disney puzzles by sorting and collecting iconic items from beloved Disney and Pixar movies including Moana, Aladdin and Toy Story. Dive into the enchanting
bluejetty:00044402:ios.description:
Disney Magic Match 3D is a brand-new 3D matching game where you’ll solve captivating Disney puzzles by sorting and collecting iconic items from beloved Disney and Pixar movies including Moana, Aladdin and Toy Story. Dive into the enchanting world of Disney Magic Match 3D, a captivating puzzle game adventure with beloved Disney treasures!
The ancient Disney Book of Magic, filled with iconic artifacts, has been opened, releasing a whirlwind of nostalgia. It’s your mission to return these cherished items to their rightful place by sorting and matching the pieces in magical puzzles in this relaxing sorting game. Disney Magic Match 3D blends sorting, collecting, and puzzle-solving gameplay.
DISCOVER ICONIC DISNEY 3D TREASURES!
Explore stunning 3D puzzles inspired by your favorite Disney films and discover a vast array of nostalgic items in this immersive puzzle game. From Mickey Mouse’s iconic gloves to Aladdin’s magic lamp or Toy Story’s classic Woody boots, each 3D piece is brimming with Disney charm.
Unlock new chapters in the magic book and uncover even more iconic Disney treasures in Enchanted Levels! Enchanted Levels include themed pieces from your favorite movies or nostalgic characters, making each level a fun Disney Magic Match experience with sorting and matching game play. Collect themed items from classic Disney characters like Mickey Mouse’s shoes, Minnie Mouse’s bow, and Donald Duck’s hat.
SORT AND MATCH IN ICONIC DISNEY PUZZLES!
Test your skills with a variety of engaging Disney puzzles in Disney Magic Match 3D, a relaxing matching game that will challenge your mind and appeal to nostalgia. Match and sort scattered Disney items, from Moana’s Heart of Te Fiti to a vast array of Disney princess dresses, in this satisfying sorting game.
By identifying and sorting scattered items, each completed match brings you closer to restoring order to the Disney universe. Feel the satisfaction of collecting and organizing treasures in Disney Magic Match 3D, a beautifully crafted puzzle game.
Download Disney Magic Match 3D and enjoy Disney Magic Match, a magical matching game, immersive puzzle game, and relaxing sorting game where you can collect and play with iconic Disney treasures in a stunning 3D world.

bluejetty:00046463:ios.name: Cora - Personal Fitness Coach
bluejetty:00046463:ios.summary:
Cora: Your Personal Fitness Coach
Cora is an AI fitness coach that builds personalized plans across training, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and healthy habits. Tell Cora your goals, schedule, current level, preferences, and limitations. C
bluejetty:00046463:ios.description:
Cora: Your Personal Fitness Coach
Cora is an AI fitness coach that builds personalized plans across training, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and healthy habits. Tell Cora your goals, schedule, current level, preferences, and limitations. Connect Apple Health so Cora can use your own data to make the guidance more relevant.
Cora keeps coaching after the plan is built. When your schedule, sleep, recovery, travel, or missed workouts change, Cora helps adjust what comes next.
Ask Cora to:
• Build a strength plan around three days in the gym
• Adjust this week after poor sleep or a missed workout
• Plan meals around your calorie, macro, and training targets
• Find a restaurant meal that fits your targets, then log it
• Explain changes in your sleep, recovery, strain, or fitness
• Help you build routines and stay consistent
TRAINING
Get strength and cardio plans based on your goals, current level, schedule, equipment, and recovery. Plan your week, follow each workout, log sets and reps, track muscle recovery, and see how your training changes over time.
NUTRITION
Set calorie, macro, and micronutrient targets. Log food by typing what you ate, scanning a barcode, or taking a photo. Ask Cora for a meal plan, recipe, breakfast idea, or restaurant option that fits what you have left.
SLEEP AND RECOVERY
See daily and weekly sleep insights, recovery, Body Charge, and strain in one place. Cora explains the numbers, connects them to your training, and helps you decide when to push or take it easier.
HEALTHY HABITS
Create routines, track streaks, and connect daily habits to the goals you care about.
CHAT WITH CORA ANYWHERE
Chat with Cora in the app or through iMessage to ask questions, log food, check your plan, and get coaching without changing your routine.
Connect Cora to supported AI assistants through Model Context Protocol (MCP). With your permission, you can check your stats and plans, ask Cora questions, log meals or workouts, and update your training plan from the AI apps you already use.
APPLE HEALTH AND WEARABLES
Connect Apple Health and your existing wearable so Cora can use your workouts, sleep, heart rate, recovery, and activity data in its coaching. No extra band or device required.
WHAT ELSE YOU CAN DO IN THE CORA APP:
• Chat with Cora in the app or through iMessage
• Connect supported AI assistants to Cora through MCP
• Sync a compatible wearable through Apple Health
• Track live workouts on iPhone and Apple Watch, including heart rate zones and cardio goal notifications
• See daily sleep, recovery, Body Charge, and strain scores
• Review workout breakdowns, muscle recovery, training load, and fitness trends
• Set personalized weekly strength and cardio goals with AI recommendations
• Track resting heart rate, VO₂ max, heart rate recovery, and other fitness metrics
• Log meals by text, photo, or barcode
• Track calories, macros, and micronutrients
• Build meal plans and get healthy food recommendations
• Create and track habits and streaks
• Add widgets to check progress at a glance
GET STARTED: Answer a few basic bio questions and sync your Apple Health data to setup your profile, set goals, and initialize personalized training plans.
APP REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION (see more below in our terms of service). 
Download Cora today and start improving your fitness!
NOTE: Seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions.

Disclaimer: https://www.corahealth.app/disclaimer
Terms of Service: https://www.corahealth.app/terms

bluejetty:00074196:ios.description:
O aplicativo Consulta Bolsa Família (Guia) oferece uma forma prática e rápida para você acompanhar e gerenciar os pagamentos dos benefícios Bolsa Família e Auxílio Brasil.
Com este aplicativo você pode consultar as parcelas concedidas pelo seu benefício de cadastro único. Para consultar a parcela concedida pelo benefício é muito simples, basta escolher o mês e ano da parcela desejada.

bluejetty:00186600:ios.description:
Master the guitar with Guitar Gravitas — the all-in-one toolkit for guitarists of every level. Whether you’re a beginner learning your first chords, an intermediate guitarist improving technique, or a professional exploring advanced music theory and composition, Guitar Gravitas is the inspirational practice and learning app designed to unlock your full potential on the fretboard.
Go beyond memorizing tabs and start understanding the language of music. Guitar Gravitas combines the most comprehensive and interactive chord library, scale encyclopedia, arpeggio generator, tuner, metronome, lessons, backing tracks, and songwriting tools in a single, powerful app.
WHY CHOOSE GUITAR GRAVITAS?
Most guitar apps focus only on learning songs. Guitar Gravitas goes deeper by helping you truly master the instrument itself. With its state-of-the-art algorithmic engine, advanced reverse-lookup finders, and harmonic compatibility tools, it becomes not just another app but your personal guitar theory bible, practice partner, and creative assistant.
CORE FEATURES
THE ULTIMATE CHORD, SCALE & ARPEGGIO LIBRARY
• Massive Chord Library – Explore over 200 chord types, from basic open chords to complex jazz extensions. Includes 15,000+ of the most common shapes ready for instant use.
• Millions of Voicings – Our revolutionary chord generation algorithm creates MILLIONS of playable chord voicings across the neck. Choose root, bass note, or top note to design the exact voicing you need.
• Global Scale Encyclopedia – Master 1,000+ scales from around the world: major, minor, pentatonic, blues, modal, and exotic. Each scale includes thousands of fingering patterns across the fretboard.
• Arpeggio Generator – Create thousands of arpeggio shapes from any of 200+ chord types. Essential for sweep picking practice, outlining harmonies, or writing solos.
THE ULTIMATE “WHAT AM I PLAYING?” TOOL
• Reverse Finders – Unsure what you’re playing? Select notes on the fretboard and instantly discover the name of the chord, arpeggio, or scale. Perfect for improvisers, students, and songwriters.
COMPLETE LEARNING & PRACTICE SUITE
• Video Lessons & Tutorials – 31 professional videos covering guitar lessons for all levels, technique tutorials, and jam-along backing tracks. Includes downloadable PDF support documents.
• High-Precision Tuner – A professional-grade chromatic tuner that works for acoustic, electric, and bass guitar.
• Versatile Metronome – Fully adjustable with multiple time signatures and subdivisions. Train rhythm, speed, and precision.
• 200+ Tunings – Standard, Drop D, Open G, DADGAD, and many more. Create your own custom tunings for any style.
SONGWRITING & CREATIVE TOOLS
• Harmonic Compatibility Engine – Automatically shows compatible chords, scales, and arpeggios for any selection. Write chord progressions, improvise melodies, or break through creative blocks with ease.
• Interactive Playback – Tap to hear every chord, scale, or arpeggio instantly. Train your ear and connect theory to sound.
WHO IS IT FOR?
• Beginners – Learn chords, scales, and rhythm step by step. Understand theory behind your favorite songs.
• Songwriters – Discover unique chord voicings and progressions. Use the compatibility engine to find the perfect scale for melodies.
• Intermediate & Advanced Players – Explore exotic scales, master fretboard navigation, and unlock new improvisation ideas.
• Music Teachers – A powerful visual reference and teaching aid for private lessons or classrooms.
THE COMPLETE GUITAR COMPANION
With Guitar Gravitas, you no longer need separate apps for a tuner, metronome, chord library, or lessons. Everything is integrated into one intuitive platform designed to make practice fun, structured, and endlessly inspiring.
Stop just playing songs — start mastering the guitar. Download Guitar Gravitas today and unlock the entire fretboard.

bluejetty:00145605:ios.description:
The Empowered Motherhood App supports you through pregnancy, birth preparation and postnatal recovery with physiotherapist-designed workouts, education, and compassionate guidance every step of the way. Trusted and recommended by healthcare professionals around the world.
Why choose EMP?
• Physio-designed workouts for every stage of pregnancy and postpartum. 
• Evidence Based Birth Preparation Program
• Motivating weekly programs combine pilates, strength, yoga and cardio. 
• Specialised programs for Pelvic Girdle Pain, C-Section and Prolapse. 
• Reduce and prevent abdominal separation with specialised workouts
• Pelvic floor training to protect and restore your pelvic floor 
• Complete online evidence-based birth preparation program 
• Postnatal recovery programs including C-section, prolapse-safe, and diastasis healing
• On-demand, at-home workouts from 10–40 minutes
• Recommended by obstetricians, midwives, and physiotherapists
Why mums love EMP
"As a physio myself, I am so grateful for your program!" – Emma K
"The modifications meant I could keep moving, even with pelvic pain." – Jade
"My daily go-to in pregnancy: mood, energy, sleep all improved." – Amelia

"Knowing it was physio-led gave me total confidence." – Laura
"I absolutely love your program, it helped me to return to running and netball safely and felt so much stronger on the inside." - Melinda

A quick “Where to Start” quiz that personalises your plan for your body, birth experience and stage of motherhood.
Start your free trial and feel confident, strong and supported through every season of motherhood.
