bluejetty:00129487:ios.summary: Make your day-to-day calculations quick, easy, and beautiful with Calzy. Whether you're a student, professional, or just looking for a better way to manage your everyday math, Calzy is the perfect solution. With its advanced features and go
bluejetty:00129487:ios.description:
Make your day-to-day calculations quick, easy, and beautiful with Calzy. Whether you're a student, professional, or just looking for a better way to manage your everyday math, Calzy is the perfect solution. With its advanced features and gorgeous design, Calzy will quickly become your go-to calculator.
One of its standout features is the "Memory Area," where you can store and easily reuse multiple numerical values with just a drag and drop. Another one is the bookmarking feature, allowing you to save any calculation with a title for future reference.
Using the latest iOS technology, like Live Activity, Drag and Drop, Haptic Touch, Face ID, and more, Calzy makes mathematical problem-solving a seamless experience. And with privacy being our top concern, rest assured your data stays with you.
Key Features:
• Memory Area for saving and reusing numerical values
• Basic and advanced modes
• History and Bookmarking with privacy mode (Face ID support)
• Clean, modern, and beautiful design
• Privacy-conscious app
• Multitasking with slide-over and split view for iPad
• Haptic Feedback for a more immersive experience
• Tax + and Tax - functions
• Quick toggle for decimal and currency rounding
• Smart parenthesis
• Today widget and iMessage extension
• Ability to edit keypad layout
• Apple Pencil 2 support and external keyboard support
• Dynamic type support for enhanced readability
• Custom App Icon support for a personalized touch
• Universal app for iPhone, Apple Watch, and iPad
• Handoff support, start on one device and resume on another
• iCloud sync
• Dark and Light modes with multiple color accents
• Regional support for countries using decimal commas
• Instant calculations as you type
• Bookmarks are available in the Spotlight search
• Universal purchase for all your devices
• Family Sharing support
• Localized in Chinese, Japanese, French, Italian, Russian and German
Powered by the latest iOS technology, Calzy is the calculator for the new age.

bluejetty:00126245:ios.description:
Beckett Basketball is a monthly magazine loaded with everything you need to know about new basketball cards and more. It offers news, values for new releases as well as past sets along with the latest collecting trends.
Our readers use this magazine to find out what's new, what their cards are worth, who's hot, who's not and more. For veterans and novices, Beckett Basketball is a must-have resource to stay informed and aware of the hobby.
What to expect in each issue:
• Editorial coverage: A mix of news, features and opinion pieces covering what’s new and what’s interesting in the hobby along with insight on how and what to collect.
• Previews: All you need to know about upcoming card sets.
• Reviews: Breakdowns and opinions of the newest card releases.
• The Hot List: A visual list and values for the 20 hottest cards on the market.
• The Price Guide: More than 200 pages filled with price ranges for new releases and past sets.
• Market Watch: A look at the key players and products to collect.
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com
--------------------

http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx

• Diagrams and step-by-step help for every calculator

► THE ONLY CHESS APP YOU NEED
Whether you’re a complete beginner or a highly experienced player, Chess Royale has everything you could need to enjoy one of the world’s greatest board games on your mobile device. Play with the AI, with friends, or with millions of strangers all over the world, then train your chess skills with tutorials, puzzles, and post-game analysis. One of the greatest things about chess is that there’s always something new to learn, and this beautifully designed app will allow you to keep on discovering the magic of chess and enhancing your love of the game day after day.
► WHY CHESS?
◾ With a history that stretches back over millennia, chess is both a vital cultural artefact and a beloved pastime that brings together millions of players all over the world.
◾ Renowned as a fierce test of the intellect, chess provides incredible training for your brain. Regularly playing chess and solving puzzles can train your strategic skills, develop logical and lateral thinking, help with learning and understanding psychology, improve your analysis and enhance your memory.
◾ It’s fun! Chess may be intimidating for beginners, but the more you learn and the better you understand the game, the more entertaining and rewarding it becomes. There’s some reason why it has remained among the most popular board games in the world for centuries, after all.
► WHY CHESS ROYALE?
◾ It pays to be popular: With over 50 000 000 players across all popular platforms, Chess Royale ensures there’s always a real opponent of similar skill online and ready to play in a variety of multiplayer formats.
◾ Endless variations: Not only can you challenge real players of different skill levels, you can also play in eight different modes. Play blitzes with varying time limitations, use the notifications system to play with friends when they’re online, test yourself in private against the game’s AI, and enter and arrange tournaments of various formats for more multiplayer fun.
◾ More than just a game: Chess Royale boasts more than 5000 chess puzzles to help you train specific aspects of your game. The app also features analysis tools that you can use post-match to help with your learning and development. And there is a trainer for beginners and more advanced players to get a better grasp of this intensely rich and complex game.
Despite the wonders of modern technology, you’ll be hard pressed to find a mobile game that’s as challenging, enjoyable, and intellectually satisfying as chess. Whether you’re looking for just a new game to play online or a trainer to help you take the very first steps in exploring the magic of chess, Chess Royale offers something extra. Download the app now to discover the ultimate mobile chess environment.

The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.
- Please note that any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase

bluejetty:00036821:ios.description:
Solitaire Master - Classic offers a fresh take on the classic solitaire experience, specifically designed with older players in mind. Enjoy the timeless fun of solitaire through a user-friendly interface optimized for both tablets and smartphones. Known also as Patience, solitaire is a single-player card game that provides hours of entertainment. Play the popular and authentic solitaire game whenever and wherever you like! It's the perfect way to challenge your mind and sharpen your skills, with the opportunity to become a solitaire expert. Try this classic, fun Patience card game now!
Why Choose Solitaire Master - Classic?
- Larger Card Display: With bigger fonts and cards, this game offers a comfortable visual experience that’s easy on the eyes, perfect for tablets and phones.
- Classic Gameplay: Enjoy the timeless charm of traditional solitaire with familiar rules that all players know and love.
- Mental Workout: Boost your brainpower and enhance your problem-solving skills while having fun with this solitaire game, turning every round into a satisfying challenge.
- Easy-to-Use Interface: The simple and intuitive design makes it easy to navigate, ensuring a fun experience for both beginners and seasoned players.
How to Play Solitaire Master - Classic:
Playing solitaire is simple! Just tap or drag the cards to organize them in descending order, alternating colors and suits. Move cards to the foundation, building each suit from Ace to King. For added difficulty, choose to draw either one or three cards at a time.
Key Features of Solitaire Master - Classic:
- Option to Draw 1 or 3 cards
- Unlimited hints and undo options
- Left-handed mode available
- Various card designs and backgrounds
- No Wi-Fi required
- Play anytime, anywhere
- A fresh solitaire experience at your fingertips
- Enhance your skills and enjoy the challenge
Don’t wait any longer! Download the game today and embark on an exciting adventure of strategy, skill, and endless fun! Let the challenge begin!

- Incremental Progression: Grow your party from a simple gathering to a grand ball.
- Unlock Services: With each successful party, unlock new services and expand your estate.
- Historical Setting: Immerse yourself in the beautifully crafted Regency era environment.
- Easy to Play, Challenging to Master:

bluejetty:00115873:ios.description:
Parking convenience is at your fingertips with the Beep Beep Salem parking App. Pay for parking on your mobile device, get notified before your time runs out, and extend your time without visiting a parking meter (note that time extension rules vary location by location).
Key features of the app include:
 • Mobile Payments via smart phone or web
 • Find my car (for those of us who forget where they parked)
 • Touch ID
Registration for Beep Beep Salem is free: just create your account via the App. Once you’ve created an account, you can park and pay for parking in any location that utilizes the Beep Beep Salem App. 
How to Use the App:
 • Create an account 
 • Choose the vehicle license plate
 • Select your location on the map
 • Use the dial to choose how long you want to park 
 • Confirm your payment
Payment with Beep Beep Salem is ultra secure. Your data is protected and our process is certified via 3rd party audit against Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards.
Find more information about our parking services on flowbirdapp.com or feel free to contact us at support@flowbirdapp.com

bluejetty:00099812:ios.description:
SalahScreen automatically blocks distracting apps when it's time to pray so you can show up for worship without the battle. No willpower needed. Just presence.
THE PROBLEM YOU KNOW TOO WELL
You know you should pray on time. But your phone knows how to keep you scrolling. One notification becomes five minutes. Five minutes becomes a missed prayer. And even when you do pray, your mind is still half-tangled in what you just saw on your screen.
You're not weak. Your brain has been conditioned for constant stimulation. Prayer requires the opposite: stillness, focus, presence. SalahScreen bridges that gap.
HOW SALAHSCREEN WORKS
Auto-Schedules from Adhan
Prayer times trigger automatic blocking windows. Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha—your phone knows when it's time, so you don't have to remember.
Choose What Gets Blocked
Select by category (Social, Video, Games) or tap individual apps. Clear "Blocked" badges show what's paused during prayer.
Pray to Unblock
When prayer time ends, a gentle prompt asks if you have prayed. Resume intentionally, not impulsively. Need flexibility? Quick Pause gives you 5 minutes.
Post-Prayer Reflection
Close each prayer with a 30-second journal. Add quick tags, write a note, or just breathe. Turn ritual into remembrance.
Daily Ayah & Hadith
Arabic text with translation. Simple daily inspiration to keep you connected.
Build the Habit
Track streaks and consistency. No pressure. No guilt. Just clarity on your progress.
WHAT YOU'LL EXPERIENCE
- Instant relief – No more battling yourself at prayer time. The apps are just... gone.
- Improved focus within days – Your mind learns that prayer time means prayer, not multitasking.
- Sustainable routine in 3 weeks – Consistency without willpower. The habit builds itself.
- Spiritual transformation over months – Prayers that feel present. Connection that feels real.
YOU'RE NOT ALONE IN THIS
"I used to feel so guilty missing prayers because I got lost scrolling. Now I don't even have to think about it. SalahScreen just handles it."
"My screen time dropped 2+ hours per day. But more importantly, my khushoo improved. I actually feel present now."
"Finally, a tool that understands Muslim rhythms. This isn't just another app blocker—it's built around salah."
WHO THIS IS FOR
Students juggling classes and social media. Professionals drowning in notifications. Parents trying to model good habits. Anyone who's tired of feeling like their phone controls them instead of the other way around.
If you're struggling to pray on time, if your mind wanders during salah, if you're exhausted from the constant battle with your device—this is for you.
YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS
- On-device processing only
- No account required
- Uses standard iOS Screen Time permissions
- Your data never leaves your phone
START TODAY
Join thousands of Muslims reclaiming their focus, one prayer at a time.
Download SalahScreen. Block the noise. Find your presence.

bluejetty:00187744:ios.description:
Access the Bible anywhere, now with Artificial Intelligence new features!
Read God's Word without internet. The app was conceived to propagate and make The Christian Bible studies easier through reading and listening anytime and anywhere, with resources such as: Search, Favorite, Note, Colour Assigning Labels, Sharing Versicles, Devotionals, Hymnal, Biblical Plans, Biblical Dictionary and Biblical Map.
This light and friendly application can accompany you everywhere, making the Word of God accessible at any time for a blessed day.
The Team who has elaborated and keeps improving this oficial application(*) believes that God’s Word must reach everyone easily, quickly and clearly. Our App was the first offline Bible on the app stores and now there are Christians from more than 168 countries and 74 languages that use it.
Details:
o Reading Plans: several Reading Plans that can help you study Bible texts or specific topics.
o Audio: audio versions for all translations, including NIV Live Audio, with Oscar winning cast and renowned Pastors. The audio is synchronized with the reading of the verses.
o Verses: resources to highlight, mark with colours, copy, add personal notes, share verses on social networks and a Verse of the Day Widget. Dive into in-depth studies generated by AI on every verse.
o Searching System: option for the whole Bible, Old Testament, New Testament or separate by book. Users can type more than one word or parts of the verses in the search. Also explore our AI-powered search and ask any kind of biblical question.
o Reading Comfort: Adapt word size, choose the font and activate nocturnal reading mode.

• Words of Jesus in red;
• Reading Progress;
• Book Introduction (informations and curiosities about the book);
• Book list in alfabetic order;
• Option to remove ads;
• Biblical dictionary with more than 900 words;
• Audio versions for all translations, including NIV Live Audio, with Oscar winning cast and renowned Pastors;
• Sharing verses as images to be posted on social networks;
• Geochurch.

bluejetty:00027319:ios.summary:
WHAT IS ONLINE CHECK-IN?

FEATURES:
-Check estimated wait ti
bluejetty:00027319:ios.description:
WHAT IS ONLINE CHECK-IN? 
Online Check-In saves you time by seeing estimated wait times for hair salons near you. From there, just pick your favorite salon, and get on the waitlist from wherever you are. 
FEATURES:
-Check estimated wait times based on current conditions in the salon and updates in real time.
-Online Check-In: You save time by checking in to the salon ahead of time - saving your place in line.
-ReadyNext®: Get text alerts to notify you when your estimated wait time reaches 15 minutes as your cue to head to the salon.
-Save your favorite hair salon so it’s even quicker next time you check in! 
HOW TO USE:
-Tap the Search icon
-Pick a hair salon near you
-Tap the Check In button
-Enter your name and phone number
-Tap Check In again to be added to the wait list – no login, email, or profile required. 
-Let the salon know when you arrive.
After you check in, you can watch your estimated wait time countdown and arrive at the salon when it's nearly your turn to get your service.
ESTIMATED WAIT TIME
Estimated wait times assume you are getting the next available stylist. You can request a stylist upon arrival at the salon but your wait may be longer. For safety and privacy reasons, we do not publish stylist schedules.
WHEN IS ONLINE CHECK-IN AVAILABLE?
Customers can check in online during the hours the salon is open. Online Check-In will not be available during the first five minutes a salon is scheduled to be open. This gives customers who are physically in the salon when it opens a chance to be checked in and have their names added to the waitlist. We accept online check-in up until 30 minutes before closing time. You can still get a haircut at closing time, you just can't check in on the app.
CAN I USE ONLINE CHECK-IN FOR MORE THAN A HAIRCUT?
Yes, you can use Online Check-In for all services except perms and formal updos. Please note that not all salons offer perms. And, most salons require an appointment for these services, so please call the salon to inquire.
WHAT DO I DO IF I DON’T HAVE A MOBILE DEVICE?
You can check in from any device that has internet (a smartphone, iPad, computer, etc.). Go to greatclips.com, click on Find a Salon or Check In. Enter your postal code or address and you'll be using Online Check-In in no time! If you don't have an Internet connection, you can always walk right in to any salon and add your name to the list.
WHEN SHOULD I ARRIVE AT THE SALON?
After you've checked in online, you will see what place you are in on the waitlist. You'll want to arrive to the salon before you are next in line. If you'd like to receive a text message when your estimated wait time reaches 15 minutes, you can sign up for ReadyNext® text alerts. Once you arrive at the salon, let the stylists know you're there, and they will confirm your information and finish your check in.
WHAT HAPPENS IF I ARRIVE LATE?
We understand: Things happen! Don't worry if you lose your keys, spill something, or get stuck in traffic. We'll keep your name on the list for a short period of time.
HOW DO I CANCEL MY CHECK IN?
Once you are checked in, the salon will appear on the home screen. Cancel at any time by tapping Cancel check-in.

bluejetty:00035500:ios.description:
Download the Package Tracker App to Monitor Your Shipments with Ease!
Keep track of all your online orders and deliveries with our versatile package tracker, supporting carrier tracking across 800+ local and international carriers, including USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL, and many more. Whether it’s Amazon, eBay, AliExpress, or any other store, Package Tracker ensures you're always informed.
Free Features:
Basic shipment tracking for a limited number of carriers
Easy copy/paste feature for quick input of tracking numbers
Premium Subscription Features (Available with a subscription):
Unlimited carrier tracking across 800+ carriers
Auto-detect courier by scanning shipping labels
Carrier auto-detection based on tracking number format
Ad-free experience
Track your packages with Package Tracker across 800+ carriers. Basic tracking is free with limited carrier access, while unlimited carrier tracking and advanced features, such as carrier auto-detection, require a subscription.
Supported Carriers Include:
FedEx
USPS
DHL Express, DHL Global Forwarding
UPS, UPS Freight
Canada Post
Aramex
Australia Post
Bpost
Blue Dart
Delhivery

Hermes (Germany)
India Post
New Zealand Post
Parcelforce
Purolator
UK Mail
SF Express
Singapore Post
TNT
Yanwen
Yodel

bluejetty:00166508:ios.description:
● Transcribe recordings into notes and summarize long notes with AI
● Chat with your notes (ask ChatGPT questions) + transcribe and summarize YouTube videos
Memo goes further than just transcription & AI note-taking. Besides the accurate voice-to-text transcriptions, Memo can summarize your notes with a tap, as well as chat with your notes via ChatGPT or translate them. 
Perfect for students and professionals, Memo lets you take voice notes with immense precision and then neatly organize your notes in folders.
Automatic Transcription and Summaries: 
• Voice Notes: Record with a single tap, and Memo transcribes in real-time using Whisper AI, ensuring you capture every detail accurately and instantly. 
• Smart Summaries: Get concise summaries of your transcriptions for quick review, saving you time and letting you focus on the key points without sifting through lengthy notes. 
• Youtube Transcribe: Automatically converts Youtube videos into AI notes, making it easy to extract and review important information from video content.
Organized Note-Taking: 
• High-Quality Transcriptions: Accurate text with proper punctuation and grammar ensures your notes are professional and easy to read, eliminating the need for manual editing. 
• AI Text Editing: Adjust text length and convert it into emails or tasks effortlessly, streamlining your workflow and improving productivity. 
• Folders: Create folders and organize your notes into categories for easy retrieval and management, helping you stay organized and efficient.
Import & Transcribe Voice Messages: 
• Import Audio Files: Transcribe recordings from other apps seamlessly, integrating smoothly with your existing files and workflows for a unified note-taking experience. 
• Voice Messages: Transcribe WhatsApp and Telegram voice messages, allowing you to convert informal communication into actionable text and keep everything in one place.
AI Translation: 
• Multilingual Support: Transcribe and translate voice notes into multiple languages, breaking down language barriers and facilitating communication with a global audience.
Effortless Sharing: 
• Seamless Sharing: Share notes directly via email, messaging apps, or as PDFs, making it simple to collaborate with others and distribute information effortlessly.
Memo’s state-of-the-art voice-to-text note-taking offers quick and efficient idea capture, hands-free multitasking, lecture transcription, and improved accessibility for those with physical challenges. 
With high accuracy, it minimizes the need for manual corrections, and its convenience allows note-taking on the go without typing. Ready to boost your productivity, organization, and time management?
Memo is the better alternative to Otter, Wave AI, Turbolearn AI, Otter AI, Coconut, Noted, Quizlet, and Chegg.
More Subscription Information:
- Weekly plan, monthly plan and yearly plan are available.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, the account will be charged for the renewal of the subscription, indicating the cost of the renewal.
- You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal after purchase by going to your App Store account settings.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
 _____________
Privacy Policy: https://memoapp.ai/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://memoapp.ai/terms.html

bluejetty:00163014:ios.summary:
itTaxi è la prima App italiana per richiedere e pagare un taxi che ti garantisce la flotta più grande d’Italia con oltre 12.000 vetture in più di 87 città!
itTaxi è affidabile, intuitiva e trasparente: organizza con rapidità i tuoi spostam
bluejetty:00163014:ios.description:
itTaxi è la prima App italiana per richiedere e pagare un taxi che ti garantisce la flotta più grande d’Italia con oltre 12.000 vetture in più di 87 città!
itTaxi è affidabile, intuitiva e trasparente: organizza con rapidità i tuoi spostamenti e prenota o chiama il Tuo taxi in tutta Italia senza pensieri.
PERCHÉ SCEGLIERE ITTAXI?
- Perché itTaxi è nata e cresciuta in Italia dall’esperienza diretta di Tassisti e Radiotaxi e dalle esigenze e desideri dei Clienti, Privati e Business.
- Perché ovunque andrai avrai la garanzia del livello di servizio itTaxi, senza compromessi.
- Perché è flessibile: puoi prenotare in anticipo, indicando il numero di passeggeri e di bagagli e anche la necessità di portare con Te il tuo amico a quattro zampe. E’ possibile richiedere un taxi per passeggeri diversamente abili e puoi scegliere tra diverse tipologie di vetture.
- Perché rispetta la natura, eliminando la carta grazie alle ricevute digitalizzate e offrendoTi un’ampia scelta di auto ibride ed elettriche.
- Perché offre molteplici metodi di pagamento: paghi a bordo del taxi o comodamente tramite App, scegliendo tra carta di credito, PayPal, GooglePay, ApplePay, Tinaba, Alipay e tanti altri circuiti di pagamento elettronico integrati, compresi i Bitcoin!
- Perché se sei un’azienda puoi gestire gli spostamenti dei Tuoi collaboratori con flessibilità, con rendicontazione in real time semplificata e digitale.
COME FUNZIONA ITTAXI?
- Facile e veloce: tramite geolocalizzazione, chiedi subito il taxi ovunque sei o prenotalo in anticipo.
- Completa: indicaci le tue esigenze particolari, Ti invieremo il taxi più adatto alle Tue esigenze.
- Paga in tutta sicurezza scegliendo tra i tanti metodi di pagamento supportati
- Risparmia tempo: salva i tuoi indirizzi preferiti, per richiedere il Tuo taxi ancora più velocemente quando sei di fretta!
- Hai bisogno di parlare direttamente con il tuo Tassista senza attendere al centralino? Con itTaxi puoi farlo in modo automatico e garantiamo la tua privacy.
ITTAXI PER LE AZIENDE
Se sei un’Azienda, il servizio Business è dedicato proprio alle Tue esigenze.
Puoi controllare le spese dei Tuoi dipendenti in tempo reale
Puoi creare e monitorare diversi centri di costo
Puoi modificare i limiti di spesa per ciascun centro di costo e profilo del singolo utilizzatore.
Puoi emettere voucher per i Tuoi ospiti
Puoi semplificare le note spese eliminando la carta con una contabilizzazione digitalizzata e facilmente interfacciabile con i Tuoi gestionali.
Puoi scegliere tra diverse soluzioni flessibili di pagamento
DOVE PUOI UTILIZZARE ITTAXI?
Siamo presenti in oltre 87 città italiane e il network è in continua espansione!
Vieni a trovarci su www.ittaxi.it per restare aggiornato sulle novità!
CONTATTI E SOCIAL
itTaxi ti ascolta! Scrivici a info@ittaxi.it, siamo a Tua disposizione per qualsiasi esigenza.
Vuoi essere sempre aggiornato sulle novità?
Seguici sui Social!
https://www.facebook.com/ittaxi.it/
https://www.instagram.com/_it_taxi_/
https://www.linkedin.com/company/ittaxi

bluejetty:00022017:ios.description:
Need to measure your land, field, or yard? FieldCalc - GPS Area Measure gives you a simple and powerful way to calculate area and distance right from your phone using GPS.
Whether you are a farmer planning crop fields, a surveyor mapping property, or a homeowner measuring your yard, Measure Distance & Plot Acres makes land measurement straightforward for anyone who needs quick and dependable results on the go.
Ultimate Features for Reliable Measurements in FieldCalc!
1) Real-Time GPS Area Measurement
- Need to measure a large field or plot area instantly? With FieldCalc's advanced GPS area measurement feature, simply walk your property boundaries or manually tap points on the map.
- Our algorithm calculates precise area measurements in real-time, supporting multiple units (acres, square feet, hectares & more).
- Whether you're surveying residential property, agricultural land or commercial plots, get instant results with pinpoint accuracy using GPS.
- Measuring irregular properties? FieldCalc's cut-hole(Area Subtraction) feature allows you to deduct areas from your main measurement - perfect for properties with ponds, buildings, or excluded zones.
2) Accurate Distance Measurement
- Measure distances between any two points with GPS precision. Whether you're calculating property boundaries, fence lines, or land dimensions, FieldCalc's distance measurement tool provides reliable results.
- Choose between walk mode for active field surveying or manual point-tapping for detailed mapping work. Perfect for contractors, real estate agents, and property surveyors.
3) Circular Area Measurement
- Measure circular plots, pond areas, and round properties with our specialized circular measurement feature.
- Set your desired radius, walk around the perimeter, or manually tap points to calculate circular areas accurately.
- Ideal for measuring circular agricultural fields, water tanks, swimming pools, and round property sections.
4) Marker & Coordinate
Find exact latitude and longitude coordinates for any location on your map.
• Identify exact GPS coordinates instantly
• Edit coordinates manually for precise adjustments
• Display markers on interactive maps
These coordinates are perfect for property records, land documentation, and surveying reference points.
5) Save Complete Measurement Data
Every measurement tells a story. FieldCalc lets you save measurement records including:
• Full measurement data
• Custom icons and group categorization
• Attached photos and documentation
• Organize your measurements efficiently with custom groups.
Why Surveyors Choose FieldCalc:
- Professional-Grade Accuracy: GPS precision meets surveying standards
- Multiple Measurement Modes: Walk, manual tap
- Comprehensive Data Management: Save, organize, and retrieve measurements
- Photo Documentation: Attach images to your measurements
Perfect for:
• Professional Surveyors & Land Measurers
• Real Estate Agents & Property Managers
• Farmers & Agricultural Professionals
• Construction & Contractors
• Property Buyers & Sellers
• Land Developers
• GPS Mapping Enthusiasts
Are you looking for an app that combines surveying precision with user-friendly design? FieldCalc delivers professional surveying tools in an intuitive mobile & web interface. Measure properties with confidence, save detailed records with photos, and manage multiple projects effortlessly with our color-coded group system.
Download FieldCalc today and transform property measurement from complicated guesswork into simple, accurate surveying. Get professional results every time.
Disclaimer:
- This app offers paid features that require an additional purchase for full access. To enjoy all the content and functionality, a subscription is required.
- Street View displays previously captured imagery and is not a live or real-time camera feed. Images may not reflect current conditions.
Privacy Policy: https://fieldcalc.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://fieldcalc.app/terms

bluejetty:00065469:ios.summary: The Winter Park Mobile Banking App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so
bluejetty:00065469:ios.description:
The Winter Park Mobile Banking App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Winter Park National customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Winter Park Mobile Banking App, you must be enrolled as an Winter Park National Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00174640:ios.name: Audio Evolution Mobile Studio
bluejetty:00174640:ios.summary: Record your ideas on the go or create entire music productions from scratch, we'll leave it up to you! This app is a portable multitrack audio and MIDI recording studio featuring virtual instruments, pitch and time editing of vocals (*), un
bluejetty:00174640:ios.description:
Record your ideas on the go or create entire music productions from scratch, we'll leave it up to you! This app is a portable multitrack audio and MIDI recording studio featuring virtual instruments, pitch and time editing of vocals (*), unlimited undo/redo, mixing, real-time effects, automation and much more!
Features:
• Multitrack audio recording / playback
• MIDI sequencing with piano roll editor and MPE support
• Drum pattern editor (including triplets, use your own samples and effects chain per drum sound)
• Automatically or manually tune your vocals with Vocal Tune Studio (*) : an editor to correct pitch and time of vocal recordings and the timing of any audio material. It features retune time, retune amount, volume and formant correction per note as well as vibrato controls.
• Add tempo and time signature changes including gradual tempo change
• Real-time effects including: chorus, compressor, delay, dual delay, reverse delay, reverb, flanger, noise gate and many more!
• Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) with TONE3000 integration offering access to a massive library of NAM captures and IRs of real analog amps, pedals and cabs
• Flexible effect routing: an unlimited number of effects can be placed on a grid, featuring parallel effect paths.
• Assign LFO's to effect parameters or lock parameters to tempo
• Sidechain on the compressor effects
• Inter-app audio effects and instruments
• AudioBus support (including AudioBus remote)
• Audio Unit instruments, effects and AU MIDI
• Multi-output support for Audio Unit instruments
• Virtual analog synthesizer 'Evolution One' featuring morphing oscillators, FM, Sub Osc, Noise, Portamento, 2 LFO's that can be routed to 12 targets, Moog type filtering, effects, ARP, sequencer and more!
• Soundfont (sf2/sf3/sfz) support: free GS/GM Soundfont included, add more from the Soundfont shop or from your own collection
• Special Live performance mode for playing virtual instruments live (worship etc.) with more easy access to instruments, track volume and effects.
• Non-linear editing with move, trim, split, cut/copy/paste, remove, cross-fade, time-stretching etc. with full undo/redo
• Virtual instruments (comes with free instruments and more instrument packs to download)
• Track freezing to save CPU usage
• Clip volume and fade points
• Automation of mixer and effect parameters
• Mix-down to WAV, AIFF and ALAC
• MIDI clock sync
• MIDI remote control
• Unlimited number of tracks and groups
• Non-realtime effects: fade in/out, normalize, reverse, pitch shift, time stretching
• Export to other DAW's by rendering all tracks to separate audio files (stems)
• Media server to access your files easily from a desktop computer
• Multi-core support
• AudioShare support
• Cloud sync using Google Drive and Dropbox
In short: a complete portable multitrack music studio that will replace your fourtrack recorder or tape machine!
(*) The following in-app purchases are available to expand your studio:
• ToneBoosters effect pack 1 (Barricade, DeEsser, Gate, Reverb)
• ToneBoosters EQ with frequency analyzer
• ToneBoosters Compressor
• ToneBoosters Ferox
• ToneBoosters V4 Barricade
• ToneBoosters V4 BitJuggler
• ToneBoosters V4 Compressor
• ToneBoosters V4 Enhancer
• ToneBoosters V4 EQ
• ToneBoosters V4 MBC (multi-band compressor)
• ToneBoosters V4 ReelBus
• ToneBoosters V4 Reverb
• ToneBoosters V4 Sibilance
• ToneBoosters V4 Voice Pitcher
• Vocal Tune with two-voice harmonizer and Vocal Tune PRO, both real-time vocal pitch correction effects
• Vocal Tune Studio: auto tune your vocals, pitch and time correction
• Soundfont instrument packs
• Loop packs from Function Loops
The 'PRO' in-app purchase is only for people who downloaded version 1.x in the past and is not applicable to version 2.0 or higher.
If you have any suggestions, questions or want to report a bug, please contact us! We'll gladly solve any problem!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AudioEvolutionMobile
Forum: https://www.extreamsd.com/forum

bluejetty:00038657:ios.name: Tracky: Simple Budget Planner
bluejetty:00038657:ios.summary:
Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker is the simplest and fastest app to manage your budgets, track your expenses, and save money on the go.
Take control of your budget by allocating your expenses into different envelopes such as groceries, salary
bluejetty:00038657:ios.description:
Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker is the simplest and fastest app to manage your budgets, track your expenses, and save money on the go.
Take control of your budget by allocating your expenses into different envelopes such as groceries, salary, fuel, hobbies, shopping, vacations, and more. Whether it's recurring expenses or special events, Tracky lets you track your monthly or one-time budgets.
Track your expenses and make the most of your savings with Tracky’s automatic calculation of your remaining budget. This fast and easy budget tracking tool is suitable for everyone, regardless of their expertise in budget management. Rest assured, Tracky doesn't require any connection to your bank account, ensuring your data and privacy remain secure.
Why should you use Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker?
- Quick and easy
- Free
- Allocate your budget
- Track your expenses
- Enjoy your savings
- No sign-up or login required
- No bank account needed
- Private & secure: we don't collect your data, it's safe for you
- Automatic iCloud sync to share data across multiple devices logged in to the same iCloud account
=== TRACKY: SIMPLE BUDGET TRACKER FEATURES ===
- Create and manage your budgets
- Add and customize your operations: name, amount, date, icon, color
- Automatic calculation of your remaining budget
- Stay informed about your budget's progress with notifications
- Keep a history of your expenses
- Save time by reusing recurring budgets
- Easily share your data across multiple devices logged in to the same iCloud account
- Widgets: instantly monitor your budget from your lock screen and home screen
How to use Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker:
1. Create a budget and give it a name (e.g., "July")
2. Define and customize your envelopes (e.g., "Groceries," "Fuel," "Hobbies")
3. Add your expenses to the envelopes
4. Enter the expense name and amount
5. Personalize the expense by selecting an icon and color
6. Continue adding your expenses as you go, and Tracky will calculate the remaining budget
As you can see, Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker is incredibly simple and fast to use. It's the perfect solution for tracking your expenses and budgets without wasting time on understanding the app or linking your bank account, which could compromise your data. Managing your expenses has never been easier, faster, and more efficient.
Easily set and monitor your monthly or one-time budgets. Modify them anytime to adapt to your financial situation. Track your expenses accurately and identify areas where you can save. Dive into the detailed expense history for a deeper analysis of your spending habits. Identify trends, strengths, and areas for improvement to optimize your budget.
Tracky is the easiest and most convenient app to track your budgets, so what are you waiting for? Download Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker now!
***
Our app is FREE to use. However, you can become premium with in-app purchases. You'll have unlimited budgets, envelopes, and expenses, and no ads will be displayed to ensure optimal user experience.
All prices are in euros (EUR). Prices in other currencies and countries may vary depending on the country of residence.
Thank you for using Tracky: Simple Budget Tracker. Support us by sharing the app with your loved ones and giving us a 5-star rating on the App Store. Your support will enable us to continue improving the app and provide you with an even better financial management experience.

App Description
Keep LiteFit: Workouts at Home helps you get fit, build strength, and stay consistent without leaving your house. Whether you want to lose weight, tone your body, improve flexibility, or simply feel better every day, Keep Li
bluejetty:00165069:ios.description:
App Description
Keep LiteFit: Workouts at Home helps you get fit, build strength, and stay consistent without leaving your house. Whether you want to lose weight, tone your body, improve flexibility, or simply feel better every day, Keep LiteFit offers simple and effective workouts designed for real life.
No gym. No equipment. No complicated setup. Just a few minutes a day to build a healthier routine at home.
Personalized Workout Plans
Get a workout plan tailored to your goals, fitness level, and lifestyle. Whether you're a beginner starting your fitness journey or someone looking for a more structured home routine, Keep LiteFit helps you stay on track with a plan that works for you.
Easy-to-Follow Home Workouts
Stay active with guided workouts that are simple, clear, and effective. Each session is designed to be easy to follow, so you can exercise with confidence anytime, anywhere. Short workouts make it easier to stay consistent, even on busy days.
Train Anytime, Anywhere
Work out at home, in your room, or wherever fits your schedule. Keep LiteFit is designed for flexible training, so you can stay committed without needing special equipment or a gym membership.
Diverse Workout Library
Explore a wide range of workout types to match your needs and preferences, including:
- Wall Pilates
- Chair Workout
- Dance Cardio
- Anaerobic Exercise
- HIIT
- Running & Brusk walking
Whether your goal is fat loss, mobility, posture improvement, or daily movement, there's a workout for you.
Built for Different Fitness Levels
From beginner-friendly routines to more challenging sessions, Keep LiteFit supports you at every stage. Start small, progress steadily, and build long-term healthy habits at your own pace.
Clear Guidance and Better Form
Follow step-by-step instructions designed to help you move with confidence. Keep LiteFit makes it easier to understand each workout and stay focused on proper movement and consistency.
Stay Motivated Every Day
Build your own routine, complete daily workouts, and keep moving toward your goals. With practical plans and easy access to workouts, Keep LiteFit helps turn fitness into a habit you can maintain.
Start your home fitness journey with Keep LiteFit: Workouts at Home and make every workout count.

bluejetty:00185488:ios.summary:
A music sequencer reimagined with multiple playheads.
"How Bach would have made a sequencer." (Create Digital Music)
"A musical feat." (Creator's Project)
"A new approach to sequencing." (XLR8R)
"A next generation music sequencer." (Ask Au
bluejetty:00185488:ios.description:
A music sequencer reimagined with multiple playheads.
"How Bach would have made a sequencer." (Create Digital Music)
"A musical feat." (Creator's Project)
"A new approach to sequencing." (XLR8R)
"A next generation music sequencer." (Ask Audio)
Fugue Machine Classic is a tool inspired by composition techniques used in Baroque music and Serialism — e.g. Bach’s canons and fugues, and Schoenberg’s twelve-tone technique. The idea was to design a tool to manipulate a melody’s speed, direction, and pitch, as well as play multiple variations of the melody simultaneously.
As it turned out, the best implementation for this was to reimagine one of the most fundamental building blocks of all music sequencers: the piano roll.
Fugue Machine Classic is the world’s first multi-playhead piano roll. Create a music sequence and play it back with up to four playheads at once — each at various speeds, directions, pitches, and more. Watch the playheads dance, and hear the complex patterns that emerge.
It’s mesmerizing.
Fugue Machine Classic supports iPhone, iPad, MIDI, AUv3 MIDI, Ableton Link, Audiobus, Audiobus 3 MIDI, and Inter-App Audio. Thanks to the AUv3 standard, you can run multiple instances of Fugue Machine Classic on a single device when hosted in an AUv3 MIDI host app — like AUM, Logic Pro for iPad, Loopy Pro, and Cubasis.

bluejetty:00017459:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00017459:ios.description:
Swipe the letters. Find the word. Watch the stack collapse.
Word Trails is a word search that does not sit still. Find a word and the letters above it fall into place, reshaping the board under your finger. Every solve changes what you are looking at.
HOW IT WORKS
- Swipe across adjacent letters to trace a word
- Words run in any direction through the stack
- Find one and the letters above collapse down
- Clear the whole stack to finish the level
- Find extra words we did not ask for and earn rewards
EVERY LEVEL HAS A THEME
Not random letters. Each puzzle has a subject, and the words belong to it. Knowing the theme is half the solve; the other half is spotting the trail through a grid that keeps rearranging itself.
THOUSANDS OF LEVELS
From short warm-ups to stacks that take a few sittings. New puzzles added regularly.
THREE WAYS OUT WHEN YOU ARE STUCK
- Spyglass reveals a word's position
- Light Bulb fills in a letter
- Shuffle rearranges the board and often that is all you needed
EARN YOUR OWN HINTS
Extra words you find pay coins. Coins buy hints. The better you get, the less you need them, and the more you have banked for the levels that really fight back.
PLAYS OFFLINE
No connection needed. On a plane, on the bus, in a waiting room or anywhere the signal drops.
GOOD FOR YOUR VOCABULARY
Every level asks you to pull words out of a shifting grid and to think about which ones fit the theme. Players use it to keep sharp, to build vocabulary and to practise English.
FOR EVERY AGE
Simple enough for a child learning to spell, deep enough to become a daily habit.
Free to download and play. Optional in-app purchases are available for coins, and a Remove Ads upgrade if you want to play without interruptions.
Swipe. Solve. Watch it fall.

bluejetty:00152008:ios.description:
Welcome to Beauty Sort! Experience the Fusion of Style, Drama, and Sorting Fun! 
A Turning Point! Heiress Scarlett's world is shattered by betrayal. Returning to her family, she's determined to uncover the truth behind her mother's mysterious death and build her own business empire. But the path is fraught with challenges! Scarlett needs your strategic mind and fashion expertise to succeed. Are you ready to embark on this glamorous and compelling adventure?
Game Features
- Dramatic Storyline: Immerse yourself in Scarlett's world, filled with compelling drama, secrets, family mysteries, betrayal, and her rise to success.
- Addictive Sorting Puzzles: Showcase your organizational skills! Quickly identify and match 3 identical items on beautifully stocked shelves. Clear the shelves and earn valuable rewards.
- Stylish Makeovers: Use your winnings to glam up Scarlett AND her squad! From boardroom chic to red carpet glam – every occasion demands a new look!
- Engaging & Relaxing Puzzles: Match items to unwind while keeping your mind sharp. It's the perfect blend of relaxing gameplay and stimulating mental challenge!
- Powerful Boosters: Tough level? Don't worry! Use a variety of powerful boosters to overcome obstacles and clear levels！
How to Play?
- Sort the Shelves: Scan the goods on the shelves. Find and match 3 identical ones to clear them.
- Achieve Objectives: Clear the entire board within the time limit to win Coins & Gems! 
- Style Makeover: Use your earned rewards! Style Scarlett and her companions with fabulous outfits and accessories for the perfect look.
- Unlock Drama: Give Scarlett a glam makeover to unlock shocking betrayals—will you reveal her wealthy family’s darkest secrets?
Enjoy exciting stories, solve fun sorting puzzles, and create stylish makeovers! Help Scarlett unravel the mystery, rebuild her life, and create her dazzling empire! Are you ready for this unique adventure blending brains, beauty, and thrilling drama?

bluejetty:00180563:ios.description:
Give your child the tools to thrive in school, at home, and beyond and make screen time productive with fun, educational and non addictive games and stories.
With 2500+ interactive activities, award-winning stories, and science-backed games, Smart Tales® is the go-to learning app for kids aged 2 to 11. Whether you’re a parent, teacher, or caregiver, it’s built to support every learner—including neurodivergent children—with a focus on inclusivity and engagement.
“Smart Tales has been a game-changer. My child now asks to practice multiplication tables!”
“I love that I can track progress and feel confident it’s not just screen time—it’s real learning.”
“As a busy single mom, it’s the only app I trust when I need 20 focused minutes.”
What Smart Tales® Helps Your Child Achieve:
-Master MATH SKILLS and go beyond with addition, subtraction, multiplication, division & time tables
-Build a LOVE FOR READING with read-along stories and vocabulary-rich adventures
-Practice real-world SCIENCE: human body, space, nature, and fun experiments
-Strengthen LOGIC and REASONING through coding challenges and brain games
-Develop BETTER BEHAVIOR and emotional regulation through STORIES rooted in values and kindness
-Progress at their own pace with a personalized LEARNING PATH
-Learn anywhere with OFFLINE ACCESS and multi-device support
BUILT FOR ALL TYPES OF LEARNERS
Smart Tales® was crafted with inclusivity at its core, certified for kids on the autism spectrum and built to support neurodivergent learning styles. Whether your child is ahead, behind, or simply learns differently, Smart Tales® adapts to their needs.
AWARDS & RECOGNITION
**Apple App Store: 2025 Essential App for Kids
Mom’s Choice Award®
National Parenting Product Award
Academics’ Choice™ Brain Toy Award
Parent and Teacher Choice Award™
Kids Safe Certified
5 Stars – Educational App Store**
PROGRAMS THAT GROW WITH YOUR CHILD
READING PROGRAM
Nurture early literacy with phonics, read-alongs, sentence building, and story comprehension. Smart Tales® builds a love for reading by making every word part of an adventure.
MATH PROGRAM
From counting to multiplication and time tables, every activity is designed to strengthen core math skills through engaging, gamified lessons.
SCIENCE PROGRAM
Explore topics from animal facts and senses to geography, photosynthesis, and astronomy. Real-world learning, simplified and made fun.
FOR PARENTS AND TEACHERS
-Monitor learning with the Parent Area
-Set time limits, track achievements, and adjust difficulty
-Aligned to U.S. State Standards
-Created by educators, backed by child development research
Whether you’re prepping your preschooler for kindergarten, reinforcing classroom learning, or just looking for smarter screen time, Smart Tales® gives your child a solid educational foundation—and makes them love learning.
Download Smart Tales® today—where every tap leads to growth.

bluejetty:00179138:ios.description:
Save today on International Calls, Mobile Recharges & Travel eSIMs with Pingo App!
Keep the world within reach for less. Whether you're making premium international calls at budget rates, sending a mobile top-up to family back home, or activating instant data for your next trip, Pingo brings you closer to what matters in one simple app.
Replace expensive calling cards and roaming fees with our excellent value calling rates from our all-in-one international app. Easily make cheap calls or send top-ups to Nigeria, Ghana, India, UK, Kenya, US, Germany, Poland, China, and many more. 
Premium voice calls:
* High Quality: Enjoy crystal-clear VoIP calls at local rates
* Pay per minute with no hidden fees
* Use with WiFi or Mobile Data
Download for free and get:
* Cheap rates for international phone calls
* No Hidden or Extra Fees
* $5 Minimum Order
* Minute rounding
* 100% Call Quality
* Access from all iOS smartphones and tablets
* Direct access to your phone contacts
* 24/7 Customer Service
Very easy to use:
1. Create an account or login
2. Buy Voice Credit, Mobile Recharge, or Travel eSIM
3. Start calling and stay connected with the world!
Extra options:
* Instantly check the rate/min for the destination you want to call
* Check out the answers to frequently asked questions in our Help Center
* Set My Caller ID - Let your friends and family know it's you calling by setting your Caller ID directly in the app.
* Rate Our App - We value your feedback. Let us know how we're doing!
Features:
* Integrated Contacts: Use your existing phone list for 1-tap calls
* Easy Onboarding: Create a new account directly from the app in seconds
* Speed Dial: Call your favorite international numbers faster than ever
Tip: We recommend turning off "International Calling" with your current mobile provider to avoid accidental high charges on their network. Always use Pingo app for great rates!
Backup calling method:
Use our Toll Free or Local Access numbers from any mobile or landline.
Mobile Recharge 
Need to send mobile credit abroad? Top up any prepaid phone in 160+ countries in just a few taps. It’s the fastest way to support your friends and family with instant delivery.
Travel eSIM 
Digital eSIM for the modern traveler. Skip the physical cards and the roaming charges. High-speed travel data is just a tap away, keeping you connected wherever your journey leads.
Questions or Feedback?
We value your opinion! Reach out to us at customerservice@pingo.com or check our Help Center directly in the app.
Frequently asked questions
1. Can I use my phone contacts?
Yes, but you have to make sure that all phone numbers are saved in international format: country code + phone number.
2. How much data does the app use for an online call?
On average, the app uses approximately 1MB/min for making a voice call. In order to benefit from the highest quality available, we advise you to use the application with a WiFi network. bluejetty:00079472:ios.description:
Boston Transit — Your Smarter Way Around Boston
Get real-time MBTA bus, subway, commuter rail, and ferry updates — all in one simple, reliable app built for Boston commuters.
“I use Boston Transit every day. The live train times are spot on, and the alerts have saved me from missing my connections more than once.”
Why Bostonians love Boston Transit:
• Live MBTA bus, subway, and commuter rail tracking
• Stop and schedule alerts
• Trip planner with step-by-step directions
• Live and offline route maps
• One-tap “Get Me Home” journeys
• Customizable widgets for quick access
Never miss your stop again — with Get Off Alerts, Boston Transit lets you know exactly when it’s time to hop off. Check your bus, train, or ferry on the map in real time, see crowd levels before boarding, and stay updated with instant alerts about delays, detours, and service changes.
Whether you’re commuting from Cambridge, riding the Red Line downtown, or catching a ferry across the harbor, Boston Transit makes it easy to get where you’re going.
Coverage Includes:
• MBTA Subway (Red, Orange, Blue, and Green Lines)
• MBTA Buses and Silver Line
• MBTA Commuter Rail
• MBTA Ferries
• Regional connections: CATA, BAT, LRTA, MWRTA, and more
• Real-time service alerts, detours, and closures
Plan trips, check live arrivals, and save your favorite stops — all in one streamlined app designed for Boston and the Greater Massachusetts area.
--------
What is Boston Transit?
Boston Transit is a real-time public transport app for Boston and the Greater Massachusetts area. It shows live MBTA bus, subway, commuter rail, and ferry times, plus service alerts.
Does it work with the MBTA?
Yes — Boston Transit covers all MBTA services, including buses, subways, ferries, and commuter rail lines.
Can I track my train or bus in real time?
Yes. You can see your vehicle’s exact position on the map and check live arrival predictions for every stop.
Does it include commuter rail services?
Yes — Boston Transit provides real-time updates for all MBTA Commuter Rail lines.
Does Boston Transit show service alerts and delays?
Yes. You’ll receive live notifications about delays, detours, and service interruptions straight from the MBTA.
Can I use Boston Transit offline?
Yes — the app includes offline maps and saved timetables so you can travel without mobile

Hearing Aid turns your phone and your headphones into a real-time sound amplifier, a live caption reader, a guided hearing screening and a tinnitus relief player - for the moments when you need to hear clearly right now.
AMPLIFY THE ROOM
P
bluejetty:00081554:ios.description:
Hearing Aid turns your phone and your headphones into a real-time sound amplifier, a live caption reader, a guided hearing screening and a tinnitus relief player - for the moments when you need to hear clearly right now.
AMPLIFY THE ROOM
Point your phone toward whoever you want to hear and lift their voice straight into your headphones.
- Amplification you set in decibels, with a live room-level meter
- Voice focus lifts speech and evens out sudden loud sounds
- Three-stage noise reduction for fans, traffic and crowd noise
- Independent left and right balance for uneven hearing
- Bass and treble shaping plus a full equalizer
- One-tap presets: Conversation, Restaurant, TV, Outdoors, Music, Quiet room
- Scene suggestion: when the room gets loud, the app offers the preset that fits
- A safe listening limit caps the loudest output the app will send to your ears
- Headphone guard stops speaker feedback before it starts
LIVE CAPTIONS
Turn the speech around you into large, readable text.
- Real-time captions with adjustable text size
- Copy or share what was said
- AI recap: a short summary, the key points, and the follow-ups worth asking
- Your captions stay on your device
HEARING TEST AND YOUR PROFILE
- A guided pure-tone screening for each ear, step by step
- Your result drawn as an audiogram, with earlier tests kept for comparison

bluejetty:00098575:ios.description:
Ready to give your mind a daily challenge?
Practice memory, focus, logic, and problem-solving through engaging brain games and activities. IQ Booster is designed to make mental practice fun and easy to fit into your routine.
Whether you want to challenge yourself at work, while studying, or during everyday moments, you can explore a variety of activities designed to keep your mind engaged.
Train Your Mind with Engaging Brain Games
IQ Booster combines interactive activities to create a varied brain game experience. Explore games and exercises focused on memory, attention, logical thinking, problem-solving, and mental agility.
Each session offers different challenges across a range of skill areas, so you can keep your daily training varied and engaging.
Why You’ll Love It:
- Engaging Brain Games: Explore interactive activities focused on memory, logic, attention, and problem-solving.
- Varied Challenges: Practice different skills through a range of games and exercises.
- Cognitive Quizzes: Explore quizzes related to memory, attention, reasoning, and other cognitive skills.
- Track Your Progress: Follow your activity and performance over time.
- Daily Streaks: Stay consistent and build a regular brain training routine.
Brain Games, IQ Quizzes & Daily Training
Explore brain games, memory games, logic challenges, and IQ-style quizzes designed to keep your mind active and engaged.
Practice different types of mental activities focused on attention, memory, reasoning, and problem-solving. Follow your progress, try new challenges, and create a routine that works for you.
Build a consistent habit with daily brain training streaks. Explore IQ games, brain quizzes, memory challenges, and different training activities.
Challenges That Make You Think
Take engaging quizzes and review your quiz results and activity.
From logical reasoning and memory recall to attention and mental speed, IQ Booster gives you different ways to explore your performance in different activities and challenge yourself over time.
Perfect For:
- Students – Practice focus, memory, and logical thinking alongside your daily routine.
- Professionals – Explore activities involving reasoning, attention, and problem-solving.
- Lifelong Learners – Keep your mind engaged with regular mental activities.
- Curious Minds – Explore IQ-style quizzes, brain games, and personal progress.
IQ Booster brings brain games, memory activities, and IQ-style quizzes together in one place.
Explore new challenges, follow your progress, and make brain training part of your daily routine.
Subscriptions are offered as auto-renewable plans on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis (pricing may vary by country). Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
For support or feedback, contact us at support@iqbooster.com
Terms of Use: https://iqbooster.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://iqbooster.com/privacy

====最新情報====
新モード|【一局戦】登場
◆電光石火の三人麻雀！飜数UPでボーナスもUP！「役満特等賞」を目指して奮闘しよう！
新モード|【挑戦試合（PvP）】登場
◆牌山を選び全国の雀士と対決！何度も挑戦して高得点を狙おう！
新キャラ|【宮本夏樹】参戦
◆人気声優の小清水亜美さんがボイスを担当！腕利きのファイナンシャルプランナー宮本夏樹。父親に男手一つで育てられた彼女は、いつも強気で誰にも屈しない気概を持っていた。そのため仕事や学業の面で成功を収めることができたが、深い人間関係を築く機会を失ってしまい、心のどこかで物足りなさを感じていた……。
新イベント|【神宴～ファンタジー周年祭】開催
◆人気キャラが古代ギリシャの神々に変身……!? 雀皇麻雀のファンタジー周年祭に参加しよう！さらに初課金ボーナスイベント復活！青木健一郎の獲得率もUP！詳しいイベント情報はゲーム内で！
====「麻雀×寿命」の都市伝説====
人々の寿命が賭けられるという
「得失の間」と呼ばれる謎多き雀荘
ごくごく普通のバーを装い
街の片隅にひっそりと店を構えている
様々なバックグラウンドを持つ
異世界人のような格好をした雀士たち
そしてバーのスタッフと来客たち
それぞれが自分の目的を持って出入りしている
麻雀は試練ではない
思考を巡らせ、仲間と共に真実を探るもの
勝敗だけではない
各々の運命の物語が絡み合っていく……
====気軽に楽しく遊べる====
『雀皇麻雀』は基本無料でフルに楽しめる二次元風美少女麻雀ゲーム。全国の麻雀好きの雀士とマッチング対局し、あなたの腕前を披露しよう！対局中はユニークで可愛いキャラスタンプを使って、同卓の雀士に想いを伝えることも可能！
多彩なオリジナルモードで今までにない麻雀体験をするもよし、豪華声優陣が演じる個性豊かなキャラたちのストーリーに没頭するもよし！気に入ったキャラクターがいれば、10連ガチャで確実にゲット！
◆美麗でリアルなキャラたち
都会的なOLスタイルから、異国情緒あふれる幻想的なスタイル、そしてネオン要素を取り入れたストリートスタイルまで……多種多様なスキンから選択可能！どのキャラも美麗なモーション付きで、あなたとのインタラクションに応じたリアクションを楽しめる！キャラを手に入れるのは簡単で、10連ガチャで「最低でも1人」の雀士をゲット！
キャラが好きなギフトを贈ることで好感度を大幅UP！キャラ専用スキン・アイテムを解放しよう！どのキャラも２つ以上の高級スキンを用意！
◆豊富なアイテムで華麗なる対局を演出
自分好みにカスタマイズ可能！お気に入りの装飾品で、自分だけの麻雀空間を創り出そう！麻雀牌・雀卓マット・リーチ棒などの麻雀アイテムから、キャラクターのスキン、そしてスタンプに至るまで、すべて自由自在に変更可能！
◆麻雀冒険譚の幕開け
個性豊かな雀士と始めるドキドキの奇妙な冒険。各キャラのストーリーが次第に交錯する……。すべてのストーリーを攻略して「得失の間」の真相を解き明かそう！物語が進むにつれ、キャラからメッセージが届くことも！心ときめく内容にどう返信する……？好感度を上げると、キャラ専用アイテムや高級スキンもゲットできる！
◆超スリリングなオリジナルモード
▼仲良し“2v2モード”：
味方の手牌が丸見え！？
協力プレイに最適！完全初心者と歴戦の強者がタッグを組んで楽しめる！また、気心の知れた仲間と連携プレーも可能！友達との仲が今まで以上に深まるかも……？
▼実力勝負の“挑戦試合”：
プロ雀士も本気を出さないと負ける！？
同じ牌山の対局に何度も挑戦し、最高打点を狙おう！始めるのは簡単、でも極めるのは難しい……？ランキングで何位を獲得できるかな？
====「得失の間」雀友交流SNS====
より詳しいゲーム情報は以下のSNSでチェック！
▼公式Twitter：https://twitter.com/mahjongkings1
▼公式：discord：https://discord.gg/VGVRRa4hZU
====全キャラ豪華声優ボイス付き====
人気声優陣が多彩なキャラを熱演！
藤原芽衣（CV：種﨑敦美）

listings.description:
====最新情報====

新モード|【一局戦】登場
◆電光石火の三人麻雀！飜数UPでボーナスもUP！「役満特等賞」を目指して奮闘しよう！

新モード|【挑戦試合（PvP）】登場
◆牌山を選び全国の雀士と対決！何度も挑戦して高得点を狙おう！

新キャラ|【宮本夏樹】参戦
◆人気声優の小清水亜美さんがボイスを担当！腕利きのファイナンシャルプランナー宮本夏樹。父親に男手一つで育てられた彼女は、いつも強気で誰にも屈しない気概を持っていた。そのため仕事や学業の面で成功を収めることができたが、深い人間関係を築く機会を失ってしまい、心のどこかで物足りなさを感じていた……。

新イベント|【神宴～ファンタジー周年祭】開催
◆人気キャラが古代ギリシャの神々に変身……!? 雀皇麻雀のファンタジー周年祭に参加しよう！さらに初課金ボーナスイベント復活！青木健一郎の獲得率もUP！詳しいイベント情報はゲーム内で！

====「麻雀×寿命」の都市伝説====
人々の寿命が賭けられるという
「得失の間」と呼ばれる謎多き雀荘
ごくごく普通のバーを装い
街の片隅にひっそりと店を構えている
様々なバックグラウンドを持つ
異世界人のような格好をした雀士たち
そしてバーのスタッフと来客たち
それぞれが自分の目的を持って出入りしている
麻雀は試練ではない
思考を巡らせ、仲間と共に真実を探るもの
勝敗だけではない
各々の運命の物語が絡み合っていく……

====気軽に楽しく遊べる====
『雀皇麻雀』は基本無料でフルに楽しめる二次元風美少女麻雀ゲーム。全国の麻雀好きの雀士とマッチング対局し、あなたの腕前を披露しよう！対局中はユニークで可愛いキャラスタンプを使って、同卓の雀士に想いを伝えることも可能！

多彩なオリジナルモードで今までにない麻雀体験をするもよし、豪華声優陣が演じる個性豊かなキャラたちのストーリーに没頭するもよし！気に入ったキャラクターがいれば、10連ガチャで確実にゲット！

◆美麗でリアルなキャラたち
都会的なOLスタイルから、異国情緒あふれる幻想的なスタイル、そしてネオン要素を取り入れたストリートスタイルまで……多種多様なスキンから選択可能！どのキャラも美麗なモーション付きで、あなたとのインタラクションに応じたリアクションを楽しめる！キャラを手に入れるのは簡単で、10連ガチャで「最低でも1人」の雀士をゲット！

キャラが好きなギフトを贈ることで好感度を大幅UP！キャラ専用スキン・アイテムを解放しよう！どのキャラも２つ以上の高級スキンを用意！

◆豊富なアイテムで華麗なる対局を演出
自分好みにカスタマイズ可能！お気に入りの装飾品で、自分だけの麻雀空間を創り出そう！麻雀牌・雀卓マット・リーチ棒などの麻雀アイテムから、キャラクターのスキン、そしてスタンプに至るまで、すべて自由自在に変更可能！

◆麻雀冒険譚の幕開け
個性豊かな雀士と始めるドキドキの奇妙な冒険。各キャラのストーリーが次第に交錯する……。すべてのストーリーを攻略して「得失の間」の真相を解き明かそう！物語が進むにつれ、キャラからメッセージが届くことも！心ときめく内容にどう返信する……？好感度を上げると、キャラ専用アイテムや高級スキンもゲットできる！

◆超スリリングなオリジナルモード
▼仲良し“2v2モード”：
味方の手牌が丸見え！？
協力プレイに最適！完全初心者と歴戦の強者がタッグを組んで楽しめる！また、気心の知れた仲間と連携プレーも可能！友達との仲が今まで以上に深まるかも……？

▼実力勝負の“挑戦試合”：
プロ雀士も本気を出さないと負ける！？
同じ牌山の対局に何度も挑戦し、最高打点を狙おう！始めるのは簡単、でも極めるのは難しい……？ランキングで何位を獲得できるかな？

====「得失の間」雀友交流SNS====
より詳しいゲーム情報は以下のSNSでチェック！
▼公式Twitter：https://twitter.com/mahjongkings1
▼公式：discord：https://discord.gg/VGVRRa4hZU


====全キャラ豪華声優ボイス付き====
人気声優陣が多彩なキャラを熱演！

藤原芽衣（CV：種﨑敦美）
竹岡翔太（CV：白井悠介）
及川綾（CV：斎藤千和）
黒崎優（CV：上坂すみれ）
宮本夏樹（CV：小清水亜美）
桜井由里（CV：M·A·O）
坂部美咲（CV：喜多村英梨）
織田愛（CV：佐倉綾音）
及川千夜（CV：浪川大輔）
青木健一郎（CV：土岐隼一）
ボイス付きキャラ続々追加中！

bluejetty:00089063:ios.description:
Do you want to have a restaurant that belongs to you completely? Then you have come to the right place! 
In this game, you are the restaurant owner in charge of everything, from restaurant design to restaurant management, you just need to make it look like you want.
The freshly sold restaurant is messy and dilapidated, to clean it up! 
It is so empty… Lacking some tables, chairs and kitchen utensils, to buy it! 
The guests ordered food, to cook it! 
Here, you can do everything you want to do. Be a designer to complete restaurant design and furniture procurement. Be a chef to perform restaurant cooking management. Be a waiter to complete restaurant delivery and ordering. Be a happy restaurant executive managing the restaurant business. You will witness the perfect transformation of this restaurant and write your own restaurant story.
So are you ready to start your restaurant story? 
Maybe you are curious, what can you experience in the exciting restaurant games? Let me tell you~
-- Design Restaurant
Buy the furniture you like for the restaurant and design it as you want. Not just the dine-in area, you can also complete kitchen design and kitchen remodel, turn it into a perfect cooking kitchen!
-- Make Food and Serve Customers
Take orders for the guests and make the food they want to eat. Burger, pizza, sandwich; milk, cola, icecream... try to meet the needs of the guests. 
-- Manage And Upgrade Your Business
Seriously manage the restaurant, expand the scale and upgrade your business.
Restaurant Story: Decor & Cook is always waiting for you. 
Hope you like this cooking diary restaurant game. At the same time, we also welcome your suggestions and complaints. If you have any questions, please email us: Beyondthegame01@gmail.com.

bluejetty:00094808:ios.summary:

Step into the shoes of a master farmer with Mowing Craze - Sort Puzzle, where rainbow grasses meet s
bluejetty:00094808:ios.description:
Mowing Craze - Sort Puzzle, the exciting grass-cutting puzzle frenzy! Sort, stack, and bale colorful hay in this addictive farm adventure!
Step into the shoes of a master farmer with Mowing Craze - Sort Puzzle, where rainbow grasses meet satisfying organization! Harvest vibrant grasses, match them to color containers, and create wonderful haystacks in this thrilling color-matching challenge. Great for fans of color sort games and puzzle-solving fun!
How to Play
• Match the colored grass flowing from farms to hay bale containers below
• Only front-row containers can be filled - complete them to unlock next rows
• Pack each bale to 100% precision before moving to the next
• Juggle multiple containers filling different grass colors simultaneously
• Win by perfectly packing all bales!
Key Features of Mowing Craze - Sort Puzzle
Satisfying Color Match: Transform colorful grass chaos into neatly stacked hay masterpieces.
Relaxing Yet Challenging: Wonderful blend of color match focus and strategy.
Hundreds of Levels: From breezy bales to randomly shuffling the colors of the lawn in the front row, each stage feels fresh!
Offline Play: Match and sort anytime, anywhere—no WiFi needed.
Relaxing Gameplay: Experience ASMR-like satisfaction as colorful grasses transform into neatly contained bales.
Upgrade Power-Ups: Use various props to control the pace of your color sort game!
Great Choice for Players Who Enjoy
Color Sort games like Hexa Master 3D or Balloon Triple Match
Puzzle games with a twist (Coffee Sort)
Matching games that test reflexes (Tile Master)
Whether you're a casual player looking for a relaxing color sort experience or a puzzle game master who loves strategic merging, Mowing Craze offers endless fun.
Ready to bake your way to glory? Download Mowing Craze - Sort Puzzle now; it’s totally FREE and relax!

bluejetty:00114284:ios.description:
Encontrar passagem é um perrengue?
Grupos de ofertas. Programas de milhas. Buscadores de voo. E ainda paga caro?
No Viajants, garimpamos todos lugares possíveis:
- Grupos de WhatApp
- Grupos de Telegram
- Programas de Milhas
- Blogs de Viagens
- Sites das Cias Aéreas
- Buscadores de Voos
E te avisamos de tudo que encontrarmos!
Como funciona?
Defina até 5 aeroportos de origem. Nós encontramos as ofertas e te enviamos.
E você compra a passagem sem intermediários.
Espiamos 39 grupos de alertas de voos (pagos e gratuitos). Varremos 143 sites das cias aéreas, blogs de viagem e buscadores de passagens. Somos hoje o maior agregador de ofertas de passagens aéreas promocionais do Brasil.Reserve direto com a companhia aérea. Sem agências, riscos ou taxas extras.
Somos um agregador de ofertas. Enviamos os dados da passagem e você compra diretamente com a companhia aérea, com toda a segurança.
Você paga o investimento no Viajants Pro com uma única passagem promocional encontrada. Vários assinantes conseguem economizar mais de R$ 5.000 em uma única viagem.
Monitoramos tanto passagens em dinheiro quanto promoções de emissão com milhas (Smiles, TudoAzul, Latam Pass). Vamos te enviar ambas as opções, você decide.
A maioria dos voos que filtramos possuem alguma relação com o Brasil, seja de origem ou destino. Você dificilmente irá receber alertas de voos como origem Bangkok e destino Delhi, por exemplo. Mas é possível encontrar voos de São Paulo > Delhi > Bangkok, e vice-versa.
Você tem a opção de alterar seus 5 aeroportos de origem, filtrar os destinos (nacional ou internacional) e escolher as cabines. Assim vai deixar mais assertivo seu alertas. Mas também pode pausar eles temporariamente, e retomar quando quiser, direto na área de membros.
Faça o teste, venha para o Viajants!

bluejetty:00142390:ios.description:
NOMO is now NOMO CAM. Except the name, everything else is still the same. We're announcing more NOMO apps soon and make the NOMO PRO membership more valueable. Please stay tuned.
Here are your new cameras! NOMO CAM was designed to help casual photographers to focus on taking pictures, instead of all the post-production retouches.
# AUTHENTIC CAMERAS
Tap on the yellow "Camera" button and the "Shop" button, you will find all the cameras that you can purchase, download and use.
After taking a picture, random analog presets -- including curves, grains, dust, light leak, vignette, sharpening, frames, etc. -- will be added to the image. It's just like what a real 35mm film camera does.
Press the double exposure button and take two photos for our fantastic "double exposure" effect. There are unlimited possibilities. Keep playing it to discover.
# NOMO PRO
We will continuously release new cameras. With a NOMO PRO membership, you can use them all unlimitedly. Meanwhile, we will announce exclusive membership-only cameras.
A NOMO PRO membership will activate exclusive pro tools, including importing photos, turning off the film development time of INS cameras, and other upcoming features.
# ABOUT SUBSCRIPTION
Subscription service conditions:
- NOMO PRO provides 1-year membership for you to purchase;
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase;
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period;
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period;
- The renewal price for 1-year membership is USD 24.99.
- You can manage your subscription and switch off the auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings after purchase;
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription to that publication;
- All personal data is handled under the terms and conditions of NOMO CAM’s privacy policy. More details can be found here:
https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/platform_service/20220620162325709/20220620162325709.html
https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/privacy/20220704103203877/20220704103203877.html

bluejetty:00074346:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00074346:ios.description:
Build your DFS lineups with a swipe.
Optimal DFS turns lineup building into a deck of cards. Every card is an optimized DraftKings Showdown or FanDuel Single Game lineup, best projected first. Swipe right to keep it, left to pass, then export your lineups straight to DraftKings or FanDuel. No spreadsheets. No guesswork. Just swipe.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Set your rules: how many lineups, how different they are, which stacks to allow and your salary range.
2. Swipe: every card is a legal lineup with its captain, projected points, salary, stack and exposure. Right keeps it, left passes.
3. Export: get an upload-ready file for DraftKings or FanDuel, checked before it's written.
SWIPE BUILDER
- Swipe a few, then tap Fill the rest to keep the next best lineups until your set is full.
- Choose your spacing: Diverse, Balanced or Top Projected.
- Leave out any stack, like 5-1 or 4-2, set a salary floor, and see how many lineups still fit.
- Lock a player into every lineup or out of all of them, as captain or flex.
- Edit any projection before you swipe.
- Track captain and player exposure as you go.
- Undo a swipe, or take a second look at the lineups you passed.
- Import your DraftKings entries file to fill every contest you've entered, then upload it on DraftKings' Edit Entries page.
CLASSIC OPTIMIZER
For classic slates, the optimizer builds up to 150 lineups in seconds.
- Lock, exclude and edit player projections.
- Set max exposures for players and roster spots.
- Stack your QB with RBs, WRs or TEs, and keep opponents away from your defense.
- Optimize for tournaments, and filter by injury status or projected starters.
- Export lineups to CSV for DraftKings or FanDuel, with lineup summaries and player exposures.
- Check spreads, totals and projected box scores for every game on the slate.
NEVER MISS A SLATE
Turn on notifications and we'll let you know when new slates and projections are ready to swipe, plus breaking news that moves lineups.
SUPPORTED SLATES
DraftKings: NFL, NBA and MLB Classic and Showdown
FanDuel: NFL, NBA and MLB Classic and Single Game
Optimal DFS is not affiliated with or endorsed by DraftKings or FanDuel.
____________________________
Optimal DFS is not responsible for any decisions made, financial or otherwise, based on information provided by this application. Optimal DFS cannot guarantee the correctness of the information contained within our application.
SUBSCRIPTION
- Unlock all Optimal DFS features with a subscription.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, at the cost of the renewal.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple Account settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
