bluejetty:00026992:ios.summary:
This game challenges your music knowledge, whether you're playing alone or competing with friends. All you need is an active Apple Music subscription.
Navigate your way to the top of the international leaderboards, engage in thrilling duel
bluejetty:00026992:ios.description:
This game challenges your music knowledge, whether you're playing alone or competing with friends. All you need is an active Apple Music subscription.
Navigate your way to the top of the international leaderboards, engage in thrilling duels, or outshine your friends in local multiplayer matches!
Explore a vast selection of playlists, pick your favorite and dive right in.
*Single Player*
In the Single Player mode you go for the top spots on the international leaderboards - You have to be correct, but also fast!
There are 5 modes to choose from: Guess the title, artist, release year or start at the beginning of the song. 
In the Bople mode you start with just 1 second. Can you name the title with only that small snippet?
You are shown four possible answers, but only one is correct.
*Multiplayer*
BopSesh: Only the host needs an Apple Music subscription! The others can download the app, join the session on their own device and use it as a remote. 
Select a playlist, start the game and tap the correct answer as quickly as possible.
Classic: This mode is designed for the couch, train rides, or any gathering where you have a few friends for a local showdown.
Simply input the names of your friends and rivals, set the rules, and kick off the game. Only one device needed!
A song plays, and the first person who knows the artist, the title, or both hits the buzzer. Quickly provide an answer and the leaderboard updates.
Play the songs and discover who holds the title of the ultimate music nerd among you!
*Duel*
Challenge a friend to an asynchronous match in the Duel mode. You take turns selecting and playing playlists. 
After five playlists, you can declare the champion - until the next duel begins!
If you'd like to support my work, please consider leaving a review or providing feedback.
But most importantly, enjoy the game!
BopQuiz offers subscriptions for the full access to all modes and features. 
You can choose between a monthly, yearly or lifetime purchase.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. 
Our terms of Use: https://bopquiz.app/terms/
Our Privacy Policy: https://bopquiz.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00185557:ios.summary:

F
bluejetty:00185557:ios.description:
Set course for the fairways of the world, but don’t expect an easy lie or to improve your golf swing! Get ready to play solitaire with a twist playing Fairway Solitaire, the card game that’s easy to pick up, but impossible to put down. 
Fairway Solitaire is the unique card game where solitaire and golf merge into an easy to play puzzle game. Simply play one card up or one card down from your draw pile to clear the puzzle board as you take on challenging solitaire puzzles on hand-painted, scenic golf courses from all around the world.
Fun and Easy to Play!
• Simply play one card up or one card down from your draw pile, it’s that easy!
• Stay on par by removing the most cards in each solitaire hand
• If you get stuck, select a golf club from your bag
• Expertly play like a pro through puzzling solitaire challenges, from rough hazards to sand traps and rain hazards 
Why Fairway Solitaire? 
• Play THOUSANDS OF COURSES in incredible locations all over the world
• Play with unique golf-themed BOOSTS to power-up your game
• Use STRATEGY to master the fairway
• Use irons and Midas Clubs as WILD CARDS to aide in your strategy, or POWER UPS like the Shuffle and Preview to solve puzzling card layouts.
• Enjoy over 1,000 solitaire levels and counting!
• Get swept away to different destinations in special week-long events
• Every weekend you’ll find amazing hand painted scenery to take you far away while staying in the comfort of your own home.
• Play Fairway Solitaire daily for events like Treasure Hunts, Pro Stars, and Stamp-edes!
• Play Fairway Solitaire for as long as you like; there are no lives or limits to your game play!
Earn rewards: 
• Complete daily challenges to earn rewards
• Win daily FREEBIES
• Get rewards through stamp collections, trophies, tours, mini-games, events or daily gifts!
• Collect adorable hand-drawn stamps and complete collections to earn rewards
• Enjoy fun mini-games like McDinko, Wild Shot, Long Drive Contest, and Gopher Derby.
Why not join a Country Club? 
• Join a club to earn EXCLUSIVE REWARDS and GIFTS each week
• Play with exclusive Fairway Solitaire Country Club players to earn exclusive rewards and gifts each week, just for playing on a team! 
• Complete exclusive Country Club stamp sets for even greater rewards 
• Use Chat to collaborate and strategize with your Club members in the game!
• Unlock new and exciting rewards!
• Play with a team to reach new goals!
• There are 4 Tiers of rewards to earn every week!
• No Gophers Allowed!
Don’t get left in the rough, follow us on Facebook for more Fairway Solitaire news, fun, and games: http://www.facebook.com/FairwaySolitaire
Experiencing issues? Please visit https://fairwaysolitaire.zendesk.com
* By downloading and using this app, you agree to the Terms of Use at http://www.bigfishgames.com/company/terms.html and acknowledge the Privacy Policy at http://www.bigfishgames.com/company/privacy.html.

Reliable and easy to use multiplatform baby monitor. Watch live video streaming of your baby and hear every noise on your phone or tablet.
Simplicity and quick use - this was our highest priority when developing this app. You could barely find such a simple device connection as Baby Monitor TEDDY has (there is no need to create account, in most cases it is not necessary to enter any code). - Live HD video streaming anywhere - you will not miss any detail
- Hear every noise & See every motion
- Talk to baby - soothe your baby easily from anywhere

bluejetty:00061913:ios.description:
With mBlock, students can easily create games, animations, and program robots by dragging and dropping blocks, or through writing Python. 
Moreover, mBlock comes with AI, IoT, data science features for cutting-edge computer science learning, making it the perfect helper for coding educators and learners.
Features: 
- Graphical programming: The app allows users to create projects with the most popular graphical programming language and program robots to do things as they can imagine. It makes programming as easy as blocks building. 
- Game-based learning: Children learn to code in completing tasks and know how it feels to accomplish something.     
- Cloud storage: Users can store their projects in the cloud, syncing the projects across devices. It’s safe and convenient. 
- Compatible with Makeblock robots: mBot, mBot Ranger, Codey Rocky, Neuron 
- Support multiple languages: Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Polish, and Korean.

bluejetty:00138433:ios.description:
Fishing has never been so easy! 
Hooked on real motion fishing! Everyone can catch monster fish with any cast! Grab your friends and cast a line in famous fishing spots like Key West and Pacific Ocean! Chill out in stunningly realistic nature scenes, catch over 100 species of fish, and become a Fishing Master!
Fishing Master is a 3D realistic fishing game for relaxation that's perfect for everyone. Cast your line and reel in over hundreds of different fish species with intuitive controls. Master various fishing techniques to catch monster fish and hidden golden treasures. Duel your friends for leadboard glory and claim the ultimate rewards!
【Realistic Visual Art Style】
Travel to realistic fishing spots like Caddo Lake, Key West, Pacific Ocean or Bering Sea. Catch rich species of fish from small to huge, like bassfish, catfish, marlin, and even monster shark, monster tuna, monster squid.
【Simple and Satisfying Mechanics】
Fishing-line throwing responds to motion control and with various engaging fishing techniques that are easy to learn. The casual gameplay is convenient for short gaming sessions and soothing for long gaming sessions.
【Rewarding and Relaxing Experience】
Addictive gameplay with various reward systems such as boxes and lucky wheels with achievements to hunt, fish collections to expand, and special fishing rods and abilities to upgrade.
【Thrilling Monster Fishing Mode】
Special events and rare opportunities can trigger raids and the appearance of special Monster fish that can be caught through effortless Quick Time Events.
【Real-Time Duels】
Match with players from around the world to compete in intense duels of skill and luck and climb the ranks of the global leaderboard as a Fishing Master.
Join now and become the very best Fishing Master!

bluejetty:00043424:ios.name: WhatsGPS
bluejetty:00043424:ios.summary: WhatsGPS is a global dynamic location service management platform driven by artificial intelligence, cloud computing, blockchain and big data technologies. It delivers comprehensive, one-stop IoT location solutions for government, enterpris
bluejetty:00043424:ios.description:
WhatsGPS is a global dynamic location service management platform driven by artificial intelligence, cloud computing, blockchain and big data technologies. It delivers comprehensive, one-stop IoT location solutions for government, enterprise and individual users worldwide.
The platform integrates the full workflow of information collection, intelligent analysis, data processing and visual presentation, enabling full linkage of personnel, equipment, data and information. With rich API interfaces, it supports access to diverse devices and meets personalized customization requirements of vertical industries.
Core Functions
Precise Positioning: Supports real-time high-precision positioning via Beidou/GPS, cellular base station and Wi-Fi with millisecond-level location updates.
Intelligent Early Warning: Delivers 23-dimensional full-scenario risk alerts with multi-channel notification push.
Track Playback: Cloud storage of historical tracks allows users to check vehicle travel records anytime.
Video Surveillance: Syncs video feeds with vehicle locations for real-time remote on-site monitoring.
Status Monitoring: Real-time monitoring of key vehicle statuses including start-stop, idling, temperature and fuel level.
Fence Management: Customizable electronic fences trigger instant alerts when vehicles enter or exit restricted areas.
Data Analysis: AI assistant for smart insights and multi-dimensional data analysis.
Remote Control: One-click remote command issuance enables convenient remote device operation.
Platform Features
SaaS Cloud Management: Multi-level account permission system features clear hierarchy and easy standardized management.
Component-based Scenario Service: Flexibly configurable scenario functions support customized solutions to fit diverse industrial needs.
Full Hardware Compatibility: Works with nearly 200 mainstream BeiDou/GPS trackers, plus sensors for infrared, fuel level, temperature & humidity, weight, and door status.
Easy Device Management: Full online lifecycle management for devices, covering import, sales and renewal services.
Global Multi-language Support: Available in 20+ major languages to serve global users and international use cases.
Private Brand Customization: Provides exclusive customization for domain names, logos, homepages and apps to build personalized brand images.
7×24 Professional Support: Round-the-clock professional technical customer service provides timely technical support.

Enemies storm the fortress from every direction, growing stronger and more coordinated with each wave. Your mission is to fortify the shifting maze corridors, build strategic defenses, and upgrade your arsenal to withstand the escalating pressure.

With relentless waves, evolving strategies, and high-velocity combat, Spiremaze: Defense Line delivers a thrilling defense experience where only sharp instincts and clever planning can secure victory.

bluejetty:00018282:ios.description:
Save money, invest, and budget automatically with Qapital – an app that makes financial decision-making easier on the brain.
Studying behavioral economics taught us that humans are simply not wired to process tradeoffs between spending now and saving for later. So, we put together a team of product experts and finance pros to build automated money management solutions that are simple to use and easy to stick with.
Start your 30-day free trial today. No hidden fees. No surprises.
*****
Qapital helps you to put away a little bit every week. It’s the easiest way to save for things like: presents, birthdays, vacations, and emergency funds.
1. Set unlimited money saving goals
Set as many goals as you’d like, personalize them, move money to them automatically, and track your progress as you go.
2. Budget with smart rules
Qapital transfers money from your checking account to Qapital savings using the rules you set. We help you build rules around habits you already have. That way, you can save when you buy a treat, or go for a run.
3. Save money & invest in ETFs
Automatically set money aside for savings and investing goals when you get paid, when you shop, or whenever works best for you.
4. Spend smarter
Set money aside for weekly spending with the Qapital Visa® debit card. Shop anywhere Visa® is accepted, get cash from ATMs world-wide, and get notified when you’re close to your weekly budget.
5. Invite a partner and team up on your goals
Qapital Dream Team™ lets you save toward shared goals and see one another’s transactions without giving up your individual accounts. You decide what’s shared and what’s private, always.
*****
Qapital is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Checking account provided by Lincoln Savings Bank, Member FDIC. Visa® debit card issued by Lincoln Savings Bank, Member FDIC. Deposit insurance covers the failure of an insured bank.
Advisory services provided by Qapital Invest, LLC, an SEC-registered investment advisor. Brokerage services provided to Qapital Invest clients by either (i) Apex Clearing Corporation, an SEC-registered broker-dealer and member FINRA/SIPC or (ii) Wedbush Securities Inc., an SEC-registered broker-dealer and member FINRA/SIPC.
Qapital will deduct a monthly membership fee after any applicable free trial ends and you connect a bank account. Current membership fees can be found at https://www.qapital.com/pricing.
For full details, see Qapital’s Terms and Conditions (https://www.qapital.com/terms/) and Privacy Policy (https://www.qapital.com/terms/privacy-policy/).

Award-winning Fitness and Pilates Instructor, Cassey Ho (Blogilates) has put together
bluejetty:00145427:ios.description:
Welcome to the official Blogilates App, complete with free workouts, challenges, a social community, and a place to log your fitness and wellness journey.
Award-winning Fitness and Pilates Instructor, Cassey Ho (Blogilates) has put together all of her best workout videos in one sleek app so you can take her with you anywhere!
APP FEATURES
1. Monthly Workout Calendar
The Blogilates Workout Calendar is a monthly exercise plan designed to help you get lean, toned, and strong at home using the Blogilates workout videos. Every day you will focus on a different muscle group, so that by the end of the week, you'll have worked your total body! Rest days, cardio days, and strength days are all scheduled in for you. Fresh plans at the beginning of EVERY month!
2. Motivational Challenges
- 100 Ab Challenge: 30 days of different ab exercises to flatten your abs and strengthen your core!
- 100 Glute Challenge: 30 days of unique butt lifting exercises to round and shape your booty!
+ more!
Each challenge comes with daily follow-along workout videos so you will always have Cassey there to push you through to the finish line!
3. Complete Workout Video Library all castable to TV!
It's the entire Blogilates workout video library in your pocket. Full length videos. No ads. There are hundreds of workouts that will target:
Abs, Arms, Back, Butt, Cardio, Legs, Stretch & Total Body
4. Embark on your own 90 Day Journey®!
Set your goal, journal daily, and track your mood, food, sleep, energy, water, bloat and more! Journeys is designed to help you get to know your body better. With charts that dig into your body's patterns, you'll be able to figure out what's working and not working and tweak your journey as you go.
5. Personal Progress Profile
You will be able to track how dedicated you've been to your workout calendar and your challenges. Seeing your stats and badges earned will help motivate you to stay accountable and not fall off track!
6. Social Community
A safe space to share progress, trade tips, swap POPFLEX, get motivated, and make friends. Broken down by topics, imagine an old school forum but with the feel of a social media platform. You can even DM each other!
FREE TO DOWNLOAD
The Body by Blogilates app is 100% free to download! You will have immediate access to the entire workout video library and will be able to do any workout you wish!
7-DAY FREE TRIAL
If you want access to the monthly workout calendar AND all of the challenges, sign up for a 7-day free trial!
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS:
Body by Blogilates is free to download. Ongoing use of full access features require an active subscription, available on a monthly or yearly basis. Customers who choose a monthly or yearly subscription are eligible for a free 7-day trial period. The subscription cost will be charged afterwards.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your iTunes account will be charged for each new payment period within 24 hours of current subscription's expiration. Subscriptions may be managed by the user & auto-renewal may be turned off in the user's Account Settings after purchase. You can disable automatic renewal via iTunes account settings at any time.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.blogilates.com/body-by-blogilates-terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.blogilates.com/body-by-blogilates-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00077270:ios.description:

From everyday looks to formal outfits, shop what’s next in Korea — fast, diverse, and trendy.
■ Why MUSINSA
- Top Korean brands: From streetwear to globally known brands — all in one app.
- Real-time trend: New arrivals, capsule collections, and editor picks updated regularly.
- Do not miss these special promotions : Members' Day, Black Friday, Monster Sale, and season-off deals that you can’t find elsewhere.
- Verified reviews: Fit, fabric, and styling tips from real shoppers.
- Smart search & filters: Size, silhouette, color, occasion, and price — find your needs in seconds.
- Check out real reviews from fashion lovers around the world, now available in your language.

- Curations for every purpose: Minimal, street, sporty, modern, Y2K, formal, office, outdoor & athleisure all included.
- Style Boards: Save items, build outfits, and share looks with friends.
- Personalized feed: Follow brands and creators you love; get alerts on restocks and new drops.
- Complete the looks: One-tap bundles that pair tops, bottoms, outerwear, and sneakers.
- App-exclusive perks: Early access to drops, members-only prices, and limited gifts.

- Members' Day: 30% off, 3x points, exclusive deals only for three days.

- Monster Sale: Up to 95% off on selected items for the season.
- App exclusive coupons: Activate in one tap on product pages or at checkout.

- Order tracking: Real-time status from purchase to delivery.

- Duties & taxes info provided transparently.

bluejetty:00078349:ios.description:
Jigsawpad is the first jigsaw puzzle app specifically designed for iPad players! Playing in landscape mode for a wide view that provides an authentic, near true-to-life puzzling experience.
We handpick every stunning image across over 10,000 free puzzles to ensure supreme visual quality. Experience Jigsawpad like never before! Relax and enjoy the vast, sublime collection of landscape puzzles and dive into this beautiful jigsaw world.
SPECIFICALLY DESIGNED FOR IPAD
• Landscape mode gives more space for content. Better view, better game experience.
• 4:3 aspect ratio lends a natural, authentic photo look and feel.
• Symmetrical interface enhances comfort during extended playsessions.
• Apple Pencil compatibility enables precise and engaging interactions through pressure sensitivity, from light touches to deep presses.
• Pencil mode. Specially designed for iPad, use the pencil to select multiple pieces and move them together for the most satisfying puzzle experience.
FEATURES
Enjoy a diverse selection of vibrant, high-resolution images that guarantee an unparalleled puzzle pleasure.
• Classic jigsaw gameplay
• Simple controls make it easy to solve puzzles
• 48 to 432-piece puzzles suits all skill levels
• Over 10,000 stunning images curated for visual excellence
• Soothing Dark Mode for nighttime relaxation
• A new FREE puzzle every day.
• Exclusive beautiful puzzle packs
• New Pack released each week
• Auto-save maintains progression
Jigsawpad is dedicated to sparking joy, relaxation, and brain-boosting entertainment for all ages. Escape into nostalgia with this iPad jigsaw puzzle app. Assemble vibrant landscapes, adorable animals, or scenes from beloved films—all optimized for the immersive iPad touchscreen. Intuitive controls allow you to smoothly snap pieces into place. Feel tangible stress melt away as you correctly place each piece, gradually revealing breathtaking images worthy of any wall. From fun family nights to solo self-care sessions, feed your craving for wholesome, screen-free engagement with 10,000+ puzzles spanning topics you love. Download now and enjoy jigsaw excitement perfected just for you! Your inner child, and your inner artist, will thank you!

bluejetty:00039666:ios.description:
Налоги 2023: проверка и оплата налогов физических лиц по ИНН. Информация обо всех налогах на Едином налоговом счете:
— Транспортный налог
— Налог на имущество
— Земельный налог
— Налог на доходы
— Налог на медицинское страхование
— Взносы на медицинское страхование
— Взносы на пенсионное страхование
— Налог на патент
Проверка налогов по ИНН или УИН (указан в квитанции из налоговой).
Оплата налогов онлайн картами VISA, MasterCard, Maestro и МИР.
Банковские квитанции об уплате налогов.
Уведомления о долгах по налогам в приложении и по электронной почте.
Клиентская поддержка пользователей.
Обратите внимание:
Налоги, начисленные за 2022 год, необходимо оплатить до 1 декабря 2023 года. В случае несвоевременной уплаты за каждый день просрочки начисляются пени.
Через приложение вы можете найти и оплатить следующие налоги: налог на транспорт, имущественный налог, земельный налог, налог на доходы, налог на медицинское страхование, взносы на медицинское страхование, взносы на пенсионное страхование, налог на патент, пени за несвоевременную оплату налогов (если они у вас есть).
Оплатить налог 2023 можно по УИН (он указан в квитанции из налоговой). Если вы не получили квитанцию, вы сможете найти и оплатить налог по ИНН после 1 декабря 2023 года. До 1 декабря по ИНН находятся долги за прошлые годы.
Что такое Единый налоговый счет?
Это счет, на котором собираются задолженности гражданина или компании перед бюджетом: налоги, взносы, пени, штраф и проценты. Когда налогоплательщик гасит эти долги, это также отражается на счете.
Не знаете УИН или нет квитанции из налоговой?
Если у вас нет квитанции за 2022 год из ФНС, проверьте налоги по ИНН сейчас (вы узнаете, нет ли у вас долгов по налогам за прошлые годы) и после 1 декабря (по ИНН найдется налог за 2022 год).
Помощь
Если вам нужна помощь, напишите нам на support@avtonalogi.ru, будем рады помочь.
Оплата налогов осуществляется НКО “МОНЕТА.РУ” (ООО). Лицензия ЦБ РФ №3508-К от 2 июля 2012 года. Не является официальным приложением ФНС.

• Practice mode with stroke-by-stroke guidance

• Progress tracking

bluejetty:00018774:ios.description:
Exchanging cash and credit cards to pay your tab or restaurant bill is so 2019. Rooam is a contactless payment solution allowing you to open, view and pay your tab directly from your phone. Simply put, less time waiting in line, or waiting for your server, means more time enjoying your night out!
How it works:
1. Download Rooam and create your account
2. Select your location
3. Press "Open Tab." Your tab is now open at the bar or restaurant. Order with the bartender or server, and say you're using Rooam. You'll see a live update of each item you order on the app. Once you're ready to go, select your tip and press "Close Tab." That's it! Your bills paid.
Paying with Rooam is simple:
• Select your tip with one tap
• Connect Apple Pay in seconds
• View your order history and itemized receipts at any time
Why people love it:
• Rooam is trusted by music venues, bars, & restaurants you know and love.
• Refer your friends and get $5 off your next tab
• 24/7 customer support available right inside the app.
• Forgot to close your tab? No worries, just open the Rooam app and close it from your home. No need to go back.
Why businesses love it:
• Highest level of PCI Compliance.
• Bartenders are fast, but counting cash and running cards is not. Let your staff focus on what they do best, serving drinks, and entertaining guests.
Interested in accepting Rooam at your location? Please email us business@rooam.co with your contact information or head to www.rooam.co/business for more details.
Follow Rooam and get free tickets to acts, festivals, and even free tabs:
• Instagram: https://instagram.com/rooam
• Facebook: https://facebook.com/rooam
• Twitter: https://twitter.com/rooam
Have a question? Send us feedback: help@rooam.co

bluejetty:00161430:ios.name: Trucker and Trucks
bluejetty:00161430:ios.summary:
Welcome to the exciting world of cargo transportation!
Hit the road in a new 2D trucking simulator from the creator of the popular games Bad Trucker and Best Trucker.
Wide selection of vehicles:
Drive powerful trucks with different specs
bluejetty:00161430:ios.description:
Welcome to the exciting world of cargo transportation!
Hit the road in a new 2D trucking simulator from the creator of the popular games Bad Trucker and Best Trucker.
Wide selection of vehicles:
Drive powerful trucks with different specs — from highway haulers for urban deliveries to off-road beasts. Choose the right trailers for each cargo type, whether it’s construction materials, cars, or oversized goods.
Diverse routes and cargo:
Transport valuable goods across various locations — from remote country roads to challenging mountain paths. Every route is a new challenge: watch the road and avoid losing your cargo!
Truck upgrades and maintenance:
Improve your vehicle to handle tougher jobs. Upgrade the engine, suspension, fuel system, and tires to boost off-road capability and load capacity. Don’t forget to repair and refuel on time — a breakdown mid-route could ruin your delivery!
Useful tips for successful hauls:
1. Monitor fuel and avoid wasteful driving.
2. Pick the right truck and trailer for each job.
3. Avoid rough roads if your truck isn’t equipped for off-roading.
4. Don’t lose cargo — or you’ll have to restart!
5. If stuck, call a tow truck.
6. Mind cargo dimensions during loading.
Prove you’re a true professional! Only the most persistent and attentive drivers will earn the title of Master Trucker!
Why try it?
1. Realistic physics accounting for cargo weight and terrain.
2. Tons of cargo, trucks, and locations for long-term gameplay.
3. Deep upgrade and repair system.
4. Perfect for truck enthusiasts of all ages.
5. Modern graphics and engaging gameplay.
6. Free and accessible to everyone!

bluejetty:00155883:ios.summary: Eagle Federal is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by
bluejetty:00155883:ios.description:
Eagle Federal is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Eagle Federal:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
-Transfer money between your accounts.
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
-View and save your monthly statements.
-Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Eagle Federal app, you must be enrolled as an Eagle Louisiana FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00091734:ios.name: Magic Hour
bluejetty:00091734:ios.summary: Magic Hour (also called golden hour) is the time of day around sunrise and sunset when the light is great for photography and cinematography. It is typically when the sun is between 6 degrees below the horizon to 6 degrees above. This sunli
bluejetty:00091734:ios.description:
Magic Hour (also called golden hour) is the time of day around sunrise and sunset when the light is great for photography and cinematography. It is typically when the sun is between 6 degrees below the horizon to 6 degrees above. This sunlight is evenly dispersed and helps you create great pictures.
Magic Hour makes it easy for you to know when magic hour is coming and how much time you have left once it begins. The app takes your location along with the current day and calculates when magic hour will occur. If the weather forecast is available we give that to you as well.
What other light is cool to photograph in? The moon, of course. And you want a full moon for that. Our Moon Watch section lets you know the next moonrise and when the next full moon will appear. 
In addition to this, you can set up notifications on and before magic hour begins. And with our in-app purchase you can select locations other than your current one, view future magic hour times, and create calendar events for them.
Data that is used with the Magic Hour App (e.g. locations, notifications, calendar events, etc.) remain local to your device and are not transmitted nor remotely stored.

bluejetty:00169676:ios.description:
Introducing the HIGH Fitness app: Your one-stop-shop and virtual gateway to exhilarating group exercise workouts!
With three dynamic formats to choose from, and three ways to join in — whether it's Live Stream, On-Demand, or In-Person — there’s fresh new content every week. No matter your fitness level, there's something tailored for everyone.
Experience the flagship HIGH format — a vibrant fusion of high-energy, high-intensity workouts synced to your favorite tunes. Engage in exhilarating high-intensity training sessions that'll leave you pumped and energized.
Looking for a lower impact option? Enter LOW — a captivating blend of high-energy cardio with a focus on reduced impact and steady-state movements. Expect the same infectious energy, electrifying music, and fun-filled routines.
Unwind and rejuvenate with YO — our innovative group stretch class designed to make stretching enjoyable. Groove to music spanning genres and decades while you lengthen and strengthen your body in this no-impact workout.
No equipment or prior experience needed. Join live sessions or access on-demand classes led by top-notch instructors nationwide, all from the comfort of your home. Or, looking for in-person classes near you? Use our class finder to locate instructors nearby and drop in on a class! Prepare for an unparalleled workout experience filled with fun and excitement.
Plus, take advantage of the all-new HIGH Lifestyle community feature packed with exciting new content every week. Podcasts, blogs, forums, event tickets, discount codes to HIGH Fitness apparel, and other preferred brands, and so much more.
SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING TERMS
We offer 2 premium subscription plans: Monthly (1 month)or Annual (12 months). Unless canceled or auto-renew is turned off 24-hours before the end of subscription term or the 7-day trial period, you will be billed automatically based on your chosen subscription plan at the end of the free trial or on your subscription renewal date.
Manage your subscription and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase or trial start. 
Read full Terms of Service at: https://app.getterms.io/view/05jRl/tos/en-us
and Privacy Policy at: https://app.getterms.io/view/05jRl/privacy/en-us

bluejetty:00200073:ios.description:
Hi, I’m Berry, a filter creator from South Korea.
Some of you may know me from Instagram as @berryveryloveyou.
Many of the filters I once shared on social media are now gone—
but I wanted to preserve the soft tones I’ve created over the past 5 years.
That’s why I built this space: BerryFilm.
New filters will be added regularly.
Natural skin tone effects and soft light features are also in the works.
Please enjoy the filters I’ve poured my heart into.
--
Features
- Soft and subtle Korean-style filters
From airy milk tones to cool, warm, and vintage moods—
you’ll find filters that bring out your natural atmosphere.
- Photos and videos in your favorite tone
Transform your gallery into a soft, aesthetic feed
with gentle color correction and minimalist touch.
- Simple, quiet, and easy to use
Apply filters with one tap, save favorites,
and shoot with a silent shutter—anytime, anywhere.
- New filters every month
Always something new, designed to match the season or your mood.
- Built with feedback from real users
We’re constantly improving the app through your suggestions.
--
Recommended For
- Fans of Berry’s Instagram filters
- Anyone looking for soft, natural Korean-style filters
- Users who love subtle selfies without heavy edits
- Those who enjoy discovering new filters each month
--
Included Filters
Featuring over 40 carefully designed filters like
milk, iPhone 7, butter, cool, warm, and blossom —
with more coming soon.
--
Contact & Sharing
Tag @seesun.app on Instagram to share your photos.
For questions or feedback, feel free to DM or email us.
Email: seesunapp@gmail.com
Instagram: @berryfilm.app

bluejetty:00060941:ios.description:
Like a personal secretary at your fingertips, Bookedin takes care of all of your time-consuming appointment booking tasks. The simple to set up, easy-to-use appointment booking system that’ll take your business to the next level! Everything you and your team need to get booked solid, save time, reduce stress, and impress your clients.
POWERFUL APPOINTMENT SCHEDULER
• Secure & private appointment app for you & your staff
• Easily adjust availability: block time off, schedule lunch breaks, set business hours, service hours
• One-time & recurring appointment booking & class scheduling
• Easily add video conferencing to any appointment or service (ex. Zoom)
• Attach files & photos to appointments 
• Handy notifications for new appointments, payments, cancellations
• Invite staff to log in with different levels of access 
EASY ONLINE APPOINTMENT BOOKING
• Branded online booking link for your clients. Ex: bookedin.com/book/my-business
• Get booked on Facebook or Instagram 
• Profile photo, logo & colors
• Easily share via Email, Text, WhatsApp, etc.
• Clients don’t need to download the app or remember a password
• Directory listing for your business
• Block unwanted clients
APPOINTMENT CONFIRMATIONS & REMINDERS
• Automated text & email reminders
• Clients can confirm or cancel appointment via email or text
• Unlimited email messages sent
• Text appointment reminders & booking confirmations
PAYMENT COLLECTION
• Eliminate no-shows! Collect deposit payments when clients book classes & schedule appointments online
• Clients pay via debit, credit card, PayPal or Venmo
• Automatic payment receipts
• Works with Stripe, Square, or PayPal
CLIENT HISTORY & DATABASE
• Track client list, profiles & write private notes
• Appointment & payment history
• Click to call, text or email clients directly
• Private, secure & continuously backed up data
ADDITIONAL FEATURES
• Web appointment calendar & manager: month, week, day, team split views
• Custom form fields for scheduling appointments
• Custom reminder emails & automated follow ups
• Appointment booking reports
• Attach files to send automatically after clients book
• Import / export client list
• Cancellation policy
• Website booking button & calendar integration
• 2-way personal calendar sync: Google, iCloud, Outlook, Office365, Microsoft Exchange
• Client email invoicing
• Automatic refund for canceled appointments
Enjoy all Pro Bookedin features & unlimited appointment booking FREE for 14 days! Or choose Bookedin's basic free plan with limited features & bookings.
NEED HELP?
Web: support.bookedin.com
Email: support@bookedin.net
In-app: Settings > Support > Request phone call
TESTIMONIALS:

A re-imagined experience for Seattle Sports fans. Watch or listen to live talk shows, get podcasts and on-demand moments, and read the latest news.
Seattle Sports is the radio home of the Seattle Seahawks and Seattle Mariners, in addition to a wide variety of local sports talk programming. Hosts include Brock Huard, Mike Salk, Michael Bumpus, Stacy Rost, Bob Stelton, and Dave Wyman. 
SEATTLE SPORTS
Listen or watch for free, anytime of day with crystal clear audio quality. 
Catch live game broadcasts from the Seattle Seahawks and Seattle Mariners.* 
On-DEMAND 
Missed a show? No problem.
Watch highlights, listen to podcasts from all your favorite shows, and pick up where you left off. Share video Shorts, interviews, and podcast episodes with your friends. 
NEWS 
Get the latest updates on the Seattle Seahawks, Seattle Mariners, Seattle Kraken, UW Huskies, WSU Cougars, and more. Stay up to date with breaking news and get inside analysis from Seattle Sports 710 AM experts on the game. 
ALERTS
Turn on notifications to get breaking news, game updates, and must-see moments as they happen.
INTERACT 
Be part of the conversation. Connect with the shows via text, voice message, social media, or email. Share your love for Seattle teams with others who share your same passion. 
Join our community! 
Facebook: /SeattleSports710 
Instagram: @seattlesports710 
Twitter: @SeattleSports 
YouTube: /SeattleSports710 
Website: seattlesports.com 
About Bonneville 
Bonneville Seattle is part of the Bonneville International family, which is an integrated media and marketing solutions company dedicated to building up, connecting, informing and celebrating families and communities. Founded in 1964, Bonneville currently operates radio and TV stations, local websites, chart topping podcasts and other digital distribution assets in six western U.S. markets. Headquartered in Salt Lake City, Bonneville is a subsidiary of Deseret Management Corporation (DMC), a for-profit arm of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Visit https://bonneville.com/ to learn more. For a full list of our markets and digital assets, please visit https://bonneville.com/markets/

CEC Laundry Pay is an iPhone application providing the easiest and smartest complete laundry solution. This app allows you to pay for laundry cycles from your account by using Bluetooth to communicate with the washer or dryer.
Simply use CEC Laundry Pay to purchase credit right from the app, then use that credit for your laundry. A full accounting is available to see your transaction purchase history.
• Scan the QR code of your laundry room (one time process)

bluejetty:00140494:ios.description:
Experience the challenge of clearing traffic jams and solving parking puzzles in Bus Rush: Car Parking Games.
This puzzle game combines bus parking mechanics, traffic jam puzzles, and passenger sorting gameplay into a strategic and relaxing experience. Plan your moves carefully, match passengers to the correct vehicles, and clear crowded parking lots step by step.
Stuck in traffic puzzles that feel repetitive?
Many parking and traffic games quickly become predictable and repetitive.
Bus Jam introduces a dynamic traffic puzzle system where every level presents a different parking challenge. Vehicles block each other, passengers wait for the correct ride, and every move affects the flow of traffic.
By analyzing the situation and moving vehicles in the right order, you gradually clear the jam and restore order to the parking lot.
Looking for a puzzle game that challenges strategy and logic?
Some casual games rely mostly on speed or random mechanics.
Bus Jam focuses on planning and logical thinking. Each level requires you to evaluate the parking layout, match passengers with the correct buses or cars, and ensure vehicles can exit the lot without creating new traffic blocks.
The result is a puzzle experience that rewards patience, observation, and strategy.
Need an offline puzzle game for short breaks?
Many mobile games require a constant internet connection.
Bus Jam is designed to be an offline parking puzzle game, allowing you to play anytime without Wi-Fi. Whether you are commuting, traveling, or simply relaxing at home, you can enjoy solving traffic jams and clearing parking puzzles.
Short levels make it easy to play during quick breaks while still providing meaningful challenges.
How the Bus Jam Puzzle Works
Observe the parking layout and traffic blocks.
Match passengers with the correct buses or cars based on color.
Move vehicles in the correct order to clear paths.
Solve the traffic jam and complete the parking puzzle.
Each level introduces new layouts and more complex traffic situations, encouraging players to think carefully before making a move.
Key Gameplay Features
Strategic Parking Puzzles
Solve increasingly complex parking situations where buses and cars block each other.
Passenger Sorting Mechanics
Match passengers to the correct vehicles and manage the flow of people leaving the parking area.
Challenging Traffic Jam Levels
Each level introduces new parking layouts that require careful planning and problem solving.
Colorful 3D Environments
Smooth animations and vibrant vehicle designs make each traffic puzzle easy to read and satisfying to complete.
Offline Gameplay
Play anytime without an internet connection, making it ideal for travel or short breaks.
Regular Updates
New levels, vehicles, and seasonal events are introduced to keep the puzzle experience fresh.
Why Players Enjoy Bus Jam
Bus Jam combines parking puzzles, traffic management, and sorting mechanics into a single casual puzzle experience. The gameplay is easy to understand but becomes increasingly strategic as levels progress.
Players can gradually improve their problem-solving skills while enjoying relaxing puzzle sessions that can be played anytime.
Continuous Improvements
The development team regularly updates Bus Jam based on player feedback. New parking puzzles, vehicles, and event challenges are introduced to keep the gameplay engaging and varied.
Additional features such as accessibility options and improved puzzle balance are added over time to make the experience more enjoyable for all players.
Download Bus Rush: Car Parking Games and start solving traffic jams, clearing parking lots, and mastering strategic parking puzzles today.

bluejetty:00096676:ios.description:
Tricky Blocks is a clean, satisfying physics stacker where you build as high as you dare. Drag from a tray of three blocks, choose any order, and place at your own pace—no time pressure. A smart shadow preview shows valid snap spots before you drop, so every placement feels fair, tactile, and oh-so-addictive.
Why you’ll love it
No timer, no rush: Always get 3 blocks to pick from—play thoughtfully, not frantically.
Satisfying physics: Real weight, friction, and wobbles as pieces settle into place.
Smart snapping & ghost: See exactly where your block will fit—clean, readable, and precise.
Three lives: Mistakes happen; run out of hearts and it’s game over.
Crisp 2D look: Bright blocks with subtle outlines and a camera that rises with your tower.
Punchy feedback: Optional haptics and juicy SFX for perfect drops and close saves.
How to play
1. Pick any block from your tray of three.
2. Aim—the shadow shows a valid snap location.
3. Drop and watch it settle.
4. Keep stacking to reach new heights without toppling.
Build tall, build smart, and master the art of the perfect drop in Tricky Blocks.

bluejetty:00041782:ios.description:
MIDITrail is a MIDI player which provides 3D visualization of MIDI data sets.
You can enjoy not only listening but also viewing.
MIDITrail supports Standard MIDI File (format 0/1), CoreMIDI, and multiple MIDI ports.
MIDITrail is available for Windows, macOS and iOS.
Optional feature: You can enjoy the VR(virtual reality) experience using cheap VR glasses for smartphones and the game controller for iPhone.
Requirements: iOS 12.0 or later
(1) Preparing MIDI files
You have to transfer MIDI files to your iOS device from Mac or PC.
Connect your iOS device to Mac or PC, and launch iTunes.
Then you can transfer MIDI files using 'File Sharing'.
Or you can add MIDI files to MIDITrail using Files App of iOS.
(2) Preparing Sound module
You can use sound module which supports Core MIDI. And you can use internal wavetable synthesizer.
There are three ways as shown below:
The first way is to use the internal wavetable synthesizer. You have to transfer the wavetable file (DLS/SF2) to your iOS device in advance.
The second way is to use Synth App which supports 'Virtual MIDI Port' and 'Background Mode'. (e.g., KQ Sampei, bs-16i, Sound Canvas for iOS)
The third way is to connect MIDI interface device and external sound module. (e.g., CME U2MIDI Pro)

bluejetty:00080688:ios.description:
Enter a relaxing cat-themed avatar world where you can explore different locations, customize characters, decorate spaces, and create your own daily-life stories.
In Lovely Cat World: Avatar Life, every scene is open for interaction. Move characters, arrange items, unlock hidden details, and discover how each location connects with the rest of the town. From cozy apartments to lively public spaces, you can shape your own version of cat town life at your own pace.
【Explore A Rich Cat Town】
Visit a variety of interactive locations, including cat apartments, clothing shops, accessory stores, greenhouses, stations, and more. Each area is filled with objects to move, characters to place, and small details to discover.
New areas continue to expand the world, bringing fresh ways to explore and create stories.
【New Scenes To Discover】
Step into the Police Station and explore the reception desk, archive area, office rooms, and lost-and-found corner. Arrange characters, check different props, and create your own town-service stories.
Celebrate in the Second Anniversary Area, a special scene with themed decorations, event items, photo spots, and festive outfits.
Visit the School Dormitory, where characters can relax, organize personal spaces, and interact with shared rooms, lockers, beds, desks, and daily-life items.
Spend time in the Library, browse shelves, arrange reading corners, unlock quiet hidden spaces, and create calm story moments.
Enter the Game Hall to explore arcade machines, prize counters, lounge areas, and interactive entertainment props.
Design your own space in the **DIY House**, where you can place furniture, adjust room styles, decorate interiors, and build a personalized home for your characters.
【Customize Your Cat Characters】
Create your own cat avatars with different appearances, outfits, accessories, shoes, hairstyles, wings, and more. Mix and match hundreds of fashion pieces to build unique looks for every character.
You can also design original characters from head to tail, then bring them into different scenes across the world.
【Create Your Own Stories】
There is no fixed path. You decide where characters go, what they wear, which rooms they visit, and what kind of story happens next.
Open cabinets, move props, combine items, explore hidden corners, and discover small surprises throughout the world. Every location offers new possibilities for roleplay, decoration, collection, and discovery.
Download Lovely Cat World: Avatar Life now and start building your own cat-themed avatar world.

bluejetty:00158423:ios.description:
Sunrent- шеринг электросамокатов, велосипедов и другого электротранспорта. 
Ваш друг в быстром передвижении по городу.
Мы делаем Sunrent, чтобы ты передвигался по своим делам с комфортом и без пробок! Открой свободу передвижения вместе с нами!
КАК ЭТО РАБОТАЕТ
С помощью бесплатного приложения можно управлять всем, что угодно (кроме управления самокатом, конечно).
В два клика регистрируйся на сайте.
Найдите на карте в приложении ближайший самокат. 
Отсканируйте QR-код на самокате для его разблокировки. 
Отслеживайте ход поездки: время в пути, скорость, зоны аренды и другую важную информацию. Завершите поездку на парковке, обозначенной на карте символом "Р". 
После этого самокат будет готов к использованию другим пользователем.
ДИДЖИТАЛ
В приложении имеются функция бесплатного бронирования, страхования на время поездки, и мультиаренда - вы сможете арендовать несколько самокатов с одного аккаунта. 
Приложение поможете вам на каждом этапе. 
Для нас важно, чтобы поездки на электротранспорте были безопасными и захватывающими, а сервис- понятным и безупречным.
КАТАЙТЕСЬ БЕЗОПАСНО
Мы озаботимся о наших пользователях и остальных участниках дорожного движения, поэтому просим вас внимательно проходить обучение в мобильном приложении.
Используйте велосипедные дорожки, там, где они доступны.
Соблюдайте правила дорожного движения и проявляйте уважение к окружающим.
ЧТО ЕЩЁ КРУТО:
скорость до 25 км/ч
яркий фонарь для поездок в темное время
полного заряда хватает до 3х часов в пути
не нужно самостоятельно заряжать самокат
с вождением легко справится любой совершеннолетний,
GPS-трекинг и подробная статистика поездки,
поминутная аренда, подписки и абонементы,
все парковки для самокатов отмечены на карте в приложении.
НА СВЯЗИ
В приложении наша поддержка на связи 24/7.
Актуальные новости в наших социальных сетях!
Поехали?!

bluejetty:00023059:ios.description:
A2Z is the complete contact manager! With A2Z, you can easily create, edit, and delete contacts & groups. Send mass texts and group emails. View recently created contacts. Share or print your contacts. Create backups. Get birthday notifications. And so much more:
CONTACTS: 
• View all of your contacts organized by account or group
• Easily find a contact with A2Z's powerful search tool
• Select multiple contacts and perform a number of actions including text, email, share, and delete
• Quickly perform a number of functions with one touch directly from the contact card
GROUPS: 
• Create groups of contacts from any account including iCloud, Google, Exchange or Outlook
• Filter contacts by one or more groups at the same time
• Add & remove contacts from a particular group
• Add & remove groups from a particular contact
FAVORITES: 
• Create a list of favorites allowing you to quickly call/message/email those contacts
GROUP EMAILS & MESSAGES: 
• Send messages to groups via iMessage, SMS, & WhatsApp
• Send emails to groups via Mail App or Gmail App
• Attach photos & documents, including from Dropbox
• Assign the to/cc/bcc email field to each contact individually
• Give your message a personal touch - Automatically refer to each contact by name
COMPANIES, BIRTHDAYS, ANNIVERSARIES, MOST VIEWED, RECENTLY CREATED/MODIFIED/DELETED:
• Sort your contacts by company name
• View upcoming birthdays & anniversaries
• View your most frequently viewed contacts
• View recently created & modified contacts
• View & restore your recently deleted contacts
SHARE CONTACTS:
• Share one or more contacts via text message, email, or various other services
• Export contacts in the CSV or vCard format
DELETE CONTACTS & GROUPS:
• Quickly delete contacts & groups
BACKUP:
• Create a backup of any contact account
• Restore your backup to any contact account
CLONE CONTACTS & GROUPS:
• Clone a contact from the contact card screen including all contact fields & groups
• Clone a group so you don't have to add all of the group members manually
START SCREEN:
• Specify whether the app should load the contacts, groups, or favorites screen at startup
SHORTCUTS:
• Press & hold a contact or group to conveniently perform a number of common functions
SYNC CONTACTS WITH GOOGLE:
• Fully compatible with the "Contacts Sync" app
WORKS WELL WITH OTHER CONTACT APPS:
• Any contact changes you make with this app will be reflected in any other contact app that queries the iPhone address book (including the standard Contacts & Phone app)
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
• A2Z Contacts offers a "Premium" subscription which unlocks all of the premium features in the app, including unrestricted group emails and texts, unrestricted sharing of contacts, and access to future premium features.
• The "Premium" subscription is priced at $0.99 USD and the subscription length is 1 year
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at a cost of $0.99 USD
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00129174:ios.description:
Magnifier is a simple and free tool that helps you see small text, numbers, fine details, and facial features using your iPhone’s front or rear camera.
Easy-to-Use Zoom Bar
Magnifier features a straightforward zoom bar—just drag to zoom in or out. Its intuitive design makes it one of the easiest magnifier apps to use, perfect for daily tasks that require clarity and precision.
Built-in Flashlight
Unlike many magnifying apps, Magnifier includes a flashlight that can be turned on or off with a single tap. This makes reading and magnifying easy even in low-light environments.
Capture Images
Use Magnifier as a zoom camera to quickly take photos. You can also apply stylish filters to enhance your images—great for sharing on social media.
Magnifying Mirror
Switch to the front camera to use Magnifier as a mirror. It's handy for applying makeup, checking your appearance, or experimenting with different looks.
Key Features
- Zoom up to 16x to read prescriptions, instructions, serial numbers, and other tiny details
- Capture and save images to your camera roll with a single tap
- Use the flashlight for better visibility in dark conditions
- Turn your front camera into a magnifying mirror
- Apply filters to enhance your view
- Enjoy a clean experience with non-intrusive ads
Whether you're dealing with vision difficulties or just need a simple and reliable magnifying tool, Magnifier is a smart and accessible choice.
Download and use Magnifier.app for free.
If you enjoy using Magnifier, your support means a lot to us.

bluejetty:00014603:ios.description:
A melhor plataforma para operar no mercado financeiro do Brasil chega agora ao seu smartphone! Realize operações nos segmentos da BMF e Bovespa com mobilidade, rapidez e facilidade. Usamos nossa expertise em desenvolver tecnologias avançadas para o mercado financeiro para criar uma versão em aplicativo do Profit totalmente inédito no mercado.
Com o Profit Mobile você conseguirá:
● Executar novas ordens de compra e/ou venda sem precisar estar conectado na versão
desktop
● Visualizar em tempo real quanto que está o seu ganho financeiro em cada ativo,
resultado total das operações e informações de custódia*
● Fácil acesso à sua lista de ordens
● Poderá usar ferramentas avançadas do Profit como nosso consagrado livro de
Ofertas e preços
● Primeiro aplicativo do mundo a disponibilizar um SuperDom totalmente operacional para
smartphones (disponível para quem tem a versão RT e Pro da versão desktop)
● Possibilidade de operar por meio de nossas renomadas boletas, em especial, a nossa
boleta day-trade
● Acompanhar todas as posições abertas na sua versão desktop pelo seu celular
● Grade de cotações para rápida visualização de como está o movimento do mercado e
dos papéis que você gostaria de acompanhar
*Apenas para corretoras que disponibilizam essa informação para a Nelogica.
As assinaturas do Profit feitas pelo aplicativo serão debitadas da sua conta do iTunes na confirmação da compra. As assinaturas tem duração de um mês e começam no momento em que é feito o pagamento. Uma assinatura permite o uso do aplicativo e da versão correspondente para desktop do produto comprado. 
As assinaturas são renovadas automaticamente até 24 horas antes do final do período atual, a menos que a renovação automática seja cancelada com 24 horas de antecedência do dia da cobrança. A assinatura pode ser gerenciada pelo usuário e a renovação automática pode ser cancelada nas configurações da conta da App Store, em Ajustes. 
Política de privacidade: https://www.nelogica.com.br/app-politica
Termos de uso: https://www.nelogica.com.br/app-termos

bluejetty:00127493:ios.description:
Monty eSIM is designed to be your go-to Mobile Data solution for borderless communication.
Advanced eSIM Technology:
Step into the future with Monty eSIM, a digital SIM card embedded in your device, delivering the same functionality as a physical SIM without the having to wait in queues & to switch cards.
Monty eSIM Plans:
Choose from a variety of local, regional & global eSIM plans for mobile data. Make voice calls, send text messages via your internet-based calling app (like WhatsApp) or social media.
Simple eSIM Activation Steps
- Download the Monty eSIM app.
- Choose an eSIM data plan.
- Install your eSIM with a QR code in less than 2 minutes.
- Enjoy seamless eSIM connectivity.
Unlock the Benefits of Monty eSIM:
- Enjoy affordable global eSIM connectivity, across over 190 countries and regions.
- Eliminate physical SIM cards & long queues
- Top up or switch eSIM plans on the go.
- Avoid expensive roaming fees.
Is your device eSIM compatible?
Instantly check your device's eSIM compatibility upon app download.
You can also dial *#06# and press call. If your device is eSIM-compatible, you'll be able to view your EID number.
Monty eSIM Coverage Extends to over 190+ Countries & regions such as
United Kingdom, Germany, Turkey, Thailand, Italy, Canada, France, Egypt, Spain, The Gambia, Netherlands, Japan, United States, Portugal, Morocco, Colombia, India, South Africa, Ireland, Mexico, Dominican Republic, Chile and many more
Experience the simplicity of Monty eSIM – your key to hassle-free travel mobile data around the world.

bluejetty:00070747:ios.name: Osman Gazi: Sword Fighting RPG
bluejetty:00070747:ios.developer: UMURO OYUN VE YAZILIM TEKNOLOJILERI ANONIM SIRKETI
bluejetty:00070747:ios.summary:
Take charge of the army with Osman Gazi and witness the foundation of the Ottoman Empire.
Play the story of an epic heroism inspired by real people and events.
Lead your people! All comrades like alps, balas and chicks are fighting under yo
bluejetty:00070747:ios.description:
Take charge of the army with Osman Gazi and witness the foundation of the Ottoman Empire.
Play the story of an epic heroism inspired by real people and events.
Lead your people! All comrades like alps, balas and chicks are fighting under your leadership. Smooth story missions are waiting for you with stunning console-quality 3D graphics. The breathless adventure is accompanied by professional music. Lead the Kayi Clan on different maps and fight for your Oba and principalities!
The mobile action adventure game you've been looking for. Put on your armor, go on the attack! Defeat the rebels! Become the hero of the people and the army!
Action full of Conquest and Adventure
The most wonderful scenes you can see in the war game class are at Osman Gazi! Conquer the castles where rebels, fierce enemies roam! Put implacable enemies to the sword, draw your fate on the way from the Seljuks to the foundation of the Ottoman Empire. Defeat your opponents and achieve victory in order to grow the KAYI Oba, which is the relic of Ertuğrul Gazi. Build your state, fight for justice and righteousness. 
Customizable Character!
You can customize your character in the Osman Gazi Game. You can equip yourself with anything you want from various swords, shields, armor and bows. You can also get a pet loyal steppe wolf that will fight with you. You will be generously rewarded with gold in each mission. Save the gold you collect, spend it in the store as you wish! Cool Axes, bows and more powerful equipment are waiting for you.
With a user-friendly interface and various mechanics from each other, experience the Osman Foundation scenario in 3D. Explore your world with extensive maps and stunning landscapes. 
The control is completely in your hands!
Visit Bala Hatun in the market place and jungle, walk around the market to Malhun Hatun, or march on the enemy by taking Bamsi Bey, Turgut Alp, Konur Alp and more with the implacable valiant. Have the pleasure of controlling real Turkish heroes and directing your soldiers. Take a horse and gallop or swim to the enemy ship. Climb the flags to infiltrate the protected castles, sneak up behind them and fight with rival warriors.
Fight the Enemies of the Medieval!
Fight the real Mongol, Crusader, Byzantine, Vikings, Catalan soldiers who have existed in history. Eliminate your powerful opponents, the bloody alliances that have been formed, continue your struggle with those who seem friendly to you, disrupt the games that have been set up against you. Become a hero in a breathtaking story set in the Medieval and protect your people from brutal warriors. Survive the ambushes and move forward confidently. Set your goal, conquer Yenişehir and the castles! 
No matter where you are, this non-stop action is at your fingertips. Feel the excitement everywhere! Download now for free and join the battle.
Contact Us
You can contact us from the info panel in the game. If you want to meet other people in the game and keep up to date with new updates, you can follow us on our social media accounts.
https://instagram.com/Umuro_Game
https://www.youtube.com/UMURO
http://facebook.com/UmuroGame
http://twitter.com/UmuroGame

YO
bluejetty:00121711:ios.description:
Ever wanted to be a princess and live in a beautiful castle? Your dream comes true with My Princess Castle! Create and dress princesses and have them living in castles decorated by yourself! The best princess game of all times is here! 
YOUR OWN PRINCESS 
Stop by the exclusive Beauty Salon to create and customize your own princess just the way you want! Pick her hairstyle, her eyes, her clothes and even her jewelry, tiara and shoes -- all of the things a real princess can’t live without! 
YOUR OWN CASTLE 
Pick your favorite castles and give them your personal touch with over a hundred different and beautiful items for every type of room you can imagine. Don’t forget to add cute dolls, puppies and kitties to play with! 
Use your creativity to design incredible living rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, kitchens and much more. When you are done, take a picture of your lovely castle or room to save it forever and share it with your best friends! 
My Princess Castle brings back all the magic, fantasy and enjoyment of princesses and their adorable castles. 
HIGHLIGHTS 
• Countless combinations for your princess doll 
• Many models of castles 
• Incredibly cute illustrations 
• Designed for people of all ages, from kids to adults 
• Over 100 exclusive decoration items 
• Cute dolls, puppies and kitties 
Live this fairy tale! Play My Princess Castle now and have fun with princesses and castles! 
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings. 
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

• On the land,
• In the air;

• save your picture in the gallery,

Millions of children and mothers around the world highly appreciated our games!

bluejetty:00045194:ios.name: Mysa
bluejetty:00045194:ios.summary:
With Mysa's regularly-updated, feature-packed mobile app, you get seriously smart control and home energy savings — all you need is a WiFi connection.
Remote access from anywhere via the Mysa app means you can easily set heating or cooling
bluejetty:00045194:ios.description:
With Mysa's regularly-updated, feature-packed mobile app, you get seriously smart control and home energy savings — all you need is a WiFi connection.
Remote access from anywhere via the Mysa app means you can easily set heating or cooling schedules, use geofencing, see your heating and cooling usage, and much more.
Stay energy-efficient and save money (and the planet!) with a few simple taps from your smartphone or tablet.
Mysa works with your favourite smart home platforms and home assistants, so you stay conveniently connected and in control.
Compatibility:
Mysa for Electric Baseboard Heaters works with high voltage baseboard, convector (short cycle), fan-forced convector (long cycle), and radiant ceiling heating systems.
Mysa for Electric In-Floor Heating works with most high voltage electric in-floor heating systems and flooring types.
Mysa for Air Conditioners replaces remotes with displays for most ductless mini-split heat pump, window, or portable air conditioners.
Energy-Saving App Features:
Remote Control: Get out there. Use your smartphone or tablet to control your home heating or cooling from wherever you are.
Scheduling: Life's busy. Create the flexible heating or cooling schedule that works best for you in less than a minute. Bye-bye, buttons!
Geolocation: Boundaries are important. Mysa uses your location to detect if anyone is home, so that you're not paying to heat or cool an empty house.
Shared Access: Teamwork works. Share access to your account easily so others can control your Mysas through the Mysa app.
Vacation Mode: Take a well-deserved break.
Away from home for a while? No worries! Mysa will keep helping you save energy while you're away.
Energy Insights (Baseboard, In-Floor, AC): Track and monitor your humidity, setpoint, and temperature to create efficient heating or cooling schedules.
Energy Spending (Baseboard & In-Floor):
See your spending. Track your real-time energy use in kWh cost to find ways to reduce your electricity bill.
Energy Runtime (AC): Get cool insights.
Know your AC's runtime history and use it for help with making smart decisions about your cooling or heating schedules.

Travel from station to station, each metro stop symbolising a piece of Laura's past and future. Solve various puzzles, find the correct m
bluejetty:00131071:ios.description:
Descend into the Rusty Lake Underground and travel through the life and memories of Laura Vanderboom!
Travel from station to station, each metro stop symbolising a piece of Laura's past and future. Solve various puzzles, find the correct metro to board and uncover one of Laura’s timelines, while simultaneously helping her make sense of her life and escape the corruption of her mind!
Underground Blossom is a new point-and-click adventure developed by the creators of the Cube Escape & Rusty Lake series.
Features:
▪ A new experience in a familiar setting
Enjoy a classic Rusty Lake point-and-click puzzle adventure with a gripping story full of mysteries and, of course, puzzles.
▪ Expect to make several stops
Travel to 7 unique metro stations, each station a representation of Laura Vanderboom’s life, memories and potential future. The estimated travel time is 2 hours.
▪ You know what to do
Unravel the potential secrets hidden in each metro station, earn achievements and who knows what else you might stumble upon!
▪ Don’t forget your headphones
At each metro stop you will be greeted by an atmospheric soundtrack by Victor Butzelaar, including a cello performance by Sebastiaan van Halsema!

bluejetty:00177956:ios.description:
It's late at night. The lights are out and just when you least expect it! BOO! There is a ghost in the Haunted House! But, do not be scared, this Haunted House is not like others! Those are friendly ghosts and skeletons who are waiting for you to have some HALLOWEEN FUN!
WELCOME to My Town: Scary Haunted House, the best scary game for kids where kids can experience funny adventure in the mystery house full of spooky game characters!
EXPLORE MYSTERY MANSION
It may look like a normal house when the lights are on, but once you switch them off, the mansion turns into a Haunted House full of ghosts, witches, and other spooky in-game characters! Haunted House is alive and waiting for you to explore a scary adventure full of spooky fun! Sneak inside the My Town: Scary Haunted House and unravel the mystery!
MY TOWN HAUNTED HOUSE FEATURES:
• Explore a Haunted House full of spooky fun
• Find Hidden surprises around the Haunted House
• Many spooky characters to add to your My Town doll collection
• Play the best HALLOWEEN game for kids
• Find the perfect scary costume and Halloween themed clothing
• Save mode: Continue your scary adventure at any time
• Multi-touch function: play with friends and family on the same device
• Encounter ghosts in the Mystery Mansion and get spook every time
On a moonless night, nothing is quite as fun as playing some ghost kids games, so try the best Halloween Haunted Scary game for kids - My Town: Scary Haunted House – and experience a unique scary adventure!
THE BEST HALLOWEEN GAME FOR KIDS!
The Haunted Mansion has a lot of secrets and looks scary but it’s all about Halloween! Check all rooms and unravel the mystery in this Halloween adventure scary kids game.
Find the friendly skeleton and make sure to look for ghosts in this scary Haunted Mansion! A friendly spooky Witch is hiding at the end of a secret door and she’s just waiting to be found! What’s that scary under the bed? Could it be a scary monster? Better check it out!
MY TOWN FUN GAME FOR ALL KIDS IN THE WORLD
Our Halloween game is made for all kids to experience a fun Halloween adventure and to be a part of the spooky magic! They can simulate and create own story playing with many characters in this game!
HAUNTED HOUSE FULL OF SPOOKY CREATURES
Unravel the mystery in the My Town: Haunted House and have a fun adventure playing a scary ghost game made for kids and enjoy Halloween all year long! 
You do not have to believe in ghosts to play this scary kids game. All you need is a bit of imagination and everything is possible! Just turn off the lights in the Haunted Mansion and try to find a friendly ghost! You and your friends might be surprised how funny they can be as Haunted Mansion is alive during the night!
DOWNLOAD MY TOWN HAUNTED HOUSE and experience Halloween! Try to catch a bat check what is hidden in the spider scary net or play spooky music on the piano! Haunted House is full of mystery! Sneak in and have fun in this Halloween Adventure game!
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
While this haunted game has a “spooky theme" it is made for kids to have fun and not to be scared. It's all about Halloween magic so kids can be part of it. Even this game suits children of all ages, we recommend it for children 6 years of age and above as it features ghosts and other scary characters.
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse games for kids that promote creativity and open-ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania, and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00062144:ios.description:
The Ultimate Dinosaur Park Experience for Kids!
Venture into a vivid Jurassic world alongside a friendly Triceratops. Designed exclusively for kids, this app seamlessly combines learning and play.
Dinosaur Adventure Awaits: Within the bounds of Dinosaur Park, journey through lush tropical forests, encounter the mysterious Pachycephalosaurus, indulge in games with the mighty T-rex in a sun-soaked desert, interact with the melodious Parasaurolophus amidst frosty glaciers, and become a paleontologist searching for elusive Pterosaurs remains.
Discover & Learn: As your child navigates this dinosaur game, they’ll be introduced to various colors and shapes in fun and interactive ways. A hidden world lies beneath, where a mole family calls the rainforest home, and tapping a snack machine unveils delightful treats. But that’s not all—curious rocks might just reveal a playful baby Dilophosaurus!
Engaging Gameplay: With over 30 animations, the game is a treasure trove of surprises, ensuring children remain immersed. Moreover, its child-friendly interface makes navigation a breeze for preschool-aged explorers.
More than Just Fun: It’s not all about fun; it's about learning too. Encounters in Dinosaur Park challenge kids, emphasizing the importance of observation, patience, and critical thinking. As challenges arise, they'll learn to approach problems independently, all while enjoying their time in this jurassic world.
Features:
• Dive deep into 4 distinct Jurassic islands and bond with dinosaur friends.
• Child-friendly animations galore—over 30 to be exact!
• Tailored for preschoolers (toddler, kindergarten, ages 2-5).
• A safe environment: Absolutely no third-party ads.
• Perfect for on-the-go adventures with offline capabilities.
About Yateland:
Creating apps that merge education with fun, Yateland is a beacon for preschoolers worldwide. Every game we craft is an ode to our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Dive into our world and discover more at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
At Yateland, the safety and privacy of our users are paramount. For a comprehensive overview of our privacy practices, kindly peruse our full policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00088499:ios.description:
Stack’s Bowers Galleries conducts live, Internet, and specialized auctions for U.S. and world rare coins, paper money, ancient coins, precious metals, and bullion. For more than eight-decades we have achieved dynamic results and realized record-breaking prices. This history guides our unwavering commitment to serve novice and expert collectors and enthusiasts, as well as industry professionals across the world. As America's oldest coin auction house, Stack's Bowers Galleries has auctioned many of the rarest coins and most valuable collections ever assembled. Our knowledgeable staff offers unsurpassed expertise in all areas of numismatics, as well as a commitment to excellent personal service.
Now more than ever, collectors are bidding online, and Stack’s Bowers Galleries has invested in creating an online experience as compelling and attractive to bidders as attending our in-person auctions. The Stack’s Bowers Galleries app features our iBid Live technology and makes participating in our sales as easy as ever. Our app allows users to browse our upcoming auctions lots, view past sales results, send us pictures of items to be appraised or consigned to a future sale, track items with our watchlist, leave presale and proxy bids, and bid in real time in our virtual auction gallery that live streams video from our auction studio.

bluejetty:00126971:ios.summary:

Resources include algorithms used to lo
bluejetty:00126971:ios.description:
Trusted for over 15 years by heart rhythm professionals worldwide, epTools is a collection of useful tools for the evaluation of heart rhythm disorders. It is available on iPhone and iPad devices. 
Resources include algorithms used to localize arrhythmia substrates and reference guides to assist in the identification and, management of cardiac rhythm disorders and tools to calculate commonly used measurements and risk scores. Peer-reviewed algorithms are implemented by tools via an intuitive user interface. References are provided. Tools guide the user or AI through a series of questions to arrive at an answer while providing a graphical visualization of their progress and result of their analysis. 
Use of the save path to image feature allows users to save an image of the current decision path when using many of the decision analysis tools included. These images, which appear in the photo album, may be useful to communicate findings with colleagues. 
Included tools:
Preexcitation variant localization:
 Arruda, Milstein, Taguchi , D'Avila, Li, Pambrun, Baek and Crinion and O'Leary et al.
Atrial tachycardias: 
Ellenbogen and Kistler et al (localization )
De Ponti et al tool (calculates the appropriate mapping window for isthmus identification)
Miyazaki et al (localizes macro reentrant ATs based on pacing responses)
Ischemic ventricular tachycardia localization: 
Miller, Segal and Andreu et al) 
Idiopathic ventricular tachycardia and premature ventricular contraction:
Ito, Park and Enriquez et al (localization)
ABC-VT Risk Score
Differentiation of left vs right ventricular outflow tract sites:
QRS-RVA Interval
V₂S/V₃R Index
TZ Index
V₂ Transition ratio 
R/S-wave Amplitude, R-Wave Duration, R-wave amplitude, V₂QRSI40 and RV₁-₃ indices.
Differentiate endocardial from epicardial VTs:
Maximum deflection index 
Daniels and Berruezo et al criteria
Differentiate SVT from VT:
Brugada, Verckei and Moccetti et al 
Disease Assessment: 
Consensus criteria for ARVD/C and Short QT Syndrome
5-yr risk of SCD in HCM (O'Mahon et al, and AHA)and LQTS (1-2-3-LQTS-Risk)
5-yr risk of life threatening VTA with LMNA variant
Inadequate DFT safety margin (Hsu et al )
LA arrhythmogenic substrate (Kosiuk et al, D'Ambrosio et al)
30-day mortality after PPM and ICD lead extraction (Brunner et al)
1-4 year mortality in 1° prevention ICD placement (Bilchick et al, SHOCKED)
Shanghai score (Brugada Syndrome), 
VT prediction in ARVD/C (Cadrin-Tourigny et al.)
Suspicious Index In Lyme Carditis (SILC)
PADIT and BLISTER CIED infection risk 
Misc:
Confirm conduction system capture with LBBAP.
myPace personalized heart rate calculator
A CIED/electrocautery manager is included. Detailed preoperative plans can be created and shared by text or email.
Clinical guidelines and consensus statement resource i
CHADS₂, CHA₂DS₂VASc and ATRIA stroke risk, HAS-BLED bleeding risk scores, 
QT correction heart rate (Bazett or Fredericia, Hodges) and left bundle branch block (Bogosian and Yankelson et al)

Buy new vehicles and improve the industry and all for the sake of building a nuclear power plant!
